Create `src/modules/shielded/a0/__testing__/offlineA0.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * TEST-ONLY: the A0 key equations computed OFFLINE, and a fake `NocturaProver` native module
 * built on them (never imported by app code).
 *
 * THE ANTI-CIRCULARITY BOUNDARY. Jest cannot load the Rust core, so the suites of the note store
 * and of recovery talk to this fake through the real bridge (`nativeProverBridge.ts`). Its
 * values come from two places only, neither of them code under test:
 *   - the committed offline vector file `native/noctura-prover/tests/fixtures/a0-key-vectors.json`
 *     (written by `scripts/a0-vectors/gen-key-vectors.mjs` from micro-key-producer/bls.js and
 *     poseidon-lite; the Rust core is held to the same file) — the seed → `nk` step is a LOOKUP in
 *     that file, so no derivation at the spend path happens in JS (§14 boundary);
 *   - the frozen equations of spec §3, re-implemented here directly on `poseidon-lite` and
 *     `@noble/hashes` SHA-512 — and held to every row of that file by `offlineA0.test.ts` before
 *     any suite may lean on them.
 * Nothing here imports `fieldEquations.ts`, `recovery.ts` or `noteStore.ts`.
 *
 * The fake follows the Rust core's documented contract (spec §3 "JNI surface", rev 3.2): one live
 * handle, a second `keysOpen` replaces it, a stale handle is refused (`E_A0_UNKNOWN_HANDLE`),
 * `matchSpent` refuses a repeated own rho (`E_A0_DUPLICATE_RHO`) and treats `chainNullifiers` as
 * a set, every value is 64 lowercase canonical hex (`E_A0_NON_CANONICAL`), every u64 a canonical
 * decimal (`E_A0_NOT_U64`). Every call is logged in `calls` (method + arguments) for the
 * handle-lifetime and "one matchSpent" assertions.
 */
import {readFileSync} from 'fs';
import {join} from 'path';
import {poseidon2, poseidon3, poseidon5} from 'poseidon-lite';
import {sha512} from '@noble/hashes/sha2.js';

export const FIELD_R =
  21888242871839275222246405745257275088548364400416034343698204186575808495617n;

export interface KeyVectorNote {
  depositIndex: string;
  rho: string;
  nullifier: string;
  rhoChange: string;
  commitments: {amount: string; commitment: string}[];
}
export interface KeyVectorSeed {
  label: string;
  seed: string;
  nk: string;
  ivk: string;
  dSelf: string;
  addrSelf: string;
  notes: KeyVectorNote[];
}
export interface KeyVectors {
  constants: {mintHash: string; dSelfDomain: string; depositRhoDomain: string; fieldModulus: string};
  seeds: KeyVectorSeed[];
}

export const KEY_VECTORS_PATH = join(
  __dirname,
  '../../../../../native/noctura-prover/tests/fixtures/a0-key-vectors.json',
);
export const KEY_VECTORS = JSON.parse(readFileSync(KEY_VECTORS_PATH, 'utf8')) as KeyVectors;

/** The repo's public test mnemonic (abandon … about) — the "own" seed of every recovery test. */
export const TEST_SEED = KEY_VECTORS.seeds[0]!;
/** The repo's second test mnemonic (zoo … wrong) — "somebody else". */
export const OTHER_SEED = KEY_VECTORS.seeds[1]!;

const enc = new TextEncoder();
const hex64 = (v: bigint): string => v.toString(16).padStart(64, '0');
const bytesOf = (h: string): Uint8Array => Uint8Array.from(Buffer.from(h, 'hex'));
const beModR = (b: Uint8Array): bigint => BigInt(`0x${Buffer.from(b).toString('hex')}`) % FIELD_R;
const u64be = (i: bigint): Uint8Array => {
  const b = new Uint8Array(8);
  new DataView(b.buffer).setBigUint64(0, i, false);
  return b;
};
const cat = (...parts: Uint8Array[]): Uint8Array => Uint8Array.from(parts.flatMap(p => [...p]));

const MINT_HASH = BigInt(`0x${KEY_VECTORS.constants.mintHash}`);
const TAG_CM = 0x10n;
const TAG_NULL = 0x11n;
const TAG_ADDR = 0x12n;
const TAG_RHO = 0x13n;

/** The §3 equations for one `nk`, computed offline. Every value 64 lowercase BE hex. */
export class OfflineA0Keys {
  readonly nk: bigint;
  readonly dSelf: bigint;
  readonly addrSelf: bigint;
  constructor(nkHex: string) {
    this.nk = BigInt(`0x${nkHex}`);
    this.dSelf = beModR(sha512(cat(enc.encode(KEY_VECTORS.constants.dSelfDomain), bytesOf(nkHex))));
    this.addrSelf = poseidon3([TAG_ADDR, this.nk, this.dSelf]);
  }
  /** rho(i) = be_mod_r(SHA-512("noctura/a0/deposit-rho/v1" ‖ be32(nk) ‖ u64be(i))) */
  rho(i: bigint): string {
    return hex64(
      beModR(sha512(cat(enc.encode(KEY_VECTORS.constants.depositRhoDomain), bytesOf(hex64(this.nk)), u64be(i)))),
    );
  }
  /** nullifier(rho) = Poseidon3(0x11, nk, rho) */
  nullifier(rho: string): string {
    return hex64(poseidon3([TAG_NULL, this.nk, BigInt(`0x${rho}`)]));
  }
  /** commitment(amount, rho) = Poseidon5(0x10, addrField(d_self), amount, mintHash, rho) */
  commitment(amount: bigint, rho: string): string {
    return hex64(poseidon5([TAG_CM, this.addrSelf, amount, MINT_HASH, BigInt(`0x${rho}`)]));
  }
  /** rho_change = Poseidon3(0x13, nullifier, 0) */
  rhoChange(nullifier: string): string {
    return hex64(poseidon3([TAG_RHO, BigInt(`0x${nullifier}`), 0n]));
  }
}

/** The offline keys of a vector seed. */
export function offlineKeys(seed: KeyVectorSeed): OfflineA0Keys {
  return new OfflineA0Keys(seed.nk);
}

/** A fresh copy of a vector seed's 64 bytes (the bridge consumes — zero-fills — what it is given). */
export function seedBytes(seed: KeyVectorSeed): Uint8Array {
  return bytesOf(seed.seed);
}

/** A different 32-byte field element, deterministic in `k` (a stranger's commitment, a change leaf). */
export function strangerField(k: number): string {
  return hex64(poseidon2([0x7777n, BigInt(k)]));
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ the fake native module

export interface FakeCall {
  method: string;
  args: unknown[];
}

class NativeRefusal extends Error {
  readonly code: string;
  constructor(code: string, message: string) {
    super(`${code}: ${message}`);
    this.code = code;
  }
}

const HEX = /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/;
const U64 = /^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$/;
const canonical = (v: unknown, what: string): string => {
  if (typeof v !== 'string' || !HEX.test(v) || BigInt(`0x${v}`) >= FIELD_R) {
    throw new NativeRefusal('E_A0_NON_CANONICAL', `${what} ${String(v)}`);
  }
  return v;
};
const u64 = (v: unknown, what: string): bigint => {
  if (typeof v !== 'string' || !U64.test(v) || BigInt(v) >= 2n ** 64n) {
    throw new NativeRefusal('E_A0_NOT_U64', `${what} ${String(v)}`);
  }
  return BigInt(v);
};

export interface FakeProverNative {
  isSupported(): boolean;
  proveV1(): Promise<never>;
  keysOpen(seed: number[]): Promise<string>;
  keysClose(handle: string): Promise<null>;
  depositRho(handle: string, depositIndex: string): Promise<string>;
  matchSpent(handle: string, chainNullifiers: string[], ownRhos: string[]): Promise<number[]>;
  commitment(handle: string, amount: string, rho: string): Promise<string>;
  prove(): Promise<never>;
  /** test controls */
  readonly calls: FakeCall[];
  /** the live handle, or null */
  liveHandle(): string | null;
  /** the next call of `method` rejects with `error` (once) */
  failNext(method: string, error: Error): void;
  reset(): void;
}

/** A fake of the NocturaProver React module, computing every value offline (above). */
export function createFakeProverNative(): FakeProverNative {
  const calls: FakeCall[] = [];
  let live: {handle: string; keys: OfflineA0Keys} | null = null;
  let counter = 0;
  const failures = new Map<string, Error>();

  const enter = (method: string, args: unknown[]): void => {
    calls.push({method, args: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(args)) as unknown[]});
    const f = failures.get(method);
    if (f) {
      failures.delete(method);
      throw f;
    }
  };
  const keysOf = (handle: string): OfflineA0Keys => {
    if (!live || live.handle !== handle) {
      throw new NativeRefusal('E_A0_UNKNOWN_HANDLE', `handle ${handle}`);
    }
    return live.keys;
  };

  return {
    calls,
    liveHandle: () => live?.handle ?? null,
    failNext: (method, error) => {
      failures.set(method, error);
    },
    reset: () => {
      calls.length = 0;
      live = null;
      failures.clear();
    },
    isSupported: () => true,
    proveV1: async () => {
      throw new NativeRefusal('E_V1_REMOVED', 'the v1 prover is removed');
    },
    prove: async () => {
      throw new NativeRefusal('E_FAKE_NO_PROVE', 'the fake proves nothing (recovery never proves)');
    },
    keysOpen: async (seed: number[]) => {
      enter('keysOpen', [seed.length]); // the seed itself is never logged
      live = null; // a second open ends the live session before validating the new seed (rev 3.2)
      if (!Array.isArray(seed) || seed.length !== 64) {
        throw new NativeRefusal('E_A0_SEED_LENGTH', `seed of ${seed.length} bytes`);
      }
      const hex = Buffer.from(seed).toString('hex');
      const v = KEY_VECTORS.seeds.find(s => s.seed === hex);
      if (!v) {
        throw new Error('fakeProverNative: a seed outside a0-key-vectors.json (the fake derives nothing)');
      }
      counter += 1;
      live = {handle: String(counter), keys: new OfflineA0Keys(v.nk)};
      return live.handle;
    },
    keysClose: async (handle: string) => {
      enter('keysClose', [handle]);
      keysOf(handle);
      live = null;
      return null;
    },
    depositRho: async (handle: string, depositIndex: string) => {
      enter('depositRho', [handle, depositIndex]);
      return keysOf(handle).rho(u64(depositIndex, 'depositIndex'));
    },
    commitment: async (handle: string, amount: string, rho: string) => {
      enter('commitment', [handle, amount, rho]);
      const k = keysOf(handle);
      return k.commitment(u64(amount, 'amount'), canonical(rho, 'rho'));
    },
    matchSpent: async (handle: string, chainNullifiers: string[], ownRhos: string[]) => {
      enter('matchSpent', [handle, chainNullifiers, ownRhos]);
      const k = keysOf(handle);
      const chain = new Set(chainNullifiers.map((n, i) => canonical(n, `chainNullifier[${i}]`)));
      const seen = new Set<string>();
      const out: number[] = [];
      ownRhos.forEach((r, i) => {
        canonical(r, `ownRho[${i}]`);
        if (seen.has(r)) {
          throw new NativeRefusal('E_A0_DUPLICATE_RHO', `ownRho[${i}] repeats`);
        }
        seen.add(r);
        if (chain.has(k.nullifier(r))) {
          out.push(i);
        }
      });
      return out;
    },
  };
}
```

Create `src/modules/shielded/a0/__testing__/ownHistory.ts`:

```ts
/* eslint-disable no-bitwise -- the incremental Merkle insert is bit arithmetic on the leaf index */
/**
 * TEST-ONLY: a synthetic continuation of the recorded devnet history in which SOMEONE ELSE's seed
 * did not make every deposit (never imported by app code).
 *
 * The recorded tree (fixtures/devnet-tree-5URd.json) holds only the program side's deposits, made
 * with their keys — so for the test seed it has no own note at all (the negative case of the
 * recovery suite). For the positive cases this helper appends transactions to a copy of it, each
 * a clone of a REAL landed transaction with exactly the fields a deposit or an unshield changes:
 *   - a deposit = a clone of `3DR6F7oW…` with the instruction's `amount` / `commitment` / `rho`
 *     rewritten (§1 layout: disc | amount u64 LE | commitment | rho | u32 256 | proof — the proof
 *     bytes are the landed one's; the sync does not verify proofs), its rho-marker account set to
 *     PDA(["rho", rho]), and its `LeafInserted` set to the new leaf;
 *   - an unshield = a clone of the relayed `3UfCx5TD…` with the `nullifier` and
 *     `change_commitment` arguments rewritten, its `LeafInserted` (the change leaf) and its
 *     `Withdraw` nullifier set accordingly;
 * and after each one the tree ACCOUNT is advanced the way the program advances it (the account's
 * own zeros and filled subtrees, the leaf inserted with poseidon-lite's Poseidon2 — not the sync's
 * code —, the ring head moved before the root is written, nextLeafIndex + 1). The tree sync
 * therefore verifies the extended chain exactly as it verifies the recorded one: every event
 * root, the ring, the head and the filled subtrees.
 *
 * The values (rho, commitment, nullifier) are the caller's — the recovery suites take them from
 * the offline equations (offlineA0.ts), never from the code under test.
 */
import {PublicKey} from '@solana/web3.js';
import {base58} from '@scure/base';
import {poseidon2} from 'poseidon-lite';
import {
  accountBytes,
  appendTopLevelIx,
  blobsOf,
  cloneAsNewest,
  freshSignature,
  fromHex,
  leafBlob,
  setAccountBytes,
  setBlob,
  toHex,
  txOf,
} from './chainEdits';
import type {RecordedChain, RecordedTx} from './recordedRpc';

const PROGRAM = 'FeGSSsJtmA7GnMgnpj33JsiceSk1NyFopff2FtQFsMuH';
const LEAF_INSERTED = '59f3d408d7bfbb98';
const WITHDRAW = 'c0f1c9d946965af7';
const DEPOSIT_DISC = 'f223c68952e1f2b6';
const WITHDRAW_DISC = '6cf44379ecf67997';
const DEPTH = 20;
const RING = 64;
const OFF = {next: 8, zeros: 16, filled: 656, ring: 1296, head: 3344};
/** a slot after every recorded one (the newest recorded is 520152276) */
const FIRST_SLOT = 523_000_000;

const fe = (h: string): bigint => BigInt(`0x${h}`);
const hex64 = (v: bigint): string => v.toString(16).padStart(64, '0');

/** PDA(["rho", rho]) / PDA(["nullifier", n]) of FeGSS…, with the real web3.js (the suite's realWeb3 line). */
export function rhoPda(rho: string): string {
  return PublicKey.findProgramAddressSync([Buffer.from('rho'), Buffer.from(rho, 'hex')], new PublicKey(PROGRAM))[0].toBase58();
}
export function nullifierPda(nullifier: string): string {
  return PublicKey.findProgramAddressSync(
    [Buffer.from('nullifier'), Buffer.from(nullifier, 'hex')],
    new PublicKey(PROGRAM),
  )[0].toBase58();
}

/** Insert `leaf` into the chain's account as the program does; returns its leaf index and the new root. */
function insertLeaf(chain: RecordedChain, leaf: string): {leafIndex: number; root: string} {
  const b = accountBytes(chain);
  const dv = new DataView(b.buffer, b.byteOffset, b.byteLength);
  const next = Number(dv.getBigUint64(OFF.next, true));
  const at = (off: number, i: number) => toHex(b.subarray(off + 32 * i, off + 32 * (i + 1)));
  let cur = fe(leaf);
  let idx = next;
  for (let i = 0; i < DEPTH; i++) {
    if ((idx & 1) === 0) {
      b.set(fromHex(hex64(cur)), OFF.filled + 32 * i);
      cur = poseidon2([cur, fe(at(OFF.zeros, i))]);
    } else {
      cur = poseidon2([fe(at(OFF.filled, i)), cur]);
    }
    idx >>= 1;
  }
  const head = (Number(dv.getBigUint64(OFF.head, true)) + 1) % RING;
  b.set(fromHex(hex64(cur)), OFF.ring + 32 * head);
  dv.setBigUint64(OFF.head, BigInt(head), true);
  dv.setBigUint64(OFF.next, BigInt(next + 1), true);
  setAccountBytes(chain, b);
  return {leafIndex: next, root: hex64(cur)};
}

let serial = 0;
/** A fresh signature and slot for the next appended tx (unique within the test file's process). */
function nextId(): {sig: string; slot: number} {
  serial += 1;
  return {sig: freshSignature(serial), slot: FIRST_SLOT + serial};
}

function poolIx(tx: RecordedTx): {programIdIndex: number; accounts: number[]; data: string} {
  const msg = tx.transaction.message;
  const ixs = msg.instructions.filter(i => msg.accountKeys[i.programIdIndex] === PROGRAM);
  if (ixs.length !== 1) {
    throw new Error(`ownHistory: template has ${ixs.length} pool instructions`);
  }
  return ixs[0]!;
}

function setLeafBlob(tx: RecordedTx, commitment: string, leafIndex: number, root: string): void {
  const lines = blobsOf(tx).filter(x => toHex(x.bytes.subarray(0, 8)) === LEAF_INSERTED);
  if (lines.length !== 1) {
    throw new Error(`ownHistory: template has ${lines.length} LeafInserted`);
  }
  setBlob(tx, lines[0]!.line, leafBlob(LEAF_INSERTED, commitment, leafIndex, root));
}

export interface AppendedDeposit {
  signature: string;
  leafIndex: number;
  root: string;
}

/** Append a deposit `{amount, commitment, rho}` (a clone of the landed 3DR6F7oW…) as the newest tx. */
export function appendDeposit(
  chain: RecordedChain,
  d: {amount: bigint; commitment: string; rho: string},
): AppendedDeposit {
  const {sig, slot} = nextId();
  const tx = cloneAsNewest(chain, txOf(chain, '3DR6F7oW').tx, sig, slot);
  const ix = poolIx(tx);
  const data = base58.decode(ix.data);
  if (data.length !== 340 || toHex(data.subarray(0, 8)) !== DEPOSIT_DISC) {
    throw new Error('ownHistory: the deposit template is not a 340-byte deposit');
  }
  new DataView(data.buffer, data.byteOffset, data.byteLength).setBigUint64(8, d.amount, true);
  data.set(fromHex(d.commitment), 16);
  data.set(fromHex(d.rho), 48);
  ix.data = base58.encode(data);
  // the rho marker is the instruction's account 5 (DepositCtx order)
  tx.transaction.message.accountKeys[ix.accounts[5]!] = rhoPda(d.rho);
  const {leafIndex, root} = insertLeaf(chain, d.commitment);
  setLeafBlob(tx, d.commitment, leafIndex, root);
  return {signature: sig, leafIndex, root};
}

/**
 * Append ONE transaction carrying two deposits: `first` as in `appendDeposit`, then `second` as a
 * second top-level pool instruction (same accounts) with its own frame and LeafInserted — so the
 * second deposit's leaf is NOT the transaction's first LeafInserted.
 */
export function appendDepositPair(
  chain: RecordedChain,
  first: {amount: bigint; commitment: string; rho: string},
  second: {amount: bigint; commitment: string; rho: string},
): {signature: string; leafIndices: [number, number]} {
  const a = appendDeposit(chain, first);
  const tx = chain.transactions[a.signature]!;
  const ix = poolIx(tx);
  const data = base58.decode(ix.data);
  new DataView(data.buffer, data.byteOffset, data.byteLength).setBigUint64(8, second.amount, true);
  data.set(fromHex(second.commitment), 16);
  data.set(fromHex(second.rho), 48);
  const {leafIndex, root} = insertLeaf(chain, second.commitment);
  appendTopLevelIx(tx, {
    program: PROGRAM,
    accounts: ix.accounts.map(k => tx.transaction.message.accountKeys[k]!),
    data,
    blobs: [leafBlob(LEAF_INSERTED, second.commitment, leafIndex, root)],
  });
  return {signature: a.signature, leafIndices: [a.leafIndex, leafIndex]};
}

/** Append a relayed unshield spending `nullifier` (a clone of 3UfCx5TD…) with change leaf `changeCommitment`. */
export function appendWithdraw(
  chain: RecordedChain,
  w: {nullifier: string; changeCommitment: string},
): AppendedDeposit {
  const {sig, slot} = nextId();
  const tx = cloneAsNewest(chain, txOf(chain, '3UfCx5TD').tx, sig, slot);
  const ix = poolIx(tx);
  const data = base58.decode(ix.data);
  if (data.length !== 380 || toHex(data.subarray(0, 8)) !== WITHDRAW_DISC) {
    throw new Error('ownHistory: the withdraw template is not a 380-byte withdraw_with_change');
  }
  data.set(fromHex(w.nullifier), 40);
  data.set(fromHex(w.changeCommitment), 80);
  ix.data = base58.encode(data);
  const {leafIndex, root} = insertLeaf(chain, w.changeCommitment);
  setLeafBlob(tx, w.changeCommitment, leafIndex, root);
  const wd = blobsOf(tx).filter(x => toHex(x.bytes.subarray(0, 8)) === WITHDRAW);
  if (wd.length !== 1) {
    throw new Error(`ownHistory: template has ${wd.length} Withdraw`);
  }
  setBlob(tx, wd[0]!.line, Uint8Array.from([...fromHex(WITHDRAW), ...fromHex(w.nullifier)]));
  return {signature: sig, leafIndex, root};
}
```

```ts
/**
 * The test fake of the native A0 core is only as good as its values: before any recovery suite
 * leans on it, every value it computes is held to the committed OFFLINE vector file
 * (native/noctura-prover/tests/fixtures/a0-key-vectors.json, written by
 * scripts/a0-vectors/gen-key-vectors.mjs — the same file the Rust core is held to). A fake that
 * agreed only with the code under test would make recovery's tests agree by construction.
 */
import {
  KEY_VECTORS,
  OTHER_SEED,
  TEST_SEED,
  createFakeProverNative,
  offlineKeys,
  seedBytes,
} from '../__testing__/offlineA0';

describe('the offline equations equal every row of a0-key-vectors.json', () => {
  it.each(KEY_VECTORS.seeds.map(s => [s.label, s] as const))('%s', (_label, seed) => {
    const k = offlineKeys(seed);
    expect(k.dSelf.toString(16).padStart(64, '0')).toBe(seed.dSelf);
    expect(k.addrSelf.toString(16).padStart(64, '0')).toBe(seed.addrSelf);
    expect(seed.notes.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(5);
    for (const n of seed.notes) {
      expect(k.rho(BigInt(n.depositIndex))).toBe(n.rho);
      expect(k.nullifier(n.rho)).toBe(n.nullifier);
      expect(k.rhoChange(n.nullifier)).toBe(n.rhoChange);
      for (const c of n.commitments) {
        expect(k.commitment(BigInt(c.amount), n.rho)).toBe(c.commitment);
      }
    }
  });

  it('negative control: another seed\'s keys do not reproduce the test seed\'s rows', () => {
    const other = offlineKeys(OTHER_SEED);
    const n = TEST_SEED.notes[0]!;
    expect(other.rho(0n)).not.toBe(n.rho);
    expect(other.nullifier(n.rho)).not.toBe(n.nullifier);
    expect(other.commitment(1n, n.rho)).not.toBe(n.commitments[1]!.commitment);
  });
});

describe('the fake native module follows the core\'s contract', () => {
  it('opens by the vector seed, answers with the offline values, and refuses a stale handle', async () => {
    const f = createFakeProverNative();
    const h = await f.keysOpen(Array.from(seedBytes(TEST_SEED)));
    expect(await f.depositRho(h, '0')).toBe(TEST_SEED.notes[0]!.rho);
    expect(await f.commitment(h, '1', TEST_SEED.notes[0]!.rho)).toBe(TEST_SEED.notes[0]!.commitments[1]!.commitment);
    const n1 = TEST_SEED.notes[1]!;
    expect(await f.matchSpent(h, [n1.nullifier, n1.nullifier, OTHER_SEED.notes[0]!.nullifier], [TEST_SEED.notes[0]!.rho, n1.rho])).toEqual([1]);
    await f.keysClose(h);
    await expect(f.depositRho(h, '0')).rejects.toMatchObject({code: 'E_A0_UNKNOWN_HANDLE'});
    await expect(f.keysClose(h)).rejects.toMatchObject({code: 'E_A0_UNKNOWN_HANDLE'});
  });

  it('a second keysOpen replaces the first; a repeated own rho and a non-canonical value refuse', async () => {
    const f = createFakeProverNative();
    const a = await f.keysOpen(Array.from(seedBytes(TEST_SEED)));
    const b = await f.keysOpen(Array.from(seedBytes(OTHER_SEED)));
    await expect(f.depositRho(a, '0')).rejects.toMatchObject({code: 'E_A0_UNKNOWN_HANDLE'});
    expect(await f.depositRho(b, '0')).toBe(OTHER_SEED.notes[0]!.rho);
    const r = OTHER_SEED.notes[0]!.rho;
    await expect(f.matchSpent(b, [], [r, r])).rejects.toMatchObject({code: 'E_A0_DUPLICATE_RHO'});
    await expect(f.commitment(b, '1', 'ff'.repeat(32))).rejects.toMatchObject({code: 'E_A0_NON_CANONICAL'});
    await expect(f.depositRho(b, '01')).rejects.toMatchObject({code: 'E_A0_NOT_U64'});
  });
});
```

```ts
/**
 * Recovery of deposits from the seed (spec §7 "Deposits", R12, R13, §8 "after a restore it is the
 * highest recovered depositIndex + 1").
 *
 * The chain is the recorded devnet history of tree 5URd… (fixtures/devnet-tree-5URd.json), served
 * to the REAL web3.js Connection (recordedRpc.ts) and verified by the real tree sync. Its deposits
 * were made by the PROGRAM SIDE's keys, so for the test seed it holds no own note — the negative
 * case. The positive cases append deposits and unshields of the test seed to a copy of it
 * (ownHistory.ts: clones of real landed txs, the tree account advanced as the program advances
 * it), with every rho / commitment / nullifier taken from the OFFLINE equations (offlineA0.ts,
 * held to a0-key-vectors.json) — never from the code under test. The native core is the offline
 * fake behind the real bridge.
 */

  jest.requireActual<typeof import('../__testing__/realWeb3')>('../__testing__/realWeb3').loadRealWeb3(),
);
jest.mock('react-native', () => ({

    NocturaProver: jest.requireActual<typeof import('../__testing__/offlineA0')>('../__testing__/offlineA0').createFakeProverNative(),
  },
}));
import {readFileSync} from 'fs';
import {join} from 'path';
import {NativeModules} from 'react-native';
import {clearAllStores, initSecureMmkv, mmkvSecure} from '../../../../store/mmkv/instances';
import {OTHER_SEED, TEST_SEED, offlineKeys, seedBytes, strangerField} from '../__testing__/offlineA0';
import type {FakeProverNative} from '../__testing__/offlineA0';
import {appendDeposit, appendDepositPair, appendWithdraw} from '../__testing__/ownHistory';
import {chainFrom, recordedConnection} from '../__testing__/recordedRpc';
import type {RecordedChain, RecordedFixture} from '../__testing__/recordedRpc';
import {addA0PendingDeposit, loadA0NoteStore, setA0NextDepositIndex} from '../noteStore';
import {
  A0_DEPOSIT_GAP_LIMIT,
  A0RecoveryError,
  a0R13TriggerReached,
  loadA0LastRestoreStats,
  restoreA0FromSeed,
} from '../recovery';

const TREE = JSON.parse(
  readFileSync(join(__dirname, 'fixtures/devnet-tree-5URd.json'), 'utf8'),
) as RecordedFixture;
const fake = NativeModules.NocturaProver as unknown as FakeProverNative;
const own = offlineKeys(TEST_SEED);
const other = offlineKeys(OTHER_SEED);
const KEY = 'v1_a0_notes';

const fresh = (): RecordedChain => chainFrom(TREE);
const restore = (chain: RecordedChain, seed: Uint8Array = seedBytes(TEST_SEED)) =>
  restoreA0FromSeed(recordedConnection(chain).connection, seed, {sync: {useCache: false}});

/** Our deposit at counter `i` (rho and commitment from the offline equations). */
const ownDeposit = (chain: RecordedChain, i: bigint, amount: bigint) => {
  const rho = own.rho(i);
  return {rho, commitment: own.commitment(amount, rho), ...appendDeposit(chain, {amount, rho, commitment: own.commitment(amount, rho)})};
};
/** Every Withdraw nullifier of the recorded history, decoded independently from its logs. */
const recordedNullifiers = (chain: RecordedChain): string[] =>
  [...chain.signatures].reverse().flatMap(s =>
    chain.transactions[s.signature]!.meta.logMessages
      .filter(l => l.startsWith('Program data: '))
      .map(l => Buffer.from(l.slice(14), 'base64'))
      .filter(b => b.subarray(0, 8).toString('hex') === 'c0f1c9d946965af7')
      .map(b => b.subarray(8, 40).toString('hex')),
  );
const callsOf = (m: string) => fake.calls.filter(c => c.method === m);

beforeEach(() => {
  clearAllStores();
  initSecureMmkv('test-key');
  fake.reset();
});

describe('the recorded devnet history (the program side\'s deposits) — the negative case', () => {
  it('yields ZERO own notes for the test seed: counter 0, exactly the gap limit tried, no matchSpent', async () => {
    const chain = fresh();
    const res = await restore(chain);
    expect(res.notes).toEqual([]);
    expect(res.nextDepositIndex).toBe(0n);
    expect(A0_DEPOSIT_GAP_LIMIT).toBe(20);
    expect(callsOf('depositRho').map(c => c.args[1])).toEqual([...Array(20).keys()].map(String));
    expect(callsOf('commitment')).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(callsOf('matchSpent')).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(res.stats.treeTransactions).toBe(15);
    expect(loadA0NoteStore()).toEqual({nextDepositIndex: 0n, notes: []});
  });

  it('the history does hold deposits and unshields — they are simply not ours', async () => {
    const res = await restore(fresh());
    expect(res.stats.depositsInHistory).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(5);
    expect(recordedNullifiers(fresh()).length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(4);
    expect(res.stats.withdrawNullifiersInHistory).toBe(recordedNullifiers(fresh()).length);
  });
});

describe('own deposits appended to the recorded history — the positive cases', () => {
  it('finds every own deposit: amount from the instruction, leaf from LeafInserted, spent-status from ONE matchSpent', async () => {
    const chain = fresh();
    const d0 = ownDeposit(chain, 0n, 1_000_000_000n);
    appendDeposit(chain, {amount: 7n, rho: other.rho(0n), commitment: other.commitment(7n, other.rho(0n))});
    const d1 = ownDeposit(chain, 1n, 250_000_000n);
    appendWithdraw(chain, {nullifier: own.nullifier(d1.rho), changeCommitment: strangerField(1)});
    const d2 = ownDeposit(chain, 2n, 42n);
    const res = await restore(chain);
    expect(res.notes).toEqual([
      {commitment: d0.commitment, amount: 1_000_000_000n, rho: d0.rho, depositIndex: 0n, leafIndex: 17, status: 'unspent'},
      {commitment: d1.commitment, amount: 250_000_000n, rho: d1.rho, depositIndex: 1n, leafIndex: 19, status: 'spent'},
      {commitment: d2.commitment, amount: 42n, rho: d2.rho, depositIndex: 2n, leafIndex: 21, status: 'unspent'},
    ]);
    expect([d0.leafIndex, d1.leafIndex, d2.leafIndex]).toEqual([17, 19, 21]);
    expect(res.nextDepositIndex).toBe(3n);
    // ONE matchSpent: every synced Withdraw nullifier, every own rho
    const ms = callsOf('matchSpent');
    expect(ms).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(ms[0]!.args[1]).toEqual([...recordedNullifiers(fresh()), own.nullifier(d1.rho)]);
    expect(ms[0]!.args[2]).toEqual([d0.rho, d1.rho, d2.rho]);
    // the commitment check went through Rust's commitment() for each hit
    expect(callsOf('commitment').map(c => c.args.slice(1))).toEqual([
      ['1000000000', d0.rho],
      ['250000000', d1.rho],
      ['42', d2.rho],
    ]);
    // and the store holds them, with no nullifier anywhere
    expect(loadA0NoteStore()).toEqual({nextDepositIndex: 3n, notes: res.notes});
    const text = mmkvSecure()!.getString(KEY)!;
    for (const r of [d0.rho, d1.rho, d2.rho]) {
      expect(text).not.toContain(own.nullifier(r));
    }
    expect(res.stats).toMatchObject({ownNotes: 3, spentNotes: 1, foreignRhoHits: 0, depositIndicesTried: 23});
  });

  it('deposits that landed out of counter order are all found, returned by counter', async () => {
    const chain = fresh();
    const d2 = ownDeposit(chain, 2n, 3n);
    const d0 = ownDeposit(chain, 0n, 1n);
    const d1 = ownDeposit(chain, 1n, 2n);
    const res = await restore(chain);
    expect(res.notes.map(n => [n.depositIndex, n.leafIndex, n.rho])).toEqual([
      [0n, d0.leafIndex, d0.rho],
      [1n, d1.leafIndex, d1.rho],
      [2n, d2.leafIndex, d2.rho],
    ]);
  });

  it('two deposits in one transaction, a stranger\'s first: our note takes the leaf of ITS commitment, not the first leaf', async () => {
    const chain = fresh();
    const r0 = own.rho(0n);
    const pair = appendDepositPair(
      chain,
      {amount: 7n, rho: other.rho(0n), commitment: other.commitment(7n, other.rho(0n))},
      {amount: 8n, rho: r0, commitment: own.commitment(8n, r0)},
    );
    expect(pair.leafIndices).toEqual([17, 18]);
    const res = await restore(chain);
    expect(res.notes).toEqual([{commitment: own.commitment(8n, r0), amount: 8n, rho: r0, depositIndex: 0n, leafIndex: 18, status: 'unspent'}]);
  });

  it('OUR rho under SOMEONE ELSE\'s commitment (a front-run) is not imported — but it burns its counter', async () => {
    const chain = fresh();
    const d0 = ownDeposit(chain, 0n, 5n);
    const r1 = own.rho(1n);
    appendDeposit(chain, {amount: 5n, rho: r1, commitment: other.commitment(5n, r1)});
    const d2 = ownDeposit(chain, 2n, 5n);
    const res = await restore(chain);
    expect(res.notes.map(n => n.rho)).toEqual([d0.rho, d2.rho]);
    expect(res.stats.foreignRhoHits).toBe(1);
    expect(res.nextDepositIndex).toBe(3n);
  });

  it('a deposit whose instruction amount is not the one its commitment binds is not imported (the check uses the instruction\'s amount)', async () => {
    const chain = fresh();
    const r0 = own.rho(0n);
    appendDeposit(chain, {amount: 6n, rho: r0, commitment: own.commitment(5n, r0)});
    const res = await restore(chain);
    expect(res.notes).toEqual([]);
    expect(res.stats.foreignRhoHits).toBe(1);
    expect(res.nextDepositIndex).toBe(1n);
    // positive twin: the same deposit with the matching amount is ours
    const ok = fresh();
    appendDeposit(ok, {amount: 5n, rho: r0, commitment: own.commitment(5n, r0)});
    expect((await restore(ok)).notes.map(n => n.amount)).toEqual([5n]);
  });

  it('two successful deposits carrying one rho (impossible on chain: the rho PDA is init) refuse the recovery', async () => {
    const chain = fresh();
    const d0 = ownDeposit(chain, 0n, 5n);
    appendDeposit(chain, {amount: 6n, rho: d0.rho, commitment: own.commitment(6n, d0.rho)});
    const err = await restore(chain).catch((e: unknown) => e);
    expect(err).toBeInstanceOf(A0RecoveryError);
    expect((err as A0RecoveryError).code).toBe('E_A0_RECOVERY_DUPLICATE_RHO');
    expect(fake.liveHandle()).toBeNull();
    expect(mmkvSecure()!.getString(KEY)).toBeUndefined();
  });
});

describe('the gap limit (20 consecutive misses)', () => {
  it('19 misses then a hit → found (and the walk goes on 20 past it)', async () => {
    const chain = fresh();
    ownDeposit(chain, 0n, 1n);
    ownDeposit(chain, 20n, 2n);
    const res = await restore(chain);
    expect(res.notes.map(n => n.depositIndex)).toEqual([0n, 20n]);
    expect(res.nextDepositIndex).toBe(21n);
    expect(res.stats.depositIndicesTried).toBe(41);
  });

  it('20 misses → stop: a deposit 21 past the last hit is not looked for', async () => {
    const chain = fresh();
    ownDeposit(chain, 0n, 1n);
    ownDeposit(chain, 21n, 2n);
    const res = await restore(chain);
    expect(res.notes.map(n => n.depositIndex)).toEqual([0n]);
    expect(res.nextDepositIndex).toBe(1n);
    expect(res.stats.depositIndicesTried).toBe(21);
    expect(callsOf('depositRho').map(c => c.args[1])).not.toContain('21');
  });

  it('from the start: a first deposit at 19 is found, at 20 it is not', async () => {
    const at19 = fresh();
    ownDeposit(at19, 19n, 1n);
    expect((await restore(at19)).notes.map(n => n.depositIndex)).toEqual([19n]);
    fake.reset();
    const at20 = fresh();
    ownDeposit(at20, 20n, 1n);
    const res = await restore(at20);
    expect(res.notes).toEqual([]);
    expect(res.nextDepositIndex).toBe(0n);
  });
});

describe('the key handle and the seed (spec §3 "Handle lifetime", C3)', () => {
  it('one keysOpen, one keysClose of the same handle; the caller\'s seed is zero-filled', async () => {
    const chain = fresh();
    ownDeposit(chain, 0n, 1n);
    const seed = seedBytes(TEST_SEED);
    await restore(chain, seed);
    expect(callsOf('keysOpen')).toHaveLength(1);
    const closes = callsOf('keysClose');
    expect(closes).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(closes[0]!.args[0]).toBe(callsOf('depositRho')[0]!.args[0]);
    expect(fake.liveHandle()).toBeNull();
    expect(seed.every(b => b === 0)).toBe(true);
  });

  it('a native refusal mid-recovery: the handle is still closed, the store untouched, the seed zero-filled', async () => {
    const chain = fresh();
    ownDeposit(chain, 0n, 1n);
    fake.failNext('commitment', Object.assign(new Error('E_A0_INTERNAL: boom'), {code: 'E_A0_INTERNAL'}));
    const seed = seedBytes(TEST_SEED);
    await expect(restore(chain, seed)).rejects.toThrow('E_A0_INTERNAL');
    expect(callsOf('keysClose')).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(fake.liveHandle()).toBeNull();
    expect(mmkvSecure()!.getString(KEY)).toBeUndefined();
    expect(seed.every(b => b === 0)).toBe(true);
  });

  it('a sync that refuses: no key is opened at all, the seed is zero-filled', async () => {
    const chain = fresh();
    chain.account.value = null;
    const seed = seedBytes(TEST_SEED);
    await expect(restore(chain, seed)).rejects.toThrow('E_A0_TREE_MISSING');
    expect(callsOf('keysOpen')).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(seed.every(b => b === 0)).toBe(true);
  });

  it('without the encrypted store: refused before any request (E_A0_STORE_LOCKED), the seed zero-filled', async () => {
    clearAllStores();
    const {connection, requests} = recordedConnection(fresh());
    const seed = seedBytes(TEST_SEED);
    await expect(restoreA0FromSeed(connection, seed, {sync: {useCache: false}})).rejects.toMatchObject({code: 'E_A0_STORE_LOCKED'});
    expect(requests).toEqual([]);
    expect(callsOf('keysOpen')).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(seed.every(b => b === 0)).toBe(true);
  });

  it('into a store that already has a pending deposit and a higher counter: the deposit is confirmed, the counter kept', async () => {
    const chain = fresh();
    const d0 = ownDeposit(chain, 0n, 9n);
    // the deposit at 0 is pending in the store; counters 1..4 were used by deposits that never landed
    addA0PendingDeposit({commitment: d0.commitment, amount: 9n, rho: d0.rho, depositIndex: 0n, lastValidBlockHeight: 1});
    setA0NextDepositIndex(5n);
    const res = await restore(chain);
    expect(res.nextDepositIndex).toBe(1n);
    expect(loadA0NoteStore()).toEqual({
      nextDepositIndex: 5n,
      notes: [{commitment: d0.commitment, amount: 9n, rho: d0.rho, depositIndex: 0n, leafIndex: 17, status: 'unspent'}],
    });
  });

  it('an out-of-range answer from matchSpent is refused (E_A0_RECOVERY_NATIVE), the handle closed', async () => {
    const chain = fresh();
    ownDeposit(chain, 0n, 1n);
    const spy = jest.spyOn(fake, 'matchSpent').mockResolvedValueOnce([1]);
    const err = await restore(chain).catch((e: unknown) => e);
    spy.mockRestore();
    expect((err as A0RecoveryError).code).toBe('E_A0_RECOVERY_NATIVE');
    expect(fake.liveHandle()).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe('R13: the restore\'s cost is measured and kept', () => {
  it('returns and records the tree transaction count and the duration', async () => {
    const chain = fresh();
    ownDeposit(chain, 0n, 1n);
    appendWithdraw(chain, {nullifier: own.nullifier(own.rho(0n)), changeCommitment: strangerField(2)});
    const res = await restore(chain);
    expect(res.stats.treeTransactions).toBe(17);
    expect(res.stats.failedTransactions).toBe(0);
    expect(res.stats.fetchedTransactions).toBe(17);
    expect(res.stats.durationMs).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(res.stats.syncDurationMs);
    expect(res.stats.syncDurationMs).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);
    expect(res.stats.finishedAt).toMatch(/^\d{4}-\d\d-\d\dT\d\d:\d\d:\d\d\.\d{3}Z$/);
    expect(res.stats.r13TriggerReached).toBe(false);
    expect(loadA0LastRestoreStats()).toEqual(res.stats);
  });

  it('the trigger: more than 5,000 tree transactions, or more than 60 s', () => {
    expect(a0R13TriggerReached({treeTransactions: 5000, durationMs: 60_000})).toBe(false);
    expect(a0R13TriggerReached({treeTransactions: 5001, durationMs: 1})).toBe(true);
    expect(a0R13TriggerReached({treeTransactions: 1, durationMs: 60_001})).toBe(true);
  });
});
```

Create `src/modules/shielded/a0/__tests__/restoreRequests.test.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * I-3 (spec §14 JS, §7 "It makes no RPC request specific to one of our notes", §2 "Who sees what"):
 * a full restore from the seed makes ONLY the tree sync's requests — the same requests every
 * client makes — and no request names one of our notes.
 *
 * A recording Connection (the REAL web3.js Connection over recordedRpc.ts, which logs every
 * JSON-RPC method and its params) serves the recorded devnet history extended with the test
 * seed's own deposits and an unshield of one of them (ownHistory.ts). The assertions:
 *   1. the restore's request log is EXACTLY the log of a plain tree sync over the same chain;
 *   2. its methods are within getSignaturesForAddress(5URd…), getTransaction(<a listed pool tx>),
 *      getAccountInfo(5URd…) — stricter than §14's set, which also allows the registry's balance
 *      reads (M1b's restore makes none);
 *   3. no param, in any encoding (hex, base58, base64 of the 32 bytes), equals a commitment, rho,
 *      nullifier, rho-PDA or nullifier-PDA of the own notes.
 * POSITIVE controls: the same checker flags a restore variant that looks up one nullifier PDA, one
 * that lists one rho PDA's signatures, and one that filters accounts by one own commitment.
 */
jest.mock('@solana/web3.js', () =>
  jest.requireActual<typeof import('../__testing__/realWeb3')>('../__testing__/realWeb3').loadRealWeb3(),
);
jest.mock('react-native', () => ({
  NativeModules: {
    NocturaProver: jest.requireActual<typeof import('../__testing__/offlineA0')>('../__testing__/offlineA0').createFakeProverNative(),
  },
}));
import {readFileSync} from 'fs';
import {join} from 'path';
import {NativeModules} from 'react-native';
import {PublicKey} from '@solana/web3.js';
import type {Connection} from '@solana/web3.js';
import {base58} from '@scure/base';
import {clearAllStores, initSecureMmkv} from '../../../../store/mmkv/instances';
import {TEST_SEED, offlineKeys, seedBytes, strangerField} from '../__testing__/offlineA0';
import type {FakeProverNative} from '../__testing__/offlineA0';
import {appendDeposit, appendWithdraw, nullifierPda, rhoPda} from '../__testing__/ownHistory';
import {chainFrom, recordedConnection} from '../__testing__/recordedRpc';
import type {RecordedChain, RecordedFixture, RpcRequest} from '../__testing__/recordedRpc';
import {A0} from '../constants';
import {restoreA0FromSeed} from '../recovery';
import {syncA0Tree} from '../treeSync';

const TREE = JSON.parse(
  readFileSync(join(__dirname, 'fixtures/devnet-tree-5URd.json'), 'utf8'),
) as RecordedFixture;
const fake = NativeModules.NocturaProver as unknown as FakeProverNative;
const own = offlineKeys(TEST_SEED);

/** The recorded history + three own deposits (counters 0, 1, 2) + an unshield of the second. */
function chainWithOwnNotes(): {chain: RecordedChain; ownValues: Map<string, string>} {
  const chain = chainFrom(TREE);
  const notes = [0n, 1n, 2n].map(i => {
    const rho = own.rho(i);
    const commitment = own.commitment(10n + i, rho);
    appendDeposit(chain, {amount: 10n + i, rho, commitment});
    return {rho, commitment, nullifier: own.nullifier(rho)};
  });
  appendWithdraw(chain, {nullifier: notes[1]!.nullifier, changeCommitment: strangerField(9)});
  // every own value, in every encoding a param could carry it → its label
  const ownValues = new Map<string, string>();
  const add = (label: string, bytes: Uint8Array) => {
    ownValues.set(Buffer.from(bytes).toString('hex'), label);
    ownValues.set(base58.encode(bytes), label);
    ownValues.set(Buffer.from(bytes).toString('base64'), label);
  };
  notes.forEach((n, i) => {
    add(`rho[${i}]`, Buffer.from(n.rho, 'hex'));
    add(`commitment[${i}]`, Buffer.from(n.commitment, 'hex'));
    add(`nullifier[${i}]`, Buffer.from(n.nullifier, 'hex'));
    add(`rhoPda[${i}]`, new PublicKey(rhoPda(n.rho)).toBytes());
    add(`nullifierPda[${i}]`, new PublicKey(nullifierPda(n.nullifier)).toBytes());
  });
  return {chain, ownValues};
}

/** Every string anywhere inside a value. */
const stringsIn = (v: unknown): string[] =>
  typeof v === 'string'
    ? [v]
    : Array.isArray(v)
      ? v.flatMap(stringsIn)
      : v !== null && typeof v === 'object'
        ? Object.values(v as Record<string, unknown>).flatMap(stringsIn)
        : [];

/** The I-3 checker: every request outside the sync's set, and every param that names an own note. */
function noteSpecificRequests(requests: RpcRequest[], chain: RecordedChain, ownValues: Map<string, string>): string[] {
  const listed = new Set(chain.signatures.map(s => s.signature));
  const out: string[] = [];
  requests.forEach((r, i) => {
    const first = r.params[0];
    const allowed =
      ((r.method === 'getSignaturesForAddress' || r.method === 'getAccountInfo') && first === A0.merkleTree) ||
      (r.method === 'getTransaction' && typeof first === 'string' && listed.has(first));
    if (!allowed) {
      out.push(`#${i} ${r.method}(${String(first)}) is not one of the sync's requests`);
    }
    for (const s of stringsIn(r.params)) {
      for (const [value, label] of ownValues) {
        if (s.includes(value)) {
          out.push(`#${i} ${r.method} carries ${label}`);
        }
      }
    }
  });
  return out;
}

beforeEach(() => {
  clearAllStores();
  initSecureMmkv('test-key');
  fake.reset();
});

it('the fixture has own notes to leak: 3 deposits, 1 spent, 15 distinct own values × 3 encodings', async () => {
  const {chain, ownValues} = chainWithOwnNotes();
  expect(new Set(ownValues.values()).size).toBe(15);
  expect(ownValues.size).toBe(45);
  const res = await restoreA0FromSeed(recordedConnection(chain).connection, seedBytes(TEST_SEED), {sync: {useCache: false}});
  expect(res.notes.map(n => n.status)).toEqual(['unspent', 'spent', 'unspent']);
});

it('a full restore makes exactly the tree sync\'s requests, none of them note-specific', async () => {
  const {chain, ownValues} = chainWithOwnNotes();
  const rec = recordedConnection(chain);
  await restoreA0FromSeed(rec.connection, seedBytes(TEST_SEED), {sync: {useCache: false}});

  const plain = recordedConnection(chain);
  await syncA0Tree(plain.connection, {useCache: false});
  expect(rec.requests).toEqual(plain.requests);
  expect(rec.requests).toHaveLength(1 + 19 + 1);

  expect([...new Set(rec.requests.map(r => r.method))].sort()).toEqual([
    'getAccountInfo',
    'getSignaturesForAddress',
    'getTransaction',
  ]);
  expect(noteSpecificRequests(rec.requests, chain, ownValues)).toEqual([]);
});

describe('positive controls: the checker flags a restore that asks about one note', () => {
  const variant = async (lookUp: (c: Connection) => Promise<unknown>) => {
    const {chain, ownValues} = chainWithOwnNotes();
    const rec = recordedConnection(chain);
    await restoreA0FromSeed(rec.connection, seedBytes(TEST_SEED), {sync: {useCache: false}});
    await lookUp(rec.connection).catch(() => undefined);
    return noteSpecificRequests(rec.requests, chain, ownValues);
  };

  it('a lookup of one own nullifier PDA (the spent-check a restore must not make)', async () => {
    const pda = nullifierPda(own.nullifier(own.rho(0n)));
    expect(await variant(c => c.getAccountInfo(new PublicKey(pda)))).toEqual([
      `#21 getAccountInfo(${pda}) is not one of the sync's requests`,
      '#21 getAccountInfo carries nullifierPda[0]',
    ]);
  });

  it('a signature listing of one own rho PDA (the deposit-time pre-check, made at restore)', async () => {
    const pda = rhoPda(own.rho(2n));
    expect(await variant(c => c.getSignaturesForAddress(new PublicKey(pda), {limit: 1}))).toEqual([
      `#21 getSignaturesForAddress(${pda}) is not one of the sync's requests`,
      '#21 getSignaturesForAddress carries rhoPda[2]',
    ]);
  });

  it('an account filter on one own commitment', async () => {
    const cmBytes = Buffer.from(own.commitment(11n, own.rho(1n)), 'hex');
    const flagged = await variant(c =>
      c.getProgramAccounts(new PublicKey(A0.programId), {filters: [{memcmp: {offset: 8, bytes: base58.encode(cmBytes)}}]}),
    );
    expect(flagged).toEqual([
      `#21 getProgramAccounts(${A0.programId}) is not one of the sync's requests`,
      '#21 getProgramAccounts carries commitment[1]',
    ]);
  });
});
```

Create `src/modules/shielded/a0/noteStore.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * The A0 note store (spec §8): the wallet's own notes in the A0 pool, as PUBLIC or
 * spend-irrelevant fields only, and the monotone deposit counter.
 *
 * FIELDS — exactly §8's: `{commitment, amount, rho, depositIndex?, lastValidBlockHeight?,
 * leafIndex?, status: pending | unspent | spent, spentTx?, pendingSince?}`. No `noteSecret`, no
 * diversifier (every own note is under `d_self`, which stays in Rust, R9) and no nullifier of an
 * unspent note (R12) — there is no field to put one in, and a record carrying any other field
 * does not decode.
 *
 * METADATA (I-4) — `nextDepositIndex`, one counter per `nk`: it only ever increases. A pending
 * deposit takes exactly the current value and moves it on in the SAME storage write as the note
 * (§5 step 5); a dropped pending deposit does not hand it back (§5 step 7); a restore sets it to
 * the highest recovered index + 1 unless it is already higher.
 *
 * STORAGE — the encrypted instance (`mmkvSecure()`) only, one key (`v1_a0_notes`, schema 1),
 * bound to the A0 program and pool, beside the tree sync's cache. Every operation is one
 * synchronous read-modify-write of that one value, so a write is atomic (one `set`) and no other
 * JS can interleave with it. FAIL CLOSED: without the encrypted instance every call throws
 * `E_A0_STORE_LOCKED`, and a record that does not decode exactly throws `E_A0_STORE_CORRUPT` —
 * neither ever reads as "an empty store with counter 0", which would hand a used counter out
 * again. A corrupt record is replaced only by a recovery from the chain
 * (`mergeA0RecoveredNotes`), the source the store is a cache of (§7).
 *
 * THE v1 NOTES (§8 "Old notes", §12) — not migrated. The first A0 run (the first call that finds
 * no A0 record) removes every v1 note key (`v1_notes_<mint>`, the v1 `noteStore.ts` schema) from
 * the encrypted instance and then writes the empty A0 record, so it happens once: a later call
 * finds the record and touches nothing. Shielded runs only in the devnet build (R8), so only
 * the devnet build ever gets here.
 */
import {mmkvSecure} from '../../../store/mmkv/instances';
import {MMKV_KEYS} from '../../../constants/mmkvKeys';
import {A0} from './constants';
import {FIELD_MODULUS} from './fieldEquations';

export const A0_NOTE_STORE_SCHEMA = 1;

export type A0NoteStatus = 'pending' | 'unspent' | 'spent';

/** One own note (spec §8). 32-byte values are 64-char lowercase BE hex; amounts / counters BigInt. */
export interface A0Note {
  commitment: string;
  amount: bigint;
  rho: string;
  /** the deposit counter that made this note's rho (a deposit note) */
  depositIndex?: bigint;
  /** a PENDING DEPOSIT's expiry: dropped once the chain is past it with no rho PDA (§5 step 7) */
  lastValidBlockHeight?: number;
  leafIndex?: number;
  status: A0NoteStatus;
  /** the spending transaction, once known */
  spentTx?: string;
  /** a PENDING UNSHIELD's start, chain time (unix seconds) — M1c's */
  pendingSince?: number;
}

export interface A0NoteStoreState {
  nextDepositIndex: bigint;
  notes: A0Note[];
}

export type A0NoteStoreErrorCode =
  /** no encrypted instance (before onboarding / after a wipe) */
  | 'E_A0_STORE_LOCKED'
  /** the stored record does not decode exactly */
  | 'E_A0_STORE_CORRUPT'
  /** an attempt to lower nextDepositIndex */
  | 'E_A0_COUNTER_LOWER'
  /** a pending deposit whose counter is not nextDepositIndex */
  | 'E_A0_COUNTER_MISMATCH'
  /** a note or counter value out of its range or shape */
  | 'E_A0_NOTE_INVALID'
  /** a second note with the same rho or commitment */
  | 'E_A0_NOTE_DUPLICATE'
  /** no note with this rho */
  | 'E_A0_NOTE_UNKNOWN'
  /** the note is not in the state the call requires */
  | 'E_A0_NOTE_STATE';

export class A0NoteStoreError extends Error {
  readonly code: A0NoteStoreErrorCode;
  constructor(code: A0NoteStoreErrorCode, message: string) {
    super(`${code}: ${message}`);
    this.name = 'A0NoteStoreError';
    this.code = code;
  }
}

const KEY = MMKV_KEYS.A0_NOTES;
const V1_NOTES_PREFIX = MMKV_KEYS.SHIELDED_NOTES_PREFIX;
const U64_MAX = 2n ** 64n - 1n;
const HEX64 = /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/;
const B58_SIG = /^[1-9A-HJ-NP-Za-km-z]{64,88}$/;
const DEC = /^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$/;
/** 2^20 leaves (depth 20) */
const LEAF_LIMIT = 1_048_576;
const FIELDS = new Set([
  'commitment',
  'amount',
  'rho',
  'depositIndex',
  'lastValidBlockHeight',
  'leafIndex',
  'status',
  'spentTx',
  'pendingSince',
]);

const invalid = (what: string): never => {
  throw new A0NoteStoreError('E_A0_NOTE_INVALID', what);
};
const isNat = (v: unknown, limit = Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER): v is number =>
  typeof v === 'number' && Number.isSafeInteger(v) && v >= 0 && v < limit;
const field = (v: unknown, what: string): string =>
  typeof v === 'string' && HEX64.test(v) && BigInt(`0x${v}`) < FIELD_MODULUS ? v : invalid(`${what} is not a canonical 64-hex field element`);
const u64 = (v: unknown, what: string): bigint =>
  typeof v === 'bigint' && v >= 0n && v <= U64_MAX ? v : invalid(`${what} is not a u64`);

/** A copy of `n` with every field checked and the state rules of §5 / §8 held. */
function checkNote(n: A0Note): A0Note {
  for (const k of Object.keys(n)) {
    if (!FIELDS.has(k)) {
      invalid(`a note field "${k}" that §8 does not list`);
    }
  }
  const out: A0Note = {
    commitment: field(n.commitment, 'commitment'),
    amount: u64(n.amount, 'amount'),
    rho: field(n.rho, 'rho'),
    status: n.status,
  };
  if (n.status !== 'pending' && n.status !== 'unspent' && n.status !== 'spent') {
    invalid(`status ${String(n.status)}`);
  }
  if (n.depositIndex !== undefined) {
    out.depositIndex = u64(n.depositIndex, 'depositIndex');
  }
  if (n.leafIndex !== undefined) {
    out.leafIndex = isNat(n.leafIndex, LEAF_LIMIT) ? n.leafIndex : invalid('leafIndex');
  }
  if (n.lastValidBlockHeight !== undefined) {
    out.lastValidBlockHeight = isNat(n.lastValidBlockHeight) ? n.lastValidBlockHeight : invalid('lastValidBlockHeight');
  }
  if (n.pendingSince !== undefined) {
    out.pendingSince = isNat(n.pendingSince) ? n.pendingSince : invalid('pendingSince');
  }
  if (n.spentTx !== undefined) {
    out.spentTx = typeof n.spentTx === 'string' && B58_SIG.test(n.spentTx) ? n.spentTx : invalid('spentTx');
  }
  // state rules: a pending note is a pending deposit (lastValidBlockHeight, a counter, no leaf yet)
  // or a pending unshield (pendingSince, a leaf); unspent / spent notes have their leaf and no
  // pending-only field; only a spent note names its spending tx.
  if (out.status === 'pending') {
    const deposit = out.lastValidBlockHeight !== undefined;
    const unshield = out.pendingSince !== undefined;
    if (deposit === unshield) {
      invalid('a pending note is either a pending deposit (lastValidBlockHeight) or a pending unshield (pendingSince)');
    }
    if (deposit && (out.depositIndex === undefined || out.leafIndex !== undefined)) {
      invalid('a pending deposit has its counter and no leaf yet');
    }
    if (unshield && out.leafIndex === undefined) {
      invalid('a pending unshield spends a note with a leaf');
    }
  } else if (out.leafIndex === undefined || out.lastValidBlockHeight !== undefined || out.pendingSince !== undefined) {
    invalid(`an ${out.status} note has its leaf index and no pending-only field`);
  }
  if (out.spentTx !== undefined && out.status !== 'spent') {
    invalid('only a spent note names its spending transaction');
  }
  return out;
}

function checkUnique(notes: readonly A0Note[]): void {
  const rhos = new Set<string>();
  const cms = new Set<string>();
  for (const n of notes) {
    if (rhos.has(n.rho) || cms.has(n.commitment)) {
      throw new A0NoteStoreError('E_A0_NOTE_DUPLICATE', `a second note with rho ${n.rho} or commitment ${n.commitment}`);
    }
    rhos.add(n.rho);
    cms.add(n.commitment);
  }
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ the record

type Json = null | boolean | number | string | Json[] | {[k: string]: Json};

class Corrupt extends Error {}

const big = (v: Json | undefined): bigint => {
  if (typeof v !== 'string' || !DEC.test(v)) {
    throw new Corrupt('u64');
  }
  return BigInt(v);
};

function decodeNote(v: Json): A0Note {
  if (v === null || typeof v !== 'object' || Array.isArray(v)) {
    throw new Corrupt('note');
  }
  const n: Record<string, unknown> = {...v};
  for (const k of ['amount', 'depositIndex'] as const) {
    if (n[k] !== undefined) {
      n[k] = big(v[k]);
    }
  }
  try {
    return checkNote(n as unknown as A0Note);
  } catch (e) {
    throw new Corrupt(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'note');
  }
}

function encode(state: A0NoteStoreState): string {
  const notes = state.notes.map(n => {
    const o: Record<string, string | number> = {
      commitment: n.commitment,
      amount: n.amount.toString(),
      rho: n.rho,
    };
    if (n.depositIndex !== undefined) {
      o.depositIndex = n.depositIndex.toString();
    }
    if (n.lastValidBlockHeight !== undefined) {
      o.lastValidBlockHeight = n.lastValidBlockHeight;
    }
    if (n.leafIndex !== undefined) {
      o.leafIndex = n.leafIndex;
    }
    o.status = n.status;
    if (n.spentTx !== undefined) {
      o.spentTx = n.spentTx;
    }
    if (n.pendingSince !== undefined) {
      o.pendingSince = n.pendingSince;
    }
    return o;
  });
  return JSON.stringify({
    schema: A0_NOTE_STORE_SCHEMA,
    programId: A0.programId,
    pool: A0.pool,
    nextDepositIndex: state.nextDepositIndex.toString(),
    notes,
  });
}

function decode(raw: string): A0NoteStoreState {
  const o = JSON.parse(raw) as Json;
  if (o === null || typeof o !== 'object' || Array.isArray(o)) {
    throw new Corrupt('record');
  }
  const keys = Object.keys(o).sort().join(',');
  if (
    keys !== 'nextDepositIndex,notes,pool,programId,schema' ||
    o.schema !== A0_NOTE_STORE_SCHEMA ||
    o.programId !== A0.programId ||
    o.pool !== A0.pool ||
    !Array.isArray(o.notes)
  ) {
    throw new Corrupt('record header');
  }
  const next = big(o.nextDepositIndex);
  if (next > U64_MAX) {
    throw new Corrupt('nextDepositIndex');
  }
  const notes = o.notes.map(decodeNote);
  try {
    checkUnique(notes);
  } catch {
    throw new Corrupt('duplicate note');
  }
  return {nextDepositIndex: next, notes};
}

function storage() {
  const store = mmkvSecure();
  if (!store) {
    throw new A0NoteStoreError('E_A0_STORE_LOCKED', 'the encrypted store is not open');
  }
  return store;
}

/** The first A0 run: clear the v1 note schema, then write the empty A0 record (so: once). */
function firstRun(store: NonNullable<ReturnType<typeof mmkvSecure>>): A0NoteStoreState {
  for (const k of store.getAllKeys()) {
    if (k.startsWith(V1_NOTES_PREFIX)) {
      store.remove(k);
    }
  }
  const empty: A0NoteStoreState = {nextDepositIndex: 0n, notes: []};
  store.set(KEY, encode(empty));
  return empty;
}

function read(): A0NoteStoreState {
  const store = storage();
  const raw = store.getString(KEY);
  if (raw === undefined) {
    return firstRun(store);
  }
  try {
    return decode(raw);
  } catch {
    throw new A0NoteStoreError('E_A0_STORE_CORRUPT', `the ${KEY} record does not decode`);
  }
}

function write(state: A0NoteStoreState): void {
  storage().set(KEY, encode(state));
}

const bigMax = (a: bigint, b: bigint): bigint => (a > b ? a : b);

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ the API

/** The store (and, on the first A0 run, the v1 notes cleared). Throws LOCKED / CORRUPT. */
export function loadA0NoteStore(): A0NoteStoreState {
  return read();
}

/** The sum of the unspent notes' amounts. */
export function a0UnspentBalance(): bigint {
  return read().notes.reduce((s, n) => (n.status === 'unspent' ? s + n.amount : s), 0n);
}

/** Raise `nextDepositIndex` to `next`; refuses to lower it (equal is a no-op). §5 step 2. */
export function setA0NextDepositIndex(next: bigint): void {
  if (typeof next !== 'bigint' || next < 0n || next > U64_MAX) {
    invalid('nextDepositIndex is not a counter');
  }
  const s = read();
  if (next < s.nextDepositIndex) {
    throw new A0NoteStoreError('E_A0_COUNTER_LOWER', `nextDepositIndex ${s.nextDepositIndex} cannot go down to ${next}`);
  }
  if (next !== s.nextDepositIndex) {
    write({...s, nextDepositIndex: next});
  }
}

/**
 * §5 step 5: BEFORE submitting, the note as `pending` and `nextDepositIndex = depositIndex + 1`,
 * in ONE write. `depositIndex` must be exactly the current counter (lower would reuse a rho,
 * higher would leave a gap the recovery's gap limit counts).
 */
export function addA0PendingDeposit(d: {
  commitment: string;
  amount: bigint;
  rho: string;
  depositIndex: bigint;
  lastValidBlockHeight: number;
}): void {
  const note = checkNote({
    commitment: d.commitment,
    amount: d.amount,
    rho: d.rho,
    depositIndex: d.depositIndex,
    lastValidBlockHeight: d.lastValidBlockHeight,
    status: 'pending',
  });
  if (note.depositIndex === U64_MAX) {
    invalid('the deposit counter is exhausted');
  }
  const s = read();
  if (note.depositIndex !== s.nextDepositIndex) {
    throw new A0NoteStoreError(
      'E_A0_COUNTER_MISMATCH',
      `a pending deposit at counter ${note.depositIndex}, the store's next is ${s.nextDepositIndex}`,
    );
  }
  const notes = [...s.notes, note];
  checkUnique(notes);
  write({nextDepositIndex: s.nextDepositIndex + 1n, notes});
}

function indexOfRho(s: A0NoteStoreState, rho: string): number {
  const i = s.notes.findIndex(n => n.rho === rho);
  if (i < 0) {
    throw new A0NoteStoreError('E_A0_NOTE_UNKNOWN', `no note with rho ${rho}`);
  }
  return i;
}

const isPendingDeposit = (n: A0Note): boolean => n.status === 'pending' && n.lastValidBlockHeight !== undefined;

/** §5 step 6: a pending deposit becomes `unspent` at the leaf of its LeafInserted, whose commitment must be the note's. */
export function confirmA0Deposit(rho: string, leaf: {leafIndex: number; commitment: string}): void {
  const s = read();
  const i = indexOfRho(s, rho);
  const n = s.notes[i]!;
  if (!isPendingDeposit(n)) {
    throw new A0NoteStoreError('E_A0_NOTE_STATE', `the note with rho ${rho} is not a pending deposit`);
  }
  if (leaf.commitment !== n.commitment) {
    throw new A0NoteStoreError('E_A0_NOTE_STATE', `the LeafInserted commitment ${leaf.commitment} is not the note's ${n.commitment}`);
  }
  const confirmed: A0Note = {...n, leafIndex: leaf.leafIndex, status: 'unspent'};
  delete confirmed.lastValidBlockHeight; // only a pending deposit carries its expiry
  checkNote(confirmed);
  const notes = [...s.notes];
  notes[i] = confirmed;
  write({...s, notes});
}

/** §5 step 7: drop a pending deposit that can no longer land. The counter is NOT given back. */
export function dropA0PendingDeposit(rho: string): void {
  const s = read();
  const i = indexOfRho(s, rho);
  if (!isPendingDeposit(s.notes[i]!)) {
    throw new A0NoteStoreError('E_A0_NOTE_STATE', `the note with rho ${rho} is not a pending deposit`);
  }
  write({...s, notes: s.notes.filter((_n, j) => j !== i)});
}

/** The stored note vs the chain's view of the same rho (the rules of `mergeA0RecoveredNotes`). */
function merged(stored: A0Note, chain: A0Note): A0Note {
  if (stored.status === 'spent') {
    return stored; // spent is final: a note never becomes spendable again
  }
  if (chain.status === 'spent') {
    return chain;
  }
  if (stored.status === 'pending' && stored.pendingSince !== undefined) {
    return stored; // an unshield in flight: M1c's reconciliation decides, not a restore
  }
  return chain; // a pending deposit the chain has confirmed, or an unspent note re-read
}

/**
 * Write a recovery's result (§7: the store is a cache of the chain). Each recovered note is added,
 * or merged with the stored note of the same rho: spent stays spent; the chain's `spent` wins over
 * anything else; a pending unshield (`pendingSince`) is left for M1c; otherwise the chain's note
 * (`unspent`, with its leaf) replaces the stored one — that confirms a pending deposit that
 * landed. Stored notes the chain does not show are kept (a pending deposit is reconciled by §5
 * step 7, not here). `nextDepositIndex` becomes the higher of the two. A CORRUPT record is
 * replaced by the recovery alone (`replacedCorrupt: true`): its pending entries are lost, which
 * the deposit pre-check covers (a landed one is found by its rho PDA, §5 step 2). Atomic: one write.
 */
export function mergeA0RecoveredNotes(
  recovered: readonly A0Note[],
  nextDepositIndex: bigint,
): {replacedCorrupt: boolean} {
  const checked = recovered.map(checkNote);
  checkUnique(checked);
  if (typeof nextDepositIndex !== 'bigint' || nextDepositIndex < 0n || nextDepositIndex > U64_MAX) {
    invalid('nextDepositIndex is not a counter');
  }
  let base: A0NoteStoreState;
  let replacedCorrupt = false;
  try {
    base = read();
  } catch (e) {
    if (!(e instanceof A0NoteStoreError && e.code === 'E_A0_STORE_CORRUPT')) {
      throw e;
    }
    base = {nextDepositIndex: 0n, notes: []};
    replacedCorrupt = true;
  }
  const notes = [...base.notes];
  for (const r of checked) {
    const i = notes.findIndex(n => n.rho === r.rho);
    if (i < 0) {
      notes.push(r);
    } else {
      notes[i] = merged(notes[i]!, r);
    }
  }
  checkUnique(notes);
  write({nextDepositIndex: bigMax(base.nextDepositIndex, nextDepositIndex), notes});
  return {replacedCorrupt};
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Recovery of the A0 deposits from the seed (spec §7 "Deposits", R1, R12, R13).
 *
 * LOCAL MATCHING ONLY (I-3). Recovery reads the pool's whole history through the same tree sync
 * every client runs (`syncA0Tree`: one signature walk over 5URd…, one getTransaction per listed
 * pool tx, the tree account) and matches it here, on the device. It makes no other request: no
 * rho-PDA lookup, no nullifier-PDA lookup, no getTransaction of a signature it picked — so the RPC
 * provider sees the same requests from a restoring wallet as from any other (proved by
 * `__tests__/restoreRequests.test.ts` with a recording Connection, positive controls included).
 *
 * THE STEPS (§7 "Deposits"):
 *   1. the rho set: the `rho` argument of every `deposit` in the synced history. For
 *      i = 0, 1, 2, …: `depositRho(i)` (Rust) and look for it there; stop after 20 consecutive
 *      misses (deposits are sequential; a gap only comes from a failed or abandoned tx);
 *   2. each hit is read from its (already synced) creating tx: the amount from the instruction,
 *      the leaf index and commitment from that tx's LeafInserted whose commitment is the
 *      instruction's (matched by value, never by position), and Rust's `commitment(amount, rho)`
 *      must equal it. A hit that fails this check is NOT our note — somebody landed a deposit
 *      under our rho (possible only by copying it from our own deposit tx while it was in
 *      flight, a griefing front-run): it is not imported, but its counter is used, so
 *      `nextDepositIndex` passes it and it still resets the gap count;
 *   3. spent-status of every own note at once: ONE `matchSpent(handle, allSyncedWithdrawNullifiers,
 *      ownRhos)` (R12) — JS never computes or holds an own note's nullifier.
 * `nextDepositIndex` = the highest hit (own or not) + 1, or 0 when there is none (§8).
 *
 * CHANGE NOTES ARE M1c's. This module recovers deposit notes only. The recursion of §7 "Change
 * notes" (each spent note's spending tx → its `rho_change`, change amount and change leaf, then
 * again) is not built here: M1c adds it as a step of `restoreA0FromSeed` after
 * `recoverA0Deposits`, over the same `tree` and the same open handle, before the store write. Its
 * input is the spent deposit notes returned here. NOTE for M1c: `matchSpent` returns indices into
 * `ownRhos`, not WHICH nullifier matched; attributing a spent note to its spending tx needs a
 * further `matchSpent(handle, [n], spentRhos)` per synced Withdraw nullifier `n` (local calls, no
 * request) — that is also when `spentTx` gets filled; M1b leaves it unset.
 *
 * HANDLE LIFETIME (§3 m5): one handle per recovery run — `keysOpen` after the sync (the keys
 * are live only while matching), `keysClose` in a `finally`. The caller's seed is consumed:
 * zero-filled on every path, also when the sync fails before the keys are opened.
 */
import type {Connection} from '@solana/web3.js';
import {MMKV_KEYS} from '../../../constants/mmkvKeys';
import {mmkvSecure} from '../../../store/mmkv/instances';
import {
  a0Commitment,
  a0DepositRho,
  a0KeysClose,
  a0KeysOpen,
  a0MatchSpent,
} from '../../zkProver/nativeProverBridge';
import type {A0Handle} from '../../zkProver/nativeProverBridge';
import {A0NoteStoreError, mergeA0RecoveredNotes} from './noteStore';
import type {A0Note} from './noteStore';
import type {A0DepositRecord, A0SyncedTx} from './syncedTx';
import {syncA0Tree} from './treeSync';
import type {A0SyncOptions, A0VerifiedTree} from './treeSync';

/** Consecutive deposit counters without a hit after which the search stops (§7). */
export const A0_DEPOSIT_GAP_LIMIT = 20;

/** R13's indexer trigger: a restore past either makes a coordinator tree indexer a pre-mainnet item (§13). */
export const A0_R13_TRIGGER = {treeTransactions: 5000, durationMs: 60_000} as const;

export type A0RecoveryErrorCode =
  /** a deposit of the synced history whose tx has no LeafInserted of its commitment */
  | 'E_A0_RECOVERY_LEAF'
  /** two successful deposits with one rho (the rho PDA is `init`: the chain cannot hold that) */
  | 'E_A0_RECOVERY_DUPLICATE_RHO'
  /** the native core answered outside its contract (matchSpent indices) */
  | 'E_A0_RECOVERY_NATIVE';

export class A0RecoveryError extends Error {
  readonly code: A0RecoveryErrorCode;
  constructor(code: A0RecoveryErrorCode, message: string) {
    super(`${code}: ${message}`);
    this.name = 'A0RecoveryError';
    this.code = code;
  }
}

export interface A0DepositRecovery {
  /** own deposit notes, by counter; `unspent` or `spent`, each with its leaf index */
  notes: A0Note[];
  /** the highest hit (own or foreign) + 1, or 0 */
  nextDepositIndex: bigint;
  /** counters looked up with depositRho */
  indicesTried: number;
  /** hits whose commitment is not ours (not imported) */
  foreignRhoHits: number;
  /** deposits in the synced history, and its Withdraw nullifiers (distinct) */
  depositsInHistory: number;
  withdrawNullifiersInHistory: number;
}

interface Located {
  tx: A0SyncedTx;
  deposit: A0DepositRecord;
}

/**
 * Steps 1–3 over a verified tree with an open handle (no RPC). Task 4's deposit pre-check uses
 * this too, under its own handle, when a rho PDA turns out to exist (§5 step 2 "imports it
 * exactly as recovery does").
 */
export async function recoverA0Deposits(handle: A0Handle, tree: A0VerifiedTree): Promise<A0DepositRecovery> {
  const byRho = new Map<string, Located>();
  for (const tx of tree.txs) {
    for (const deposit of tx.deposits) {
      if (byRho.has(deposit.rho)) {
        throw new A0RecoveryError(
          'E_A0_RECOVERY_DUPLICATE_RHO',
          `rho ${deposit.rho} is deposited by ${byRho.get(deposit.rho)!.tx.signature} and ${tx.signature}`,
        );
      }
      byRho.set(deposit.rho, {tx, deposit});
    }
  }

  const notes: A0Note[] = [];
  let foreignRhoHits = 0;
  let highestHit = -1n;
  let misses = 0;
  let i = 0n;
  for (; misses < A0_DEPOSIT_GAP_LIMIT; i++) {
    const rho = await a0DepositRho(handle, i);
    const hit = byRho.get(rho);
    if (!hit) {
      misses++;
      continue;
    }
    misses = 0;
    highestHit = i;
    const leaves = hit.tx.leafInserted.filter(l => l.commitment === hit.deposit.commitment);
    if (leaves.length !== 1) {
      throw new A0RecoveryError(
        'E_A0_RECOVERY_LEAF',
        `${hit.tx.signature}: ${leaves.length} LeafInserted of the deposit's commitment ${hit.deposit.commitment}`,
      );
    }
    const ours = await a0Commitment(handle, hit.deposit.amount, rho);
    if (ours !== hit.deposit.commitment) {
      foreignRhoHits++;
      continue;
    }
    notes.push({
      commitment: hit.deposit.commitment,
      amount: hit.deposit.amount,
      rho,
      depositIndex: i,
      leafIndex: leaves[0]!.leafIndex,
      status: 'unspent',
    });
  }

  const nullifiers = [...new Set(tree.txs.flatMap(t => t.withdrawNullifiers))];
  if (notes.length > 0) {
    const spent = await a0MatchSpent(
      handle,
      nullifiers,
      notes.map(n => n.rho),
    );
    let prev = -1;
    for (const k of spent) {
      if (!Number.isInteger(k) || k <= prev || k >= notes.length) {
        throw new A0RecoveryError('E_A0_RECOVERY_NATIVE', `matchSpent answered ${JSON.stringify(spent)} for ${notes.length} notes`);
      }
      prev = k;
      notes[k]!.status = 'spent';
    }
  }

  return {
    notes,
    nextDepositIndex: highestHit + 1n,
    indicesTried: Number(i),
    foreignRhoHits,
    depositsInHistory: byRho.size,
    withdrawNullifiersInHistory: nullifiers.length,
  };
}

/** R13's counters of one restore, as the checkpoint reports them (§16 M1b). */
export interface A0RestoreStats {
  /** successful tree transactions in the verified history (R13's "tree transactions") */
  treeTransactions: number;
  failedTransactions: number;
  listedSignatures: number;
  /** getTransaction requests this run made */
  fetchedTransactions: number;
  /** the tree sync alone */
  syncDurationMs: number;
  /** the whole restore: sync, matching (native calls) and the store write — R13's "duration" */
  durationMs: number;
  depositIndicesTried: number;
  depositsInHistory: number;
  withdrawNullifiersInHistory: number;
  ownNotes: number;
  spentNotes: number;
  foreignRhoHits: number;
  /** UTC, ISO 8601 */
  finishedAt: string;
  /** R13: more than 5,000 tree transactions or more than 60 s */
  r13TriggerReached: boolean;
}

export interface A0RestoreResult {
  notes: A0Note[];
  nextDepositIndex: bigint;
  stats: A0RestoreStats;
}

export function a0R13TriggerReached(s: {treeTransactions: number; durationMs: number}): boolean {
  return s.treeTransactions > A0_R13_TRIGGER.treeTransactions || s.durationMs > A0_R13_TRIGGER.durationMs;
}

/**
 * A full restore (§7): sync the tree, recover the deposits under a fresh handle, merge them into
 * the note store, record R13's counters. `seed` (64 bytes) is consumed — zero-filled on every
 * path. Throws the sync's `A0SyncError`, an `A0RecoveryError`, the native core's `E_A0_…`
 * refusals, or the note store's `A0NoteStoreError` (e.g. `E_A0_STORE_LOCKED`); on any throw the
 * store is unchanged.
 */
export async function restoreA0FromSeed(
  connection: Connection,
  seed: Uint8Array,
  options: {sync?: A0SyncOptions} = {},
): Promise<A0RestoreResult> {
  const started = Date.now();
  try {
    if (!mmkvSecure()) {
      // before the walk, not after it: a restore that cannot keep its result does not start
      throw new A0NoteStoreError('E_A0_STORE_LOCKED', 'the encrypted store is not open');
    }
    const {tree, stats: sync} = await syncA0Tree(connection, options.sync);
    const handle = await a0KeysOpen(seed);
    let rec: A0DepositRecovery;
    try {
      rec = await recoverA0Deposits(handle, tree);
    } finally {
      await a0KeysClose(handle);
    }
    mergeA0RecoveredNotes(rec.notes, rec.nextDepositIndex);
    const durationMs = Date.now() - started;
    const stats: A0RestoreStats = {
      treeTransactions: sync.totalTransactions,
      failedTransactions: sync.failedTransactions,
      listedSignatures: sync.listedSignatures,
      fetchedTransactions: sync.fetchedTransactions,
      syncDurationMs: sync.durationMs,
      durationMs,
      depositIndicesTried: rec.indicesTried,
      depositsInHistory: rec.depositsInHistory,
      withdrawNullifiersInHistory: rec.withdrawNullifiersInHistory,
      ownNotes: rec.notes.length,
      spentNotes: rec.notes.filter(n => n.status === 'spent').length,
      foreignRhoHits: rec.foreignRhoHits,
      finishedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      r13TriggerReached: a0R13TriggerReached({treeTransactions: sync.totalTransactions, durationMs}),
    };
    mmkvSecure()?.set(MMKV_KEYS.A0_LAST_RESTORE, JSON.stringify(stats));
    return {notes: rec.notes, nextDepositIndex: rec.nextDepositIndex, stats};
  } finally {
    seed.fill(0);
  }
}

/** The last restore's R13 counters (encrypted instance), or null. */
export function loadA0LastRestoreStats(): A0RestoreStats | null {
  const raw = mmkvSecure()?.getString(MMKV_KEYS.A0_LAST_RESTORE);
  if (!raw) {
    return null;
  }
  try {
    return JSON.parse(raw) as A0RestoreStats;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}
```
