```ts
/**
 * The A0 proving-key files as the app obtains them (spec §1 "A0 proving keys", R4): downloaded
 * from the content-addressed route, verified by sha256 before every use, cached on disk.
 *
 * TWO PINS, ON PURPOSE. Rust pins the same four files by sha256 AND length
 * (`native/noctura-prover/src/a0/keyfiles.rs`) and refuses any other bytes whatever JS hands it —
 * that is the control (a pin living only in the layer being attacked would not be one). The JS
 * pins below exist so the app downloads the right bytes and never hands native a file it has not
 * itself checked; `keyAssets.test.ts` reads `keyfiles.rs` and fails when the two disagree.
 *
 * NO HOSTED PROVING. The prover is the on-device Rust core (`a0Prove`); `/zk/prove` answers 410
 * (§1) and nothing here or in the deposit flow sends a witness anywhere.
 *
 * The URL is DERIVED from the digest (`/h/<sha256>/a0/<file>`), so a URL that disagrees with its
 * pin cannot be written down here, and the mutable `/a0/zkey-manifest.json` pointer is never
 * consulted at run time: pins fetched at run time would let a compromised host choose the zkey.
 */
import {ensurePinnedAssets, type AssetIO} from '../../zkProver/provingAssets';
import type {CircuitAssets, PinnedAsset} from '../../../constants/provingAssets';
import type {A0Circuit} from '../../zkProver/nativeProverBridge';

const BASE = 'https://api.noc-tura.io/api/v1/zk-assets';

const at = (sha256: string, file: string): PinnedAsset => ({
  url: `${BASE}/h/${sha256}/a0/${file}`,
  sha256,
});

/** circuitSetVersion `devnet-a0-1` — single-party dev keys, devnet only (§1). */
export const A0_KEY_ASSETS: Readonly<Record<A0Circuit, CircuitAssets>> = {
  deposit: {
    zkey: at('fef08f0217a44c8c1629f5f8d670047461205c1fced83d7ea6fe763420e53fe9', 'deposit_final.zkey'),
    wasm: at('1d69d7f89792a31d4c7780afa52b2f11707a4347f61382e7b294f4848d7dfff1', 'deposit.wasm'),
  },
  withdraw_change: {
    zkey: at('ec55bdbbbfedb9823a57e5a3131c457a259fe8a690c087b82ad8b7efd3d756f2', 'withdraw_change_final.zkey'),
    wasm: at('01b0ec1f28dec05e712b2fa0524c7b212409abf330b3380119d8e64d9845e0b9', 'withdraw_change.wasm'),
  },
};

/** The circuit's public-input count (the zkey's nPublic, §14 m-5): deposit 4, withdraw_change 7. */
export const A0_NPUBLIC: Readonly<Record<A0Circuit, number>> = {deposit: 4, withdraw_change: 7};

/**
 * Local paths of the circuit's zkey and wasm, each re-verified against its pin on this call
 * (downloaded first when missing; a mismatch deletes the file and throws). The cache files are
 * keyed `a0-<circuit>` (`noctura-a0-deposit.zkey`, …) so they never collide with the v1 set's `noctura-deposit.zkey`.
 */
export function ensureA0KeyFiles(
  circuit: A0Circuit,
  io: AssetIO,
): Promise<{zkeyPath: string; wasmPath: string}> {
  return ensurePinnedAssets(`a0-${circuit}`, A0_KEY_ASSETS[circuit], io);
}
```

Create `src/modules/shielded/a0/depositFlow.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * The A0 deposit (spec §5 steps 2–7): shield `amount` of the pool's mint from the main transparent
 * account into an own note, and reconcile a deposit the app did not see land.
 *
 * THE SHAPE FOLLOWS THE SCREENS (#16 → #18 → #19 → #20 → #21, wired in Task 6):
 *   - `prepareA0Deposit` (#18, its stages reported through `onStage`) — steps 2–4: the counter and
 *     the rho-PDA pre-check, Rust's commitment, the on-device proof and the public-input compare.
 *     It writes NOTHING to the store except what a pre-check hit imports (step 2), and nothing at
 *     all when the proof's public inputs disagree;
 *   - `simulateA0Deposit` (#19) — the exact instructions, simulated on chain (which runs the
 *     program's proof verification without paying) and inspected by `checkInstructions`;
 *   - `submitA0Deposit` (#21, after #20's re-auth) — step 5 (the pending note + counter in ONE write,
 *     BEFORE the send), the send, the existing polling confirm (`pollConfirmation`), step 6 (the
 *     note becomes `unspent` at the leaf of its synced `LeafInserted`);
 *   - `reconcileA0PendingDeposits` (startup, `a0/startup.ts`) — step 7.
 *
 * WHAT THE RPC SEES (§2 "Who sees what"). A deposit is public by nature: its signer, amount and
 * rho are on chain once it lands. The requests this module makes beyond the sync everyone runs:
 *   - the pre-check `getAccountInfo(PDA(["rho", rho(i)]))` — the ONE lookup of an own value; it
 *     names our NEXT rho before it is public (step 2 needs it: a counter whose PDA exists would
 *     make a paid, rejected tx). The RPC can link that lookup to the deposit that follows from the
 *     same address moments later — it sees that deposit's submission anyway;
 *   - the depositor's token accounts, the latest blockhash, the simulation, the send and the
 *     signature-status polls of our own tx (what any transparent send does);
 *   - at startup, the same PDA lookup for each PENDING deposit — a rho that was broadcast (public
 *     on chain if it landed), and the block height.
 * The note's leaf is read from the tree sync (`syncA0Tree`), never from a `getTransaction` of our
 * own signature (Task 2's rule, §6.8).
 *
 * NO HOSTED PROVING, NO AUTHORIZATION. The proof is made by the Rust core with the pinned A0 key
 * files (`keyAssets.ts`); no witness leaves the device. A deposit needs no native confirmation:
 * the circuit binds the note to the user's own `nk`, so a deposit cannot pay anyone else (§5.5).
 *
 * THE TRANSACTION: [ComputeBudget.setComputeUnitLimit(200,000), deposit] in a LEGACY message
 * signed by the depositor alone (the fee payer) — the format of the landed deposit `3DR6F7oW…`,
 * whose whole signed message our builder reproduces byte for byte (`depositTx.golden.test.ts`).
 */
import {
  ComputeBudgetProgram,
  Keypair,
  PublicKey,
  Transaction,
  VersionedTransaction,
} from '@solana/web3.js';
import type {Commitment, Connection, TransactionInstruction} from '@solana/web3.js';
import {base58} from '@scure/base';
import {A0, A0_CU} from './constants';
import {a0RhoMarkerPda, buildA0DepositIx} from './depositIx';
import {FIELD_MODULUS, toBe32Hex} from './fieldEquations';
import {ensureA0KeyFiles, A0_NPUBLIC} from './keyAssets';
import {
  addA0PendingDeposit,
  confirmA0Deposit,
  dropA0PendingDeposit,
  hasA0NoteRecord,
  loadA0NoteStore,
  mergeA0RecoveredNotes,
} from './noteStore';
import type {A0Note} from './noteStore';
import {recoverA0Deposits} from './recovery';
import {syncA0Tree} from './treeSync';
import type {A0SyncOptions, A0VerifiedTree} from './treeSync';
import {
  a0Commitment,
  a0DepositRho,
  a0KeysClose,
  a0KeysOpen,
  a0Prove,
  isProverSupported,
} from '../../zkProver/nativeProverBridge';
import type {A0Handle} from '../../zkProver/nativeProverBridge';
import type {AssetIO} from '../../zkProver/provingAssets';
import {rnfsAssetIO} from '../../zkProver/rnfsAssetIO';
import {deriveTransparentKeypair} from '../../keyDerivation/transparent';
import {loadTransparentScheme} from '../../keyDerivation/derivationScheme';
import {resolveSourceTokenAccount} from '../../solana/transactionBuilder';
import {simulateTransaction} from '../../solana/simulation';
import {checkInstructions} from '../../solana/instructionChecks';
import type {TransferCheck} from '../../solana/simulationChecks';
import type {SimulationResult} from '../../solana/types';
import {pollConfirmation} from '../../solana/signAndSend';
import {zeroize} from '../../session/zeroize';

const U64_MAX = 2n ** 64n - 1n;
const PROOF_HEX = /^[0-9a-f]{512}$/;

/** How many pre-check hits one deposit follows before refusing (each costs a tree sync). */
export const A0_PRECHECK_MAX_HITS = 4;

/** `mintHash = be_mod_r(mint)` of the pool's mint (§1 public inputs), 64 lowercase hex. */
export const A0_MINT_HASH: string = toBe32Hex(
  BigInt(`0x${Buffer.from(base58.decode(A0.mint)).toString('hex')}`) % FIELD_MODULUS,
);

export type A0DepositErrorCode =
  /** the amount is not 1..2^64-1 base units */
  | 'E_A0_DEPOSIT_AMOUNT'
  /** the Rust prover is not available on this device (non-arm64, production build) */
  | 'E_A0_DEPOSIT_UNSUPPORTED'
  /** the RPC is not devnet (genesis hash) */
  | 'E_A0_DEPOSIT_CLUSTER'
  /** no A0 record yet: the startup restore has not run (a deposit before it could skip a note) */
  | 'E_A0_DEPOSIT_NOT_READY'
  /** the depositor holds no token account of the pool's mint */
  | 'E_A0_DEPOSIT_NO_TOKEN_ACCOUNT'
  /** a rho PDA exists but the synced history does not show its deposit yet (RPC lag): retry later */
  | 'E_A0_DEPOSIT_PRECHECK_UNSYNCED'
  /** the synced deposit of a found rho lies past the restore's gap limit: recovery did not reach it */
  | 'E_A0_DEPOSIT_PRECHECK_GAP'
  /** more than A0_PRECHECK_MAX_HITS consecutive hits */
  | 'E_A0_DEPOSIT_PRECHECK_LIMIT'
  /** the proof's public inputs are not [commitment, amount, mintHash, rho] as computed here */
  | 'E_A0_DEPOSIT_PUBLIC_INPUTS'
  /** the proof is not 256 bytes of lowercase hex */
  | 'E_A0_DEPOSIT_PROOF_SHAPE'
  /** the seed handed to submit is not the depositor's */
  | 'E_A0_DEPOSIT_SIGNER'
  /** the synced history shows a found deposit without its LeafInserted, or one rho twice */
  | 'E_A0_DEPOSIT_LEAF';

export class A0DepositError extends Error {
  readonly code: A0DepositErrorCode;
  constructor(code: A0DepositErrorCode, message: string) {
    super(`${code}: ${message}`);
    this.name = 'A0DepositError';
    this.code = code;
  }
}

/** #18's stages, in order (a hit repeats `precheck`). */
export type A0PrepareStage = 'checking' | 'keyFiles' | 'precheck' | 'commitment' | 'proving' | 'verifying';
/** #21's stages, in order. */
export type A0SubmitStage = 'signing' | 'recorded' | 'submitted' | 'confirming' | 'settling';

export interface A0PreparedDeposit {
  readonly amount: bigint;
  readonly depositIndex: bigint;
  /** 64 lowercase hex: rho(depositIndex), Rust's */
  readonly rho: string;
  /** 64 lowercase hex: Rust's commitment(amount, rho) = the proof's public input [0] */
  readonly commitment: string;
  /** 256 bytes */
  readonly proof: Uint8Array;
  /** base58: the main transparent account (signer and fee payer) */
  readonly depositor: string;
  /** base58: its token account of the pool's mint holding the largest balance */
  readonly depositorTokenAccount: string;
  /** own notes the pre-check imported (step 2) and foreign hits it moved past */
  readonly importedNotes: number;
  readonly foreignRhoHits: number;
}

export interface A0PrepareOptions {
  io?: AssetIO;
  sync?: A0SyncOptions;
  onStage?: (stage: A0PrepareStage) => void;
}

const bytesOfHex = (h: string): Uint8Array => Uint8Array.from(Buffer.from(h, 'hex'));

/** `PDA(["rho", rho])` exists AS A POOL ACCOUNT. A system-owned account at that address (lamports
 *  someone sent there) is not a rho marker: Anchor's `init` takes a pre-funded address. */
async function rhoMarkerExists(connection: Connection, rho: string, commitment: Commitment): Promise<boolean> {
  const info = await connection.getAccountInfo(a0RhoMarkerPda(bytesOfHex(rho)), commitment);
  return info !== null && info.owner.toBase58() === A0.programId;
}

async function assertDevnet(connection: Connection): Promise<void> {
  const genesis = await connection.getGenesisHash();
  if (genesis !== A0.genesisHash) {
    throw new A0DepositError('E_A0_DEPOSIT_CLUSTER', `the RPC's genesis hash is ${genesis}, not devnet's`);
  }
}

/** The main account's public key from `seed` (the secret key is wiped before returning). */
function depositorOf(seed: Uint8Array): PublicKey {
  const {publicKey, secretKey} = deriveTransparentKeypair(seed, loadTransparentScheme());
  zeroize(secretKey);
  return new PublicKey(publicKey);
}

/**
 * Step 2: the counter and the pre-check. Returns the first counter whose rho PDA is absent. A
 * present one is imported "exactly as recovery does" (the ledger's ruling (1)): one sync, then
 * `recoverA0Deposits` under this handle — own notes (Rust's commitment matches) are merged into
 * the store, a FOREIGN hit (somebody's deposit under our public rho, commitment not ours) is NOT
 * imported and never thrown on — either way the counter moves past it — then the next counter is
 * checked.
 */
async function precheck(
  connection: Connection,
  handle: A0Handle,
  options: A0PrepareOptions,
): Promise<{depositIndex: bigint; rho: string; importedNotes: number; foreignRhoHits: number}> {
  let importedNotes = 0;
  let foreignRhoHits = 0;
  for (let hits = 0; ; hits++) {
    options.onStage?.('precheck');
    const depositIndex = loadA0NoteStore().nextDepositIndex;
    const rho = await a0DepositRho(handle, depositIndex);
    if (!(await rhoMarkerExists(connection, rho, 'confirmed'))) {
      return {depositIndex, rho, importedNotes, foreignRhoHits};
    }
    if (hits >= A0_PRECHECK_MAX_HITS) {
      throw new A0DepositError('E_A0_DEPOSIT_PRECHECK_LIMIT', `${hits + 1} consecutive rho PDAs exist`);
    }
    const {tree} = await syncA0Tree(connection, options.sync);
    if (!tree.txs.some(t => t.deposits.some(d => d.rho === rho))) {
      throw new A0DepositError(
        'E_A0_DEPOSIT_PRECHECK_UNSYNCED',
        `counter ${depositIndex}: its rho PDA exists, the synced history does not show its deposit yet`,
      );
    }
    const rec = await recoverA0Deposits(handle, tree);
    if (rec.nextDepositIndex <= depositIndex) {
      throw new A0DepositError(
        'E_A0_DEPOSIT_PRECHECK_GAP',
        `counter ${depositIndex} is past recovery's gap limit (recovered next = ${rec.nextDepositIndex})`,
      );
    }
    const before = new Set(loadA0NoteStore().notes.map(n => n.rho));
    mergeA0RecoveredNotes(rec.notes, rec.nextDepositIndex);
    importedNotes += rec.notes.filter(n => !before.has(n.rho)).length;
    foreignRhoHits = rec.foreignRhoHits;
  }
}

/**
 * Steps 2–4 (#18). `seed` (64 bytes) is CONSUMED — zero-filled on every path. Refuses before any
 * key is opened when the amount, the build, the cluster, the store or the token account is wrong.
 */
export async function prepareA0Deposit(
  connection: Connection,
  seed: Uint8Array,
  amount: bigint,
  options: A0PrepareOptions = {},
): Promise<A0PreparedDeposit> {
  try {
    options.onStage?.('checking');
    if (typeof amount !== 'bigint' || amount < 1n || amount > U64_MAX) {
      throw new A0DepositError('E_A0_DEPOSIT_AMOUNT', `amount ${String(amount)} is not 1..2^64-1 base units`);
    }
    if (!isProverSupported()) {
      throw new A0DepositError('E_A0_DEPOSIT_UNSUPPORTED', 'the on-device prover is not available');
    }
    if (!hasA0NoteRecord()) {
      throw new A0DepositError('E_A0_DEPOSIT_NOT_READY', 'no A0 note record yet: the startup restore has not run');
    }
    loadA0NoteStore(); // CORRUPT throws here, before any request
    await assertDevnet(connection);
    const depositor = depositorOf(seed);
    const tokenAccount = await resolveSourceTokenAccount(connection, depositor, new PublicKey(A0.mint), amount);
    if (!tokenAccount) {
      throw new A0DepositError('E_A0_DEPOSIT_NO_TOKEN_ACCOUNT', `${depositor.toBase58()} holds no ${A0.mint} account`);
    }
    options.onStage?.('keyFiles');
    const {zkeyPath, wasmPath} = await ensureA0KeyFiles('deposit', options.io ?? rnfsAssetIO);

    const handle = await a0KeysOpen(seed);
    try {
      const pre = await precheck(connection, handle, options);
      options.onStage?.('commitment');
      const commitment = await a0Commitment(handle, amount, pre.rho);
      options.onStage?.('proving');
      const witness = JSON.stringify({amount: amount.toString(), depositIndex: pre.depositIndex.toString()});
      const proof = await a0Prove(handle, 'deposit', witness, null, zkeyPath, wasmPath);
      options.onStage?.('verifying');
      // Step 4: the circuit's Poseidon against Rust's, and the rest against values computed here.
      const expected = [commitment, toBe32Hex(amount), A0_MINT_HASH, pre.rho];
      const names = ['commitment', 'amount', 'mintHash', 'rho'];
      if (proof.publicInputs.length !== A0_NPUBLIC.deposit) {
        throw new A0DepositError(
          'E_A0_DEPOSIT_PUBLIC_INPUTS',
          `${proof.publicInputs.length} public inputs, the deposit circuit has ${A0_NPUBLIC.deposit}`,
        );
      }
      expected.forEach((v, k) => {
        if (proof.publicInputs[k] !== v) {
          throw new A0DepositError('E_A0_DEPOSIT_PUBLIC_INPUTS', `public input ${k} (${names[k]}) is not this deposit's`);
        }
      });
      if (!PROOF_HEX.test(proof.proofBytes)) {
        throw new A0DepositError('E_A0_DEPOSIT_PROOF_SHAPE', 'the proof is not 256 bytes of lowercase hex');
      }
      return {
        amount,
        depositIndex: pre.depositIndex,
        rho: pre.rho,
        commitment,
        proof: bytesOfHex(proof.proofBytes),
        depositor: depositor.toBase58(),
        depositorTokenAccount: tokenAccount.toBase58(),
        importedNotes: pre.importedNotes,
        foreignRhoHits: pre.foreignRhoHits,
      };
    } finally {
      await a0KeysClose(handle);
    }
  } finally {
    seed.fill(0);
  }
}

/** The deposit's two instructions: [setComputeUnitLimit(units), deposit]. */
function a0DepositInstructions(p: A0PreparedDeposit, units: number): TransactionInstruction[] {
  return [
    ComputeBudgetProgram.setComputeUnitLimit({units}),
    buildA0DepositIx(
      {amount: p.amount, commitment: bytesOfHex(p.commitment), rho: bytesOfHex(p.rho), proof: p.proof},
      {depositor: new PublicKey(p.depositor), depositorTokenAccount: new PublicKey(p.depositorTokenAccount)},
    ),
  ];
}

/**
 * The unsigned deposit tx (legacy message, payer = depositor) over `blockhash`, with the CU limit
 * `units` — A0_CU.deposit (200,000) in the app; the golden test passes the landed tx's own limit
 * (1,400,000) to rebuild its message. Compiled by
 * `Transaction#compileMessage` — the compiler (and so the account order) of the landed deposit
 * `3DR6F7oW…`, whose message this reproduces byte for byte. (`TransactionMessage
 * #compileToLegacyMessage` orders the accounts differently: a valid tx, but not the shape the tree
 * sync's parser was proven on.)
 */
export function buildA0DepositTransaction(
  p: A0PreparedDeposit,
  blockhash: string,
  units: number = A0_CU.deposit,
): VersionedTransaction {
  const message = new Transaction({feePayer: new PublicKey(p.depositor), recentBlockhash: blockhash})
    .add(...a0DepositInstructions(p, units))
    .compileMessage();
  return new VersionedTransaction(message);
}

/** The instructions as the risk rows inspect them, read back from the compiled message. */
function inspectable(tx: VersionedTransaction): {programId: string; data: Uint8Array}[] {
  const keys = tx.message.staticAccountKeys;
  return tx.message.compiledInstructions.map(i => ({
    programId: keys[i.programIdIndex]?.toBase58() ?? '',
    data: Uint8Array.from(i.data),
  }));
}

/** #19: simulate the exact deposit (unsigned; the chain verifies the proof in the simulation) and
 *  derive the contract / approval rows from its compiled instructions. */
export async function simulateA0Deposit(
  connection: Connection,
  p: A0PreparedDeposit,
): Promise<{simulation: SimulationResult; checks: TransferCheck[]}> {
  const {blockhash} = await connection.getLatestBlockhash('confirmed');
  const tx = buildA0DepositTransaction(p, blockhash);
  const simulation = await simulateTransaction(connection, tx);
  return {simulation, checks: checkInstructions(inspectable(tx))};
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ steps 5–7

/** What the synced history says about a pending deposit's rho. */
type Settled =
  | {kind: 'ours'; signature: string; leafIndex: number; root: string}
  | {kind: 'foreign'; signature: string}
  | {kind: 'absent'};

/**
 * Our pending note against the synced history: the deposit carrying its rho is OURS when its
 * commitment and amount are the note's (Rust computed that commitment for this amount and rho —
 * the ruling's `commitment(amount, rho)` check), whatever its signature (an exact copy of our
 * instruction landed by someone else pays into our note). Any other deposit with that rho is
 * foreign (our tx failed at the rho PDA's `init`).
 */
function settle(tree: A0VerifiedTree, note: Pick<A0Note, 'rho' | 'commitment' | 'amount'>): Settled {
  const hits = tree.txs.flatMap(t => t.deposits.filter(d => d.rho === note.rho).map(d => ({t, d})));
  if (hits.length === 0) {
    return {kind: 'absent'};
  }
  if (hits.length > 1) {
    throw new A0DepositError('E_A0_DEPOSIT_LEAF', `rho ${note.rho} is deposited ${hits.length} times`);
  }
  const {t, d} = hits[0]!;
  if (d.commitment !== note.commitment || d.amount !== note.amount) {
    return {kind: 'foreign', signature: t.signature};
  }
  const leaves = t.leafInserted.filter(l => l.commitment === note.commitment);
  if (leaves.length !== 1) {
    throw new A0DepositError('E_A0_DEPOSIT_LEAF', `${t.signature}: ${leaves.length} LeafInserted of ${note.commitment}`);
  }
  return {kind: 'ours', signature: t.signature, leafIndex: leaves[0]!.leafIndex, root: leaves[0]!.root};
}

export type A0DepositOutcome =
  | {status: 'unspent'; signature: string; leafIndex: number; root: string}
  /** the note stays `pending`; the startup reconciliation decides it (§5 step 7) */
  | {status: 'pending'; signature: string; reason: 'send-failed' | 'not-confirmed' | 'not-in-sync'; detail?: string}
  /** our tx did not land: a foreign deposit holds our rho; the pending note was dropped (counter kept) */
  | {status: 'dropped'; signature: string; reason: 'foreign'; foreignSignature: string};

export interface A0SubmitOptions {
  sync?: A0SyncOptions;
  /** sync rounds after the confirmation before leaving the note pending (default 3) */
  settleAttempts?: number;
  /** pause between them (default 1500 ms) */
  settleDelayMs?: number;
  onStage?: (stage: A0SubmitStage, signature?: string) => void;
}

const sleep = (ms: number): Promise<void> => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms));

/**
 * Steps 5–6 (#21). `seed` is CONSUMED (the depositor's key is derived from it, checked against
 * the prepared depositor, and wiped). The pending note and `nextDepositIndex = i + 1` are ONE store
 * write made BEFORE the send — a refusal there (another deposit took the counter) sends nothing.
 * After the send nothing throws on the chain's behalf: an unconfirmed or unsynced deposit stays
 * `pending` for the startup reconciliation, the single authority on pending deposits.
 */
export async function submitA0Deposit(
  connection: Connection,
  p: A0PreparedDeposit,
  seed: Uint8Array,
  options: A0SubmitOptions = {},
): Promise<A0DepositOutcome> {
  options.onStage?.('signing');
  let secretKey: Uint8Array | null = null;
  let tx: VersionedTransaction;
  let lastValidBlockHeight: number;
  try {
    secretKey = deriveTransparentKeypair(seed, loadTransparentScheme()).secretKey;
    const signer = Keypair.fromSecretKey(secretKey);
    if (signer.publicKey.toBase58() !== p.depositor) {
      throw new A0DepositError('E_A0_DEPOSIT_SIGNER', `the seed's main account is not the depositor ${p.depositor}`);
    }
    const latest = await connection.getLatestBlockhash('confirmed');
    lastValidBlockHeight = latest.lastValidBlockHeight;
    tx = buildA0DepositTransaction(p, latest.blockhash);
    tx.sign([signer]);
  } finally {
    seed.fill(0);
    zeroize(secretKey);
  }
  const signature = base58.encode(tx.signatures[0]!);

  // Step 5: pending before submitting, counter in the same write.
  addA0PendingDeposit({
    commitment: p.commitment,
    amount: p.amount,
    rho: p.rho,
    depositIndex: p.depositIndex,
    lastValidBlockHeight,
  });
  options.onStage?.('recorded', signature);

  try {
    // preflight ON: the RPC simulates once more and refuses before forwarding a failing deposit
    // (its fee would be paid on chain even when it fails).
    await connection.sendRawTransaction(tx.serialize(), {skipPreflight: false, preflightCommitment: 'confirmed'});
  } catch (e) {
    return {status: 'pending', signature, reason: 'send-failed', detail: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)};
  }
  options.onStage?.('submitted', signature);

  try {
    options.onStage?.('confirming', signature);
    await pollConfirmation(connection, signature, lastValidBlockHeight);
  } catch (e) {
    return {status: 'pending', signature, reason: 'not-confirmed', detail: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)};
  }

  // Step 6: the leaf from the synced history (never a getTransaction of our own signature).
  options.onStage?.('settling', signature);
  const attempts = options.settleAttempts ?? 3;
  for (let k = 0; k < attempts; k++) {
    if (k > 0) {
      await sleep(options.settleDelayMs ?? 1500);
    }
    const {tree} = await syncA0Tree(connection, options.sync);
    const s = settle(tree, p);
    if (s.kind === 'ours') {
      confirmA0Deposit(p.rho, {leafIndex: s.leafIndex, commitment: p.commitment});
      return {status: 'unspent', signature, leafIndex: s.leafIndex, root: s.root};
    }
    if (s.kind === 'foreign') {
      dropA0PendingDeposit(p.rho);
      return {status: 'dropped', signature, reason: 'foreign', foreignSignature: s.signature};
    }
  }
  return {status: 'pending', signature, reason: 'not-in-sync'};
}

export interface A0ReconcileReport {
  confirmed: {rho: string; leafIndex: number; signature: string}[];
  dropped: {rho: string; reason: 'expired' | 'foreign'}[];
  stillPending: {rho: string; reason: 'not-expired' | 'not-in-sync'}[];
}

/**
 * Step 7, at startup: every pending DEPOSIT (a pending unshield is M1c's) by its rho PDA —
 *   - present (a pool account, `confirmed`) → its deposit from the synced history: ours →
 *     `unspent` at its leaf; foreign → dropped (our tx failed at `init`); not synced yet → kept;
 *   - absent → dropped only once the FINALIZED block height is past the note's
 *     `lastValidBlockHeight` AND a `finalized` read of the PDA, made after that height was seen,
 *     is still absent: a tx can only land in a block at or below its lastValidBlockHeight, and
 *     every block up to a finalized height is final, so the drop is exact; otherwise kept.
 * `nextDepositIndex` is never lowered (the store refuses it; a drop keeps the counter used).
 * No pending deposit → no request at all.
 */
export async function reconcileA0PendingDeposits(
  connection: Connection,
  options: {sync?: A0SyncOptions} = {},
): Promise<A0ReconcileReport> {
  const report: A0ReconcileReport = {confirmed: [], dropped: [], stillPending: []};
  const pending = loadA0NoteStore().notes.filter(n => n.status === 'pending' && n.lastValidBlockHeight !== undefined);
  let tree: A0VerifiedTree | null = null;
  let finalizedHeight: number | null = null;
  for (const n of pending) {
    if (await rhoMarkerExists(connection, n.rho, 'confirmed')) {
      tree ??= (await syncA0Tree(connection, options.sync)).tree;
      const s = settle(tree, n);
      if (s.kind === 'ours') {
        confirmA0Deposit(n.rho, {leafIndex: s.leafIndex, commitment: n.commitment});
        report.confirmed.push({rho: n.rho, leafIndex: s.leafIndex, signature: s.signature});
      } else if (s.kind === 'foreign') {
        dropA0PendingDeposit(n.rho);
        report.dropped.push({rho: n.rho, reason: 'foreign'});
      } else {
        report.stillPending.push({rho: n.rho, reason: 'not-in-sync'});
      }
      continue;
    }
    finalizedHeight ??= await connection.getBlockHeight('finalized');
    if (finalizedHeight <= n.lastValidBlockHeight!) {
      report.stillPending.push({rho: n.rho, reason: 'not-expired'});
      continue;
    }
    if (await rhoMarkerExists(connection, n.rho, 'finalized')) {
      // landed between the two reads: the next start finds it present
      report.stillPending.push({rho: n.rho, reason: 'not-in-sync'});
      continue;
    }
    dropA0PendingDeposit(n.rho);
    report.dropped.push({rho: n.rho, reason: 'expired'});
  }
  return report;
}
```

Create `src/modules/shielded/a0/startup.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * The A0 startup step (the ledger's ruling (2); spec §7 "the note store and the registry become
 * caches", §5 step 7). Once per app session, after the encrypted store is open and the seed is in
 * hand (unlock / onboarding, `secureStorageSession.ts`):
 *   1. NO `v1_a0_notes` record (a fresh install, an import, a wiped app) — or a record that does
 *      not decode — → `restoreA0FromSeed`: the notes come back from the chain. A missing record is
 *      asked with `hasA0NoteRecord()` BEFORE anything reads the store, because the store's first
 *      read writes an empty record (its one-time v1 clear) and an empty record would read as "no
 *      notes" from then on. A restore that fails writes nothing, so the next start restores again;
 *   2. the pending deposits are reconciled (`reconcileA0PendingDeposits`).
 *
 * THE SHIELDED BALANCE IS SHOWN ONLY AFTER THIS (Task 6): `a0StartupState().phase === 'ready'`.
 * Before it (`running`) the balance is unknown, and an `error` is shown as such — never as 0.
 */
import type {Connection} from '@solana/web3.js';
import {A0NoteStoreError, hasA0NoteRecord, loadA0NoteStore} from './noteStore';
import {restoreA0FromSeed} from './recovery';
import type {A0RestoreStats} from './recovery';
import {reconcileA0PendingDeposits} from './depositFlow';
import type {A0ReconcileReport} from './depositFlow';
import type {A0SyncOptions} from './treeSync';

export interface A0StartupResult {
  /** why a restore ran, or null when the record existed and decoded */
  restoredBecause: 'no-record' | 'corrupt-record' | null;
  restore: A0RestoreStats | null;
  reconcile: A0ReconcileReport;
}

export type A0StartupState =
  | {phase: 'idle'}
  | {phase: 'running'}
  | {phase: 'ready'; result: A0StartupResult}
  | {phase: 'error'; code: string | null; message: string};

/**
 * Steps 1–2. `seed` (64 bytes) is CONSUMED: handed to the restore when one runs, zero-filled
 * otherwise (and in any case on return). Throws `E_A0_STORE_LOCKED` before any request without
 * the encrypted instance; the restore's and the reconciliation's errors pass through.
 */
export async function runA0Startup(
  connection: Connection,
  seed: Uint8Array,
  options: {sync?: A0SyncOptions} = {},
): Promise<A0StartupResult> {
  try {
    let restoredBecause: A0StartupResult['restoredBecause'] = null;
    if (!hasA0NoteRecord()) {
      restoredBecause = 'no-record';
    } else {
      try {
        loadA0NoteStore();
      } catch (e) {
        if (!(e instanceof A0NoteStoreError && e.code === 'E_A0_STORE_CORRUPT')) {
          throw e;
        }
        restoredBecause = 'corrupt-record'; // only a recovery replaces it (noteStore)
      }
    }
    const restore = restoredBecause ? (await restoreA0FromSeed(connection, seed, options)).stats : null;
    const reconcile = await reconcileA0PendingDeposits(connection, options);
    return {restoredBecause, restore, reconcile};
  } finally {
    seed.fill(0);
  }
}

let state: A0StartupState = {phase: 'idle'};
let inFlight: Promise<A0StartupState> | null = null;
const listeners = new Set<(s: A0StartupState) => void>();

function setState(s: A0StartupState): void {
  state = s;
  for (const l of listeners) {
    l(s);
  }
}

/** The session's startup state (for the shielded balance, Task 6). */
export function a0StartupState(): A0StartupState {
  return state;
}

/** Subscribe to state changes; returns the unsubscribe. */
export function subscribeA0Startup(listener: (s: A0StartupState) => void): () => void {
  listeners.add(listener);
  return () => {
    listeners.delete(listener);
  };
}

/**
 * Run the startup step once per session; never rejects (fire-and-forget callers). A call while
 * one runs, or after it succeeded, wipes its `seed` and returns that run's state; a call after a
 * FAILED run tries again (a restore that failed wrote nothing).
 */
export function ensureA0Startup(
  connection: Connection,
  seed: Uint8Array,
  options: {sync?: A0SyncOptions} = {},
): Promise<A0StartupState> {
  if (inFlight || state.phase === 'ready') {
    seed.fill(0);
    return inFlight ?? Promise.resolve(state);
  }
  setState({phase: 'running'});
  inFlight = runA0Startup(connection, seed, options).then(
    result => {
      setState({phase: 'ready', result});
      inFlight = null;
      return state;
    },
    (e: unknown) => {
      const code = typeof (e as {code?: unknown})?.code === 'string' ? (e as {code: string}).code : null;
      setState({phase: 'error', code, message: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)});
      inFlight = null;
      return state;
    },
  );
  return inFlight;
}

/** TEST-ONLY reset of the session state. */
export function resetA0StartupForTests(): void {
  state = {phase: 'idle'};
  inFlight = null;
  listeners.clear();
}
```

#### Notes for the executor (Task 4)

- **The rulings this task took (each the most secure default; the owner may overturn any):**
  - **The flow is three calls, shaped by the screens** (`prepareA0Deposit` for #18, `simulateA0Deposit` for #19, `submitA0Deposit` for #21 after #20's re-auth), not one call: the proof must exist before #19 (the simulation then runs the program's own proof verification without paying), and the transparent confirmation flow reads the seed again at #21 — so does `submitA0Deposit`. Each call consumes its own seed copy. Cost if wrong: Task 6 wraps them into one.
  - **The existing confirmation flow is the existing modules, not the existing screens.** #19–#21 (`TxSimulateScreen`, `TxConfirmScreen`, `TransactionStatusScreen`) are built around a `TransferIntent` and rebuild a transfer from it; a deposit is not a transfer. This task uses what those screens use — `simulateTransaction`, `checkInstructions` (with `FeGSS…` added), the keychain read, the polling confirm — and leaves the screens to Task 6 (no screens here). **Said loudly: until Task 6, nothing in the UI calls the A0 deposit** — the v1 `DepositScreen` / `ZkProofScreen` still call the v1 `depositShield`, which since M1a's `E_V1_REMOVED` refuses; no conflict, the two files are different (`shielded/depositFlow.ts` v1, `shielded/a0/depositFlow.ts` A0).
  - **The key files' paths:** the app downloads them from the content-addressed route through the existing `AssetIO` / `rnfsAssetIO` (`ensurePinnedAssets`, factored out of `ensureCircuitAssets`), verifies the sha256 against JS pins, and hands the paths to Rust, which verifies sha256 + length again (R4 — the control). The JS pins sit in `a0/keyAssets.ts` (not in the v1 `constants/provingAssets.ts`, which Task 5 deletes) and a test reads `keyfiles.rs` so the two cannot drift. The manifest URL is never fetched at run time (pins fetched at run time would let the host choose the key). Cache files `noctura-a0-deposit.*` never collide with v1's `noctura-deposit.*`. Never hosted proving: the only prover is `a0Prove`.
  - **A cluster check before anything else costs a request:** `getGenesisHash` must be devnet's (`EtWTRABZ…`), else `E_A0_DEPOSIT_CLUSTER`. Task 2's "no genesis request" was about the restore (I-3: its requests equal the sync's); the deposit is not the restore, and a deposit signed against the wrong cluster's blockhash is the failure this prevents. Cost: one request per deposit.
  - **A rho PDA is "present" only as a POOL account** (owner `FeGSS…`). Anyone can send lamports to the PDA address, which makes a system-owned account there; Anchor's `init` takes such a pre-funded address, so it does not block our deposit, and treating it as a hit would let a 0.0009-SOL transfer push the counter. If that reading of Anchor is wrong, the deposit fails at #19's simulation, not on chain.
  - **The pre-check imports through `recoverA0Deposits`** (ruling (1)): one sync, the full recovery under the deposit's handle, `mergeA0RecoveredNotes`, then the next counter. It refuses rather than guess in two cases: the PDA exists but the synced history does not list its deposit (`E_A0_DEPOSIT_PRECHECK_UNSYNCED` — RPC lag; retry), and the deposit is listed but recovery's gap limit did not reach it (`E_A0_DEPOSIT_PRECHECK_GAP` — 20+ burnt counters in a row; skipping would hide a note, importing outside recovery would be a second recovery). More than 4 consecutive hits → `E_A0_DEPOSIT_PRECHECK_LIMIT`. A deposit refuses before the startup step has created the record (`E_A0_DEPOSIT_NOT_READY`): its first store read would write an empty record and the restore would never run.
  - **One attempt per pending note.** `signAndSend` re-signs with a new blockhash on expiry; a deposit must not — each new blockhash has another `lastValidBlockHeight`, and the stored one must be the last attempt's or the startup reconciliation could drop a note whose second attempt is still landing. One blockhash, one pending write, one send; expiry leaves the note pending for the reconciliation, which drops it exactly. Preflight is ON (`skipPreflight: false`): the RPC simulates again and refuses a failing deposit before it costs a fee; a refused send leaves the note pending too (whether an RPC forwarded a tx it reports as failed is not knowable) — the reconciliation is the single authority on pending deposits.
  - **The legacy message, compiled by `Transaction#compileMessage`.** That compiler orders the accounts as the landed `3DR6F7oW…` does (sorted within each signer/writable class); `TransactionMessage#compileToLegacyMessage` orders them by insertion — a valid tx, but not the one Task 1's golden and Task 2's parser were proven on (M31 shows the golden sees the difference). A v0 message is not used (Task 2: v0/ALT parsing untested on real data).
  - **The leaf, by rho then commitment, from the sync** (never a `getTransaction` of our signature): the deposit carrying our rho is ours iff its commitment AND amount are the pending note's (Rust computed that commitment for this amount and rho — the ruling's `commitment(amount, rho)`); then its `LeafInserted` of that commitment. The signature is not required to be ours: an exact copy of our instruction landed by someone else pays into our note. A deposit with our rho and another commitment is foreign: our tx failed at `init`; the pending note is dropped, the counter kept. A confirmed tx the sync does not list yet stays `pending` (3 sync rounds 1.5 s apart, then the startup decides).
  - **The drop is decided on finalized reads only:** the finalized block height must be PAST the note's `lastValidBlockHeight`, and a `finalized` read of the PDA made after that height was seen must be absent. A tx can only land in a block at height ≤ its `lastValidBlockHeight`; every block up to a finalized height is final; so the absence is final. A `confirmed` height past expiry is not enough (a confirmed block can still be rolled back). Cost: a not-landed deposit is dropped ~13 s later than a confirmed-height rule would.
  - **The restore caller (ruling (2))** is `runA0Startup`: no record → restore; a record that does not decode → restore (Task 3: only a recovery replaces a corrupt record; its pending entries are lost, which the pre-check covers); `E_A0_STORE_LOCKED` → error, no request. It asks `hasA0NoteRecord()` (added to the store: a read that never writes) BEFORE any `loadA0NoteStore()`, whose first call writes the empty record. A failed restore writes nothing, so the next start restores again. `ensureA0Startup` runs it once per session, never rejects, and keeps `a0StartupState()` for the balance.
  - **Where it starts:** `secureStorageSession.ts`, right after the encrypted store is opened, at unlock (`unlockSecureStorage`) and onboarding (`unlockSecureStorageWithSeed`, i.e. create AND import) — the two places the seed is already in hand, so no second biometric prompt — with its own copy of the seed (the restore consumes it), and only when `isShieldedEnabled()` and `isProverSupported()` (the devnet build on arm64; the production build never runs it). It runs in the background; the balance waits for it.
- **Measured facts:** in Jest, a full deposit over the recorded history (prepare + simulate + submit + one settle sync) takes ~300–400 ms (the fake's Poseidon in JS, the chain a fixture); the request log of the happy path is exactly the methods `getGenesisHash, getTokenAccountsByOwner, getAccountInfo (rho PDA, then the tree), getLatestBlockhash, sendTransaction, getSignatureStatuses, getSignaturesForAddress, getTransaction` (16 getTransaction = the 15 recorded + ours, all from the tree listing); the only own-value lookup is `getAccountInfo(PDA(["rho", rho(0)]))`. Web3.js 1.99.0 omits `skipPreflight` from the request when it is false (the RPC's default is to preflight) — the test asserts `{encoding: 'base64', preflightCommitment: 'confirmed'}`. 1,400,000 = `0x155cc0` → the landed limit bytes `c0 5c 15 00`; 200,000 → `40 0d 03 00`.
- **Deviations from the brief:** none in scope. The brief's "the instruction through the existing #19→#20→#21 confirmation flow" is met by the modules the flow uses; the screens are Task 6's (above). "Startup reconciliation" also needed a caller — it runs inside the same startup step as the restore (ruling (2)), so there is one startup hook, not two.
- **What the next tasks must know:** Interfaces → "What later tasks rely on". Also: (1) the startup step adds the A0 modules to `secureStorageSession.ts`'s imports in EVERY build (the call is gated, the import is not) — the production APK of Task 7's checkpoint must launch (the libc++ lesson: a new import on the unlock path is a launch risk worth one look); (2) `liveDevnet.ts` lands a sent deposit by splicing OUR message into a clone of `3DR6F7oW…` with its meta remapped to our key order and the token amounts set to ours — the logs, CU figures and inner-instruction data stay the template's; a suite that checks those must not lean on it; (3) the devnet phone's first unlock after this task runs a full restore (no A0 record yet) — expected, and it is the R13 measurement Task 7 records anyway.
- **Stated limits (written as tests where they are behaviour, here where they are not):**
  - Two devices with one seed depositing at the same counter with DIFFERENT amounts: the one that lands is ours but differs from the other's pending note (amount), so the other device drops its pending as "foreign" and does not import the landed note — a restore finds it. M1 is one device per seed; the pre-check does not have this limit (it runs recovery, which asks Rust).
  - A deposit made through a CPI into `FeGSS…` is invisible to the sync (Task 2's limit), so a pre-check hit on it refuses `E_A0_DEPOSIT_PRECHECK_UNSYNCED` for that counter until the program side answers §15's CPI question.
  - The startup state is per process (module memory); a background restore that the OS kills is simply run again at the next start (no record yet).
  - The fake devnet's "kill" makes every later request hang, the way a dead process makes none; it does not model a process that dies between the pending write and the send (the note is then pending with a tx that never existed — the reconciliation drops it after expiry, the same path as "not landed", tested).

#### Spec rev 3.3 lines (Task 4)
- §5 step 2: "present → this is one of our own notes" — present means a rho-marker account OWNED BY THE POOL PROGRAM (a system-owned account at the address is lamports someone sent, not a marker); a present marker is imported only when Rust's `commitment(amount, rho)` equals the synced deposit's (ruling (1), Task 3's line), otherwise it is foreign: not imported, never thrown on, the counter moved past it. A marker whose deposit the synced history does not show yet refuses the deposit for now (RPC lag), never a guess.
- §5 step 2 (new): a deposit refuses until the startup step has written the A0 record (a deposit's first store read would write an empty record, and the restore of ruling (2) keys on the record's absence).
- §5 step 4: the comparison also checks the count (exactly 4 public inputs) and the proof's shape (256 bytes); "`rho` with `depositRho(i)`" uses the `depositRho(i)` value the pre-check took for this counter, under the same handle.
- §5 step 5: one blockhash, one pending write, one send — no re-sign on expiry (each new blockhash would carry another `lastValidBlockHeight`); preflight on; the tx is a legacy message `[setComputeUnitLimit(200,000), deposit]` signed by the depositor alone, compiled with the landed deposit's account order; before anything, the RPC's genesis hash must be devnet's.
- §5 step 6: the leaf is read from the tree sync (the `SyncedTx` whose deposit carries the note's rho, commitment and amount — not necessarily our signature), never from a `getTransaction` of our own signature; a confirmed deposit the sync does not list yet stays `pending`.
- §5 step 7: "the chain's block height past the deposit's `lastValidBlockHeight`" is the FINALIZED height, and "absent" is a `finalized` read made after that height was seen; a present marker whose deposit is foreign drops the pending note (counter kept); the step runs together with ruling (2)'s restore in one startup step (unlock and onboarding, devnet build with the native prover), whose state gates the shielded balance.
- §2 "Who sees what": the RPC also sees, at startup, the rho-PDA lookup of every pending deposit (a rho already broadcast) and the finalized block height.

**The rule, stated once.** A deposit is carried through the design's #18 → #19 → #20 → #21 by an opaque id, never by a transaction: the proof and the accounts stay in memory (`screenSupport`'s holder), #18 is the only screen that makes one (from the stages `prepareA0Deposit` reports — nothing timed), #21 is the only screen that sends one and it takes it out of the holder first, so a re-render, a second mount, a back-and-forward or a forged route sends nothing twice. Everything the screens say about money is BigInt and comes from the chain or the store (the SOL costs from the landed deposit's own balances); everything they say about privacy says who signs and what is public. A screen that cannot know the shielded balance yet says why and offers Retry; it never shows 0 and never spins forever. A screen that is hidden has no route.

- [ ] **Step 1: The design, rendered (never read as text).**

`/home/user/Downloads/index.html` contains the TGE date: it is never opened or grepped as text. Its screens are rendered to images by a script that only screenshots elements by id (the mockups are `#s16`, `#s18`, `#s19`, `#s20`, `#s21`, each a row of `.phone` elements; the ids were listed by counting `.phone` per id, no text read) and the images are read:

```js
// scratchpad/node_modules/m1b-t5-shot.mjs  (run from a directory where @playwright/test resolves)
import {chromium} from '@playwright/test';
const out = process.argv[2];
const b = await chromium.launch();
const p = await b.newPage({viewport: {width: 1600, height: 1200}});
await p.route(/^https?:\/\//, r => r.abort());
await p.goto('file:///home/user/Downloads/index.html');
for (const id of ['s16', 's18', 's19', 's20', 's21']) {
  const phones = p.locator(`#${id} .phone`);
  const n = await phones.count();
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) await phones.nth(i).screenshot({path: `${out}/${id}-${i}.png`});
  console.log(id, n);
}
await b.close();
```

Create `src/modules/shielded/a0/__tests__/poolSize.test.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * The pool's note count from the MerkleTree account, read from the committed devnet fixture
 * (Task 2's `devnet-tree-5URd.json`, slot 522620135). The expected count is the fixture's own
 * bytes 8..16 read as u64 LE by Node's Buffer — not by the code under test — and equals the 17
 * leaves Task 2 recorded.
 */
import {readFileSync} from 'fs';
import {join} from 'path';
import type {Connection} from '@solana/web3.js';
import {readA0PoolNoteCount} from '../poolSize';
import {A0} from '../constants';

jest.mock('@solana/web3.js', () =>
  jest.requireActual<typeof import('../__testing__/realWeb3')>('../__testing__/realWeb3').loadRealWeb3(),
);
const {PublicKey} = jest.requireMock<typeof import('@solana/web3.js')>('@solana/web3.js');

const fixture = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(__dirname, 'fixtures/devnet-tree-5URd.json'), 'utf8')) as {
  account: {value: {data: [string, string]; owner: string}};
};
const DATA = Buffer.from(fixture.account.value.data[0], 'base64');

function fakeConnection(answer: {data: Uint8Array; owner: string} | null | 'throw') {
  const calls: {key: string; commitment: unknown}[] = [];
  const connection = {
    getAccountInfo: async (key: {toBase58: () => string}, commitment: unknown) => {
      calls.push({key: key.toBase58(), commitment});
      if (answer === 'throw') throw new Error('fetch failed');
      return answer && {data: Buffer.from(answer.data), owner: new PublicKey(answer.owner), lamports: 1, executable: false};
    },
  } as unknown as Connection;
  return {connection, calls};
}

it('reads the tree account 5URd… once and returns nextLeafIndex (= 17 in the fixture, read independently)', async () => {
  const independent = Number(DATA.readBigUInt64LE(8));
  expect(independent).toBe(17);
  const {connection, calls} = fakeConnection({data: DATA, owner: fixture.account.value.owner});
  expect(await readA0PoolNoteCount(connection)).toEqual({status: 'ok', count: independent});
  expect(calls).toEqual([{key: A0.merkleTree, commitment: 'confirmed'}]);
});

it('an account not owned by the pool program is "unavailable" (nobody else can write a tree there)', async () => {
  const {connection} = fakeConnection({data: DATA, owner: '11111111111111111111111111111111'});
  expect(await readA0PoolNoteCount(connection)).toEqual({status: 'unavailable'});
});

it('no account / an RPC failure is "unavailable"', async () => {
  expect(await readA0PoolNoteCount(fakeConnection(null).connection)).toEqual({status: 'unavailable'});
  expect(await readA0PoolNoteCount(fakeConnection('throw').connection)).toEqual({status: 'unavailable'});
});

it('a wrong layout is "incompatible", with the reason', async () => {
  const short = fakeConnection({data: DATA.subarray(0, 3000), owner: A0.programId});
  const r = await readA0PoolNoteCount(short.connection);
  expect(r.status).toBe('incompatible');
  expect(r.status === 'incompatible' && r.reason).toMatch(/E_A0_TREE_LAYOUT/);
});
```

Create `src/app/__tests__/shieldedRoutes.test.tsx`:

```tsx
/**
 * Route-level gating of the shielded screens (spec §12 "Hidden until its plan lands"; M1b screens
 * task). Between M1b and M1c, #16's unshield side and the shielded transfer are HIDDEN — not a
 * hidden button: no route is registered for them, so neither `navigate(name)` nor a deep link can
 * reach them. This suite renders the REAL RootNavigator (only the splash is stubbed) and reads the
 * registered route names, and resolves the real deep-link config with React Navigation's own
 * `getStateFromPath`.
 */
import React from 'react';
import {render, act} from '@testing-library/react-native';
import {NavigationContainer, createNavigationContainerRef, getStateFromPath} from '@react-navigation/native';
import {RootNavigator} from '../Navigator';
import type {LinkingOptions} from '@react-navigation/native';

jest.mock('../../screens/SplashScreen', () => ({SplashScreen: () => null}));

type Flags = {shielded: boolean; shieldedTransfer: boolean};
let mockFlags: Flags = {shielded: false, shieldedTransfer: false};
jest.mock('../../constants/features', () => {
  const actual = jest.requireActual('../../constants/features');
  return {
    ...actual,
    isShieldedEnabled: () => mockFlags.shielded,
    isShieldedTransferEnabled: () => mockFlags.shielded && mockFlags.shieldedTransfer,
  };
});

/** The shield flow M1b registers in the devnet build. */
const SHIELD_FLOW = ['ShieldedExplainer', 'ShieldUnshieldModal', 'ZkProofModal', 'ShieldSimulate', 'ShieldConfirm', 'ShieldStatus'];
/** Hidden until M1c (and the v1 screens they replaced). */
const HIDDEN = ['ShieldedTransfer', 'ShieldedBalance', 'Deposit', 'Withdraw'];

/** The deep-link config is built at import: load it under `f` in a fresh registry. */
function loadLinks(f: Flags): typeof import('../deepLinkConfig') {
  mockFlags = f;
  let links: typeof import('../deepLinkConfig') | null = null;
  jest.isolateModules(() => {
    links = require('../deepLinkConfig');
  });
  return links!;
}

/** RootNavigator reads the flags while rendering: render it under `f`. */
function routeNames(f: Flags): {names: string[]; ref: ReturnType<typeof createNavigationContainerRef>} {
  mockFlags = f;
  const ref = createNavigationContainerRef();
  render(
    <NavigationContainer ref={ref}>
      <RootNavigator />
    </NavigationContainer>,
  );
  return {names: (ref.getRootState()?.routeNames ?? []) as string[], ref};
}

describe('shielded routes (route-level gating)', () => {
  it('devnet build (shielded on): the shield flow is registered; the unshield side and the transfer are not — even with SHIELDED_TRANSFER=true', () => {
    const {names} = routeNames({shielded: true, shieldedTransfer: true});
    expect(names).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining(SHIELD_FLOW));
    for (const h of HIDDEN) {
      expect(names).not.toContain(h);
    }
  });

  it('production build (shielded off): no shielded route at all (positive control: the core routes are there)', () => {
    const {names} = routeNames({shielded: false, shieldedTransfer: false});
    expect(names).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining(['MainTabs', 'SendModal', 'ReceiveModal']));
    for (const r of [...SHIELD_FLOW, ...HIDDEN]) {
      expect(names).not.toContain(r);
    }
  });

  it('navigating to a hidden route by name goes nowhere (the route does not exist); a shield route does', () => {
    const {ref} = routeNames({shielded: true, shieldedTransfer: true});
    const err = jest.spyOn(console, 'error').mockImplementation(() => {});
    const before = ref.getRootState()?.routes.map(r => r.name);
    act(() => {
      (ref.navigate as (n: string, p?: object) => void)('ShieldedTransfer', {});
    });
    expect(ref.getRootState()?.routes.map(r => r.name)).toEqual(before);
    // positive control: a registered shield route IS reachable by name, under the same render
    act(() => {
      (ref.navigate as (n: string, p?: object) => void)('ShieldUnshieldModal', {direction: 'private'});
    });
    expect(ref.getRootState()?.routes.map(r => r.name)).toEqual([...(before ?? []), 'ShieldUnshieldModal']);
    err.mockRestore();
  });
});

describe('shielded deep links', () => {
  const resolve = (f: Flags, path: string): string[] => {
    const links = loadLinks(f);
    const state = getStateFromPath(path, (links.deepLinkConfig as LinkingOptions<object>).config);
    const names: string[] = [];
    const walk = (s: {routes: {name: string; state?: unknown}[]} | undefined) =>
      s?.routes.forEach(r => {
        names.push(r.name);
        walk(r.state as {routes: {name: string; state?: unknown}[]} | undefined);
      });
    walk(state as {routes: {name: string; state?: unknown}[]} | undefined);
    return names;
  };

  it('devnet: noctura://deposit opens #16 (the shield side); withdraw / transfer reach no shielded screen', () => {
    expect(resolve({shielded: true, shieldedTransfer: true}, 'deposit')).toEqual(['ShieldUnshieldModal']);
    for (const p of ['withdraw', 'transfer', 'unshield']) {
      const names = resolve({shielded: true, shieldedTransfer: true}, p);
      for (const r of [...SHIELD_FLOW, ...HIDDEN]) {
        expect(names).not.toContain(r);
      }
    }
  });

  it('devnet: the config has no entry for a hidden screen', () => {
    const links = loadLinks({shielded: true, shieldedTransfer: true});
    const screens = (links.deepLinkConfig.config as {screens: Record<string, unknown>}).screens;
    for (const h of HIDDEN) {
      expect(screens[h]).toBeUndefined();
    }
    expect(screens.ShieldUnshieldModal).toBe('deposit');
  });

  it('production: deposit is not a shielded link', () => {
    expect(resolve({shielded: false, shieldedTransfer: false}, 'deposit')).not.toContain('ShieldUnshieldModal');
  });
});

```

```tsx
});
afterEach(() => jest.restoreAllMocks());

const CHECKS = [
  {status: 'ok', title: 'Known programs only', meta: 'ComputeBudget · FeGSS… shielded pool'},
  {status: 'ok', title: 'No token approvals granted', meta: 'no Approve instruction'},
];

describe('#19 ShieldSimulate', () => {
  it('simulates the HELD deposit; ready: the public-deposit row, the risk rows, the balance delta, Continue', async () => {
    const id = holdPreparedA0Deposit(PREPARED);
    mockSimulate.mockResolvedValue({simulation: {success: true, unitsConsumed: 142287}, checks: CHECKS});
    const onContinue = jest.fn();
    const r = render(<ShieldSimulateScreen intent={intentFor(id)} onContinue={onContinue} onCancel={jest.fn()} />);
    expect(r.getByText('Simulating shield deposit')).toBeTruthy();
    await waitFor(() => expect(r.getByText('Shield simulation passed · 142,287 CU')).toBeTruthy());
    expect(mockSimulate).toHaveBeenCalledWith({rpc: 'fake'}, PREPARED);
    expect(r.getByText('3 of 4')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(r.getByTestId('shield-sim-amount').props.children).toBe('2.5 TEST');
    expect(r.getByText('A public deposit')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(r.getByText('Your main account signs it. Its amount and time are visible on chain.')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(r.getByText('Known programs only')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(r.getByText('No token approvals granted')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(r.getByText('− 2.5 TEST')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(r.getByText('− 0.000005 SOL')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(r.getByText('− ≈ 0.00069596 SOL')).toBeTruthy();
    fireEvent.press(r.getByTestId('shield-sim-continue'));
    expect(onContinue).toHaveBeenCalledWith(intentFor(id));
  });

  it('failed: the reason, Retry re-simulates, and NO "Continue anyway" (preflight would refuse it)', async () => {
    const id = holdPreparedA0Deposit(PREPARED);
    mockSimulate.mockResolvedValue({
      simulation: {success: false, error: {code: 'SIM', message: 'custom program error: 0x1771', action: 'The pool rejected the proof'}},
      checks: [],
    });
    const onContinue = jest.fn();
    const r = render(<ShieldSimulateScreen intent={intentFor(id)} onContinue={onContinue} onCancel={jest.fn()} />);
    await waitFor(() => expect(r.getByTestId('shield-sim-failed')).toBeTruthy());
    expect(r.getByText(/The pool rejected the proof\. Nothing was sent\./)).toBeTruthy();
    expect(r.queryByText(/Continue anyway/)).toBeNull();
    expect(r.queryByTestId('shield-sim-continue')).toBeNull();
    mockSimulate.mockResolvedValue({simulation: {success: true}, checks: CHECKS});
    await act(async () => {
      fireEvent.press(r.getByTestId('shield-sim-retry'));
    });
    await waitFor(() => expect(r.getByText('Shield simulation passed')).toBeTruthy());
    expect(mockSimulate).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
  });

  it('a thrown A0 error shows its code', async () => {
    const id = holdPreparedA0Deposit(PREPARED);
    mockSimulate.mockRejectedValue(Object.assign(new Error('E_A0_DEPOSIT_CLUSTER: not devnet'), {code: 'E_A0_DEPOSIT_CLUSTER'}));
    const r = render(<ShieldSimulateScreen intent={intentFor(id)} onContinue={jest.fn()} onCancel={jest.fn()} />);
    await waitFor(() => expect(r.getByText(/E_A0_DEPOSIT_CLUSTER · not devnet\./)).toBeTruthy());
  });

  it('a stale / forged intent (no held deposit): nothing simulated, nothing to continue', () => {
    const r = render(<ShieldSimulateScreen intent={intentFor('a0-deposit-forged')} onContinue={jest.fn()} onCancel={jest.fn()} />);
    expect(r.getByTestId('shield-sim-missing')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(mockSimulate).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(r.queryByTestId('shield-sim-continue')).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe('#20 ShieldConfirm', () => {
  it('the design rows for a deposit; the CTA runs the re-auth, then hands over to #21', async () => {
    const id = holdPreparedA0Deposit(PREPARED);
    let approve: (v: boolean) => void = () => {};
    const requestAuth = jest.fn(() => new Promise<boolean>(res => (approve = res)));
    const onAuthorized = jest.fn();
    const r = render(
      <ShieldConfirmScreen intent={intentFor(id)} requestAuth={requestAuth} onAuthorized={onAuthorized} onCancel={jest.fn()} />,
    );
    expect(r.getByTestId('shield-confirm-headline').props.children).toBe('Shield 2.5 TEST');
    expect(r.getByText('You are about to shield')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(r.getByText('4 of 4')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(r.getByText('Solana devnet')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(r.getByText('Your main account')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(r.getByText(/^Shielded pool · 8VMe…/)).toBeTruthy();
    expect(r.getByText('The amount, the time and your main account are public in this deposit.')).toBeTruthy();
    await act(async () => {
      fireEvent.press(r.getByTestId('shield-confirm-send'));
    });
    expect(requestAuth).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(onAuthorized).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(r.getByTestId('shield-confirm-send').props.accessibilityState.disabled).toBe(true); // no double submit
    await act(async () => approve(true));
    expect(onAuthorized).toHaveBeenCalledWith(intentFor(id));
  });

  it('a declined re-auth does not hand over; the CTA comes back', async () => {
    const id = holdPreparedA0Deposit(PREPARED);
    const onAuthorized = jest.fn();
    const r = render(
      <ShieldConfirmScreen intent={intentFor(id)} requestAuth={async () => false} onAuthorized={onAuthorized} onCancel={jest.fn()} />,
    );
    await act(async () => {
      fireEvent.press(r.getByTestId('shield-confirm-send'));
    });
    expect(onAuthorized).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(r.getByTestId('shield-confirm-send').props.accessibilityState.disabled).toBe(false);
  });

  it('a stale intent: the CTA is disabled and asks for nothing', async () => {
    const requestAuth = jest.fn(async () => true);
    const r = render(
      <ShieldConfirmScreen intent={intentFor('a0-deposit-gone')} requestAuth={requestAuth} onAuthorized={jest.fn()} onCancel={jest.fn()} />,
    );
    expect(r.getByTestId('shield-confirm-missing')).toBeTruthy();
    await act(async () => {
      fireEvent.press(r.getByTestId('shield-confirm-send'));
    });
    expect(requestAuth).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});

describe('#21 ShieldStatus', () => {
  function controlledSubmit() {
    const ctl: {stage: (s: A0SubmitStage, sig?: string) => void; resolve: (o: A0DepositOutcome) => void; reject: (e: unknown) => void} = {
      stage: () => {},
      resolve: () => {},
      reject: () => {},
    };
    mockSubmit.mockImplementation((_c, _p, _s, o) => {
      ctl.stage = o.onStage;
      return new Promise((res, rej) => {
        ctl.resolve = res;
        ctl.reject = rej;
      });
    });
    return ctl;
  }
  const title = (r: ReturnType<typeof render>) => r.getByTestId('shield-status-title').props.children;
  const sub = (r: ReturnType<typeof render>) => r.getByTestId('shield-status-sub').props.children;

  it('takes the held deposit ONCE, submits it with a second keychain read; the stages; unspent → Shielded, the position, the new balance', async () => {
    const id = holdPreparedA0Deposit(PREPARED);
    const ctl = controlledSubmit();
    const r = render(<ShieldStatusScreen intent={intentFor(id)} onDone={jest.fn()} />);
    expect(preparedA0Deposit(id)).toBeNull(); // taken: no second submit can find it
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockSubmit).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1));
    expect(mockRetrieve).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(mockSubmit.mock.calls[0]![1]).toBe(PREPARED);
    expect(mockSubmit.mock.calls[0]![2]).toEqual(new Uint8Array(64).fill(9));
    await act(async () => ctl.stage('signing'));
    expect(sub(r)).toBe('Signing with your main account.');
    await act(async () => ctl.stage('recorded', SIG));
    expect(r.getByText('5kAj9N…b81e')).toBeTruthy(); // the signature from `recorded` on
    await act(async () => ctl.stage('confirming', SIG));
    expect(sub(r)).toBe('Submitted to Solana devnet · waiting for confirmation.');
    expect(r.getByText("Don't close · waiting for confirmation")).toBeTruthy();
    await act(async () => ctl.resolve({status: 'unspent', signature: SIG, leafIndex: 17, root: 'ee'.repeat(32)}));
    expect(title(r)).toBe('Shielded');
    expect(sub(r)).toBe('Confirmed on Solana devnet · your note is at position #17 in the pool.');
    expect(r.getByText('CONFIRMED')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(r.getByText('#17 in the pool')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(r.getByTestId('shield-status-balance').props.children).toBe('Shielded balance now 4 TEST');
  });

  it('a second mount for the same intent finds nothing to send (no double submit)', async () => {
    const id = holdPreparedA0Deposit(PREPARED);
    controlledSubmit();
    render(<ShieldStatusScreen intent={intentFor(id)} onDone={jest.fn()} />);
    const r2 = render(<ShieldStatusScreen intent={intentFor(id)} onDone={jest.fn()} />);
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockSubmit).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1));
    expect(title(r2)).toBe('Nothing to send');
  });

  it.each([
    ['send-failed', 'The network did not accept the transaction.'],
    ['not-confirmed', 'The network has not confirmed it yet.'],
    ['not-in-sync', 'It is confirmed, but the pool’s history does not list it yet.'],
  ] as const)('pending (%s) → "Not confirmed yet … settled the next time the wallet starts", never "failed"', async (reason, why) => {
    const id = holdPreparedA0Deposit(PREPARED);
    const ctl = controlledSubmit();
    const r = render(<ShieldStatusScreen intent={intentFor(id)} onDone={jest.fn()} />);
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockSubmit).toHaveBeenCalled());
    await act(async () => ctl.resolve({status: 'pending', signature: SIG, reason}));
    expect(title(r)).toBe('Not confirmed yet');
    expect(sub(r)).toBe(`${why} Your deposit is kept on this device and will be settled the next time the wallet starts.`);
    expect(r.getByText('PENDING')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(r.queryByText(/fail/i)).toBeNull();
  });

  it('dropped (a foreign deposit holds our rho) → "Not shielded", no tokens moved', async () => {
    const id = holdPreparedA0Deposit(PREPARED);
    const ctl = controlledSubmit();
    const r = render(<ShieldStatusScreen intent={intentFor(id)} onDone={jest.fn()} />);
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockSubmit).toHaveBeenCalled());
    await act(async () => ctl.resolve({status: 'dropped', signature: SIG, reason: 'foreign', foreignSignature: 'F'.repeat(64)}));
    expect(title(r)).toBe('Not shielded');
    expect(sub(r)).toMatch(/No tokens moved/);
  });

  it('a refusal BEFORE the pending write → "Not sent", its code, nothing broadcast', async () => {
    const id = holdPreparedA0Deposit(PREPARED);
    const ctl = controlledSubmit();
    const r = render(<ShieldStatusScreen intent={intentFor(id)} onDone={jest.fn()} />);
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockSubmit).toHaveBeenCalled());
    await act(async () => ctl.stage('signing'));
    await act(async () =>
      ctl.reject(Object.assign(new Error('E_A0_DEPOSIT_SIGNER: not the depositor'), {code: 'E_A0_DEPOSIT_SIGNER'})),
    );
    expect(title(r)).toBe('Not sent');
    expect(sub(r)).toBe('E_A0_DEPOSIT_SIGNER · not the depositor. Nothing was broadcast.');
  });

  it('a throw AFTER the pending write (e.g. the settle sync) → kept as pending, never "Nothing was broadcast"', async () => {
    const id = holdPreparedA0Deposit(PREPARED);
    const ctl = controlledSubmit();
    const r = render(<ShieldStatusScreen intent={intentFor(id)} onDone={jest.fn()} />);
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockSubmit).toHaveBeenCalled());
    await act(async () => ctl.stage('recorded', SIG));
    await act(async () => ctl.stage('settling', SIG));
    await act(async () => ctl.reject(Object.assign(new Error('E_A0_SYNC_RPC: timeout'), {code: 'E_A0_SYNC_RPC'})));
    expect(title(r)).toBe('Not confirmed yet');
    expect(sub(r)).toBe(
      'E_A0_SYNC_RPC · timeout. Your deposit is kept on this device and will be settled the next time the wallet starts.',
    );
    expect(r.queryByText(/Nothing was broadcast/)).toBeNull();
  });

  it('a cancelled keychain read → "Not sent", the submit never called', async () => {
    mockRetrieve.mockRejectedValue(new Error('User canceled the operation.'));
    const id = holdPreparedA0Deposit(PREPARED);
    const r = render(<ShieldStatusScreen intent={intentFor(id)} onDone={jest.fn()} />);
    await waitFor(() => expect(title(r)).toBe('Not sent'));
    expect(mockSubmit).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});
```

Create `src/types/shield.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * The A0 deposit carried across #18 → #19 → #20 → #21 (spec §5, §11 "#19–#21 tx flow for the
 * deposit"). A sibling of `TransferIntent`, not a variant of it: the transparent #19–#21 screens
 * REBUILD a transfer from their intent and re-sign it on expiry (TransactionStatusScreen's
 * MAX_ATTEMPTS), which a deposit must never do (one blockhash, one pending note, one send — Task 4).
 * The shield screens therefore take this intent and the prepared deposit it names; nothing in it
 * can make a transaction: the proof and the accounts are held in memory by
 * `shielded/a0/screenSupport.ts` under `preparedId`, and a forged or stale id finds nothing.
 */
export interface ShieldIntent {
  kind: 'shield';
  /** the held A0PreparedDeposit (screenSupport.holdPreparedA0Deposit) */
  preparedId: string;
  /** base units, decimal string (BigInt-safe; params must be serializable) */
  amount: string;
  tokenSymbol: string;
  decimals: number;
  /** base58 of the main transparent account that signs and pays */
  depositor: string;
}
```

Create `src/modules/shielded/a0/screenSupport.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * What the shield screens (#16 → #18 → #19 → #20 → #21, M1b Task "screens") share about the A0
 * deposit and nothing else: the pool's token as the screens name it, the SOL a deposit costs, the
 * error text, and the one prepared deposit carried from #18 to #21.
 *
 * THE PREPARED DEPOSIT IS HELD HERE, NOT IN NAVIGATION PARAMS. It carries a 256-byte proof and
 * BigInts (not serializable params), and a param can be forged by a deep link — so the screens pass
 * only an opaque id (`ShieldIntent.preparedId`). At most one prepared deposit exists (a new #18 run
 * replaces it: every prepare takes the same next counter, so an older one is worthless), and #21
 * TAKES it (`releasePreparedA0Deposit`): a second mount, a back-and-forward or a forged route finds
 * nothing to submit — one prepared deposit is submitted at most once (cardinal rule 6, and Task 4's
 * "one blockhash, one pending write, one send").
 */
import {A0} from './constants';
import type {A0PreparedDeposit} from './depositFlow';
import {formatTokenAmount, groupInteger} from '../../../utils/parseTokenAmount';

/** The pool's mint as the screens show it. Devnet's A0 pool takes a test mint standing in for NOC. */
export const A0_TOKEN = {
  mint: A0.mint,
  symbol: 'TEST',
  name: 'Devnet test token',
  decimals: A0.mintDecimals,
} as const;

/** One signature, no compute-unit price (the deposit sets only a CU limit): 5,000 lamports —
 *  the landed deposit 3DR6F7oW…'s `meta.fee` (screenSupport.test.ts reads the fixture). */
export const A0_DEPOSIT_FEE_LAMPORTS = 5_000n;

/** The rent the depositor pays for the deposit's rho marker account (`init` in `deposit`):
 *  695,960 lamports — the marker's post-balance in the landed deposit 3DR6F7oW… (devnet, slot
 *  520075903), read from the committed fixture by screenSupport.test.ts. Shown as approximate:
 *  the cluster's rent rate decides it, not this app. */
export const A0_RHO_MARKER_RENT_LAMPORTS = 695_960n;

export const SOL_DECIMALS = 9;

/** Grouped display of base units, exact (BigInt; Hermes does not group with toLocaleString). */
export function displayAmount(units: bigint, decimals: number): string {
  const s = formatTokenAmount(units, decimals);
  const [whole, frac] = s.split('.');
  return frac ? `${groupInteger(whole ?? '0')}.${frac}` : groupInteger(whole ?? '0');
}

/** `code` + text of any A0 refusal (`A0DepositError`, `A0NoteStoreError`, `A0SyncError`, a native
 *  `E_A0_*` rejection) — the screens show the code, never a bare "something went wrong". */
export function a0ErrorText(e: unknown): {code: string | null; message: string} {
  const raw = e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);
  const own = (e as {code?: unknown} | null)?.code;
  const code =
    typeof own === 'string' && /^E_[A-Z0-9_]+$/.test(own) ? own : (/^(E_[A-Z0-9_]+)\b/.exec(raw)?.[1] ?? null);
  const message = code && raw.startsWith(`${code}: `) ? raw.slice(code.length + 2) : raw;
  return {code, message};
}

let held: {id: string; deposit: A0PreparedDeposit} | null = null;
let seq = 0;

/** Hold `deposit` for #19–#21 and return its id; replaces any earlier one. */
export function holdPreparedA0Deposit(deposit: A0PreparedDeposit): string {
  seq += 1;
  held = {id: `a0-deposit-${seq}`, deposit};
  return held.id;
}

/** The held deposit with this id, or null (none, replaced, or already submitted). */
export function preparedA0Deposit(id: string): A0PreparedDeposit | null {
  return held && held.id === id ? held.deposit : null;
}

/** Take the held deposit for submitting: returns it once, then null for that id. */
export function releasePreparedA0Deposit(id: string): A0PreparedDeposit | null {
  if (!held || held.id !== id) {
    return null;
  }
  const {deposit} = held;
  held = null;
  return deposit;
}

/** TEST-ONLY. */
export function resetPreparedA0DepositsForTests(): void {
  held = null;
}
```

Create `src/modules/shielded/a0/poolSize.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * The A0 pool's note count — the anonymity set as a NUMBER (spec §11 "Measure, not boolean (I4)":
 * where a screen speaks of the pool's privacy at all, it shows the pool's note count, never a
 * yes/no). Read from the MerkleTree account `5URd…` (`nextLeafIndex` = the leaves the program has
 * inserted), one `getAccountInfo` of a public account every client reads — nothing of the user's.
 *
 * Replaces the v1 `poolState.fetchAnonymitySet` (the NPkc pool) for the screens. "unavailable"
 * (RPC down, no account) and "incompatible" (the account is not the layout Task 2 decodes) stay
 * apart, as the v1 reader learned to keep them.
 */
import {PublicKey} from '@solana/web3.js';
import type {Connection} from '@solana/web3.js';
import {A0} from './constants';
import {parseA0TreeAccount} from './treeAccount';

export type A0PoolNoteCount =
  | {status: 'ok'; count: number}
  | {status: 'unavailable'}
  | {status: 'incompatible'; reason: string};

export async function readA0PoolNoteCount(connection: Connection): Promise<A0PoolNoteCount> {
  let data: Uint8Array;
  try {
    const info = await connection.getAccountInfo(new PublicKey(A0.merkleTree), 'confirmed');
    if (!info || info.owner.toBase58() !== A0.programId) {
      return {status: 'unavailable'};
    }
    data = Uint8Array.from(info.data);
  } catch {
    return {status: 'unavailable'};
  }
  try {
    return {status: 'ok', count: parseA0TreeAccount(data).nextLeafIndex};
  } catch (e) {
    return {status: 'incompatible', reason: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)};
  }
}
```

Create `src/hooks/useA0Shielded.ts`:

```ts
import {useEffect, useState} from 'react';
import {a0StartupState, ensureA0Startup, subscribeA0Startup} from '../modules/shielded/a0/startup';
import type {A0StartupState} from '../modules/shielded/a0/startup';
import {loadA0NoteStore} from '../modules/shielded/a0/noteStore';
import {a0ErrorText} from '../modules/shielded/a0/screenSupport';
import {isProverSupported} from '../modules/zkProver/nativeProverBridge';
import {isShieldedEnabled} from '../constants/features';
import {keychainManager} from '../modules/keychain/keychainModule';
import {mnemonicToSeed} from '../modules/keyDerivation/mnemonicUtils';
import {getConnection} from '../modules/solana/connection';

/**
 * The shielded balance as the screens may state it (spec §11; Task 4's rule: the balance is the
 * note store's ONLY once the startup restore/reconcile finished — `a0StartupState().phase ===
 * 'ready'`). Every other state is a state, never a 0:
 *   - unsupported — no shielded in this build, or no on-device prover (non-arm64);
 *   - idle        — the startup step has not run this session (it starts at unlock; Retry runs it);
 *   - running     — restoring / reconciling from the chain;
 *   - error       — the step failed: its code is shown, Retry runs it again (a failed restore wrote
 *                   nothing, so a retry restores again — never an endless spinner);
 *   - ready       — unspent and pending sums from the store (a store read that throws is an error).
 */
export type A0ShieldedView =
  | {kind: 'unsupported'}
  | {kind: 'idle'}
  | {kind: 'running'}
  | {kind: 'error'; code: string | null; message: string}
  | {kind: 'ready'; unspent: bigint; pending: bigint; notes: number};

export function a0ShieldedView(state: A0StartupState): A0ShieldedView {
  if (!isShieldedEnabled() || !isProverSupported()) {
    return {kind: 'unsupported'};
  }
  switch (state.phase) {
    case 'idle':
      return {kind: 'idle'};
    case 'running':
      return {kind: 'running'};
    case 'error':
      return {kind: 'error', code: state.code, message: state.message};
    case 'ready':
      try {
        const {notes} = loadA0NoteStore();
        let unspent = 0n;
        let pending = 0n;
        for (const n of notes) {
          if (n.status === 'unspent') {
            unspent += n.amount;
          } else if (n.status === 'pending') {
            pending += n.amount;
          }
        }
        return {kind: 'ready', unspent, pending, notes: notes.filter(n => n.status === 'unspent').length};
      } catch (e) {
        return {kind: 'error', ...a0ErrorText(e)};
      }
  }
}

/** The startup state, live (subscribed). */
export function useA0StartupState(): A0StartupState {
  const [s, setS] = useState<A0StartupState>(a0StartupState());
  useEffect(() => {
    setS(a0StartupState());
    return subscribeA0Startup(setS);
  }, []);
  return s;
}

/** The shielded balance view, live. `refresh` re-reads the store (e.g. on focus after a deposit). */
export function useA0Shielded(): {view: A0ShieldedView; refresh: () => void} {
  const state = useA0StartupState();
  const [tick, setTick] = useState(0);
  const [view, setView] = useState<A0ShieldedView>(() => a0ShieldedView(state));
  useEffect(() => {
    setView(a0ShieldedView(state));
  }, [state, tick]);
  return {view, refresh: () => setTick(t => t + 1)};
}

/**
 * Run the startup step again (Retry on an `idle` or `error` view): one keychain read (biometric),
 * the seed's own copy handed over (the step consumes it). Never rejects — a refused keychain read
 * is returned as an error state; the step's own failure is its state.
 */
export async function retryA0Startup(): Promise<A0StartupState> {
  if (!isShieldedEnabled() || !isProverSupported()) {
    return a0StartupState();
  }
  let seed: Uint8Array;
  try {
    seed = await mnemonicToSeed(await keychainManager.retrieveSeed());
  } catch (e) {
    return {phase: 'error', ...a0ErrorText(e)};
  }
  return ensureA0Startup(getConnection(), seed);
}
```

```diff
+ * Each row shows its MEASURED time ("running · 2.1 s" from a clock while it runs, "done · 4.2 s"
+ * after), not a percentage: no stage reports a fraction, so the design's "42 %" is not drawn
+ * (deviation, said loudly). A failure marks the row it happened in and shows the E_A0_* code.
```
