```tsx
import React, {useEffect, useRef, useState} from 'react';
import {View, Pressable, ScrollView, ActivityIndicator} from 'react-native';
import {SafeAreaView} from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import {ArrowLeft, Check, AlertTriangle, Info, ArrowRight, ShieldCheck, Eye} from 'lucide-react-native';
import {Text, Button, Card} from '../../components/ui';
import {cn} from '../../utils/cn';
import {formatAddress} from '../../utils/formatAddress';
import {formatTokenAmount} from '../../utils/parseTokenAmount';
import {simulateA0Deposit} from '../../modules/shielded/a0/depositFlow';
import {
  A0_DEPOSIT_FEE_LAMPORTS,
  A0_RHO_MARKER_RENT_LAMPORTS,
  SOL_DECIMALS,
  a0ErrorText,
  displayAmount,
  preparedA0Deposit,
} from '../../modules/shielded/a0/screenSupport';
import {getConnection} from '../../modules/solana/connection';
import type {TransferCheck} from '../../modules/solana/simulationChecks';
import type {ShieldIntent} from '../../types/shield';

/**
 * #19 tx-simulate for the A0 deposit — mirror /home/user/Downloads/index.html §s19, its SHIELDED
 * variant (states 4–5: "SHIELDED Review", mint accents, "Privacy & risk" + "Balance delta" cards),
 * plus the design's failed state (state 3).
 *
 * The simulation is `simulateA0Deposit`: the exact deposit transaction, unsigned, simulated on
 * chain — the program verifies the proof in it, so a bad proof fails HERE, before any fee. The risk
 * rows are its `checks` (`checkInstructions` over the compiled instructions: FeGSS… and the compute
 * budget program are known; anything else is a row that says so).
 *
 * Copy (D27, spec §11): the privacy row says what is public — the deposit is signed by your main
 * account and its amount and time are on chain — instead of the design's "Privacy preserved" row
 * (a claim about the sender that this deposit does not deliver; privacyClaims.test refuses it).
 *
 * NO "Continue anyway" (deviation from the design's failed state, said loudly): the deposit is sent
 * with preflight ON (Task 4), so a transaction whose simulation fails is refused by the RPC — the
 * button could only burn the deposit counter and leave a pending note. Failed = Retry or Cancel.
 *
 * A stale or forged intent (no held deposit under its id) shows that state and cannot continue.
 */

type SimState =
  | {kind: 'simulating'}
  | {kind: 'ready'; checks: TransferCheck[]; units: number | null}
  | {kind: 'failed'; reason: string}
  | {kind: 'missing'};

interface ShieldSimulateScreenProps {
  intent: ShieldIntent;
  onContinue: (intent: ShieldIntent) => void;
  onCancel: () => void;
}

export function ShieldSimulateScreen({intent, onContinue, onCancel}: ShieldSimulateScreenProps) {
  const [sim, setSim] = useState<SimState>({kind: 'simulating'});
  const [attempt, setAttempt] = useState(0);
  const lastTapRef = useRef(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    const prepared = preparedA0Deposit(intent.preparedId);
    if (!prepared) {
      setSim({kind: 'missing'});
      return;
    }
    setSim({kind: 'simulating'});
    simulateA0Deposit(getConnection(), prepared)
      .then(({simulation, checks}) => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        if (simulation.success) {
          setSim({kind: 'ready', checks, units: simulation.unitsConsumed ?? null});
        } else {
          setSim({
            kind: 'failed',
            reason: simulation.error?.action ?? simulation.error?.message ?? 'Simulation failed',
          });
        }
      })
      .catch((e: unknown) => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        const {code, message} = a0ErrorText(e);
        setSim({kind: 'failed', reason: code ? `${code} · ${message}` : message});
      });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [intent.preparedId, attempt]);

  const tap = (fn: () => void) => () => {
    const now = Date.now();
    if (now - lastTapRef.current < 500) return; // cardinal rule 6
    lastTapRef.current = now;
    fn();
  };

  const amount = `${displayAmount(BigInt(intent.amount), intent.decimals)} ${intent.tokenSymbol}`;

  return (
    <SafeAreaView edges={['top', 'bottom', 'left', 'right']} className="flex-1 bg-bg-base">
      <View className="flex-row items-center px-4 py-3 min-h-touch-min">
        <Pressable
          onPress={onCancel}
          accessibilityRole="button"
          accessibilityLabel="Back"
          className="w-12 h-12 items-center justify-center -ml-2">
          <ArrowLeft size={22} color="#A8ACB5" strokeWidth={1.75} />
        </Pressable>
        <View className="flex-row items-center gap-2 flex-1 ml-1">
          <ShieldCheck size={12} color="#5BE3C2" strokeWidth={2} />
          <Text variant="overline" className="text-accent-shielded">
            Shielded
          </Text>
          <Text variant="h2">Review</Text>
        </View>
        <Text variant="caption" className="text-fg-tertiary">
          3 of 4
        </Text>
      </View>

      <ScrollView className="flex-1" contentContainerClassName="px-5 pb-6 gap-3" showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}>
        <Card padding="p-4">
          <Eyebrow sim={sim} />
          <View className="flex-row items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
            <Text variant="body-lg" numeral className="text-fg-primary font-geist-semibold" testID="shield-sim-amount">
              {amount}
            </Text>
            <Text variant="body-sm" mono className="text-fg-tertiary">
              →
            </Text>
            <Text variant="body-sm" mono className="text-accent-shielded">
              shielded pool
            </Text>
          </View>
          <Text variant="caption" mono className="text-fg-tertiary mt-1">
            {`from ${formatAddress(intent.depositor)} · your main account`}
          </Text>
        </Card>

        {sim.kind === 'simulating' ? (
          <Card padding="p-4" className="gap-3">
            <View className="h-3 rounded-md bg-bg-surface-3 w-1/3 opacity-60" />
            <View className="h-3 rounded-md bg-bg-surface-3 w-full opacity-40" />
            <View className="h-3 rounded-md bg-bg-surface-3 w-2/3 opacity-40" />
          </Card>
        ) : null}

        {sim.kind === 'failed' ? (
          <View className="rounded-lg p-4 bg-[rgba(255,92,106,0.10)] border border-[rgba(255,92,106,0.5)]" testID="shield-sim-failed">
            <View className="flex-row items-center gap-2 mb-1">
              <AlertTriangle size={16} color="#FF5C6A" strokeWidth={2} />
              <Text variant="body" className="text-fg-primary">
                Couldn't simulate this deposit
              </Text>
            </View>
            <Text variant="body-sm" className="text-fg-secondary">
              {`${sim.reason}. Nothing was sent. A deposit that fails its simulation is refused by the network, so it cannot be sent anyway.`}
            </Text>
          </View>
        ) : null}

        {sim.kind === 'missing' ? (
          <View className="rounded-lg p-4 bg-bg-surface-2 border-l-2 border-l-warning" testID="shield-sim-missing">
            <Text variant="body-sm" className="text-fg-secondary">
              This deposit is no longer prepared. Go back and start the shield again.
            </Text>
          </View>
        ) : null}

        {sim.kind === 'ready' ? (
          <>
            <Card padding="p-4">
              <Text variant="overline" className="mb-3">
                Privacy & risk
              </Text>
              <PublicRow />
              {sim.checks.map((c, i) => (
                <CheckRow key={i} check={c} />
              ))}
            </Card>
            <Card padding="p-4">
              <Text variant="overline" className="mb-3">
                Balance delta · this deposit
              </Text>
              <DeltaRow label="Shielding" value={`− ${amount}`} />
              <DeltaRow label="ZK proof fee" value="None · on this device" zk />
              <DeltaRow label="Network fee" value={`− ${formatTokenAmount(A0_DEPOSIT_FEE_LAMPORTS, SOL_DECIMALS)} SOL`} />
              <DeltaRow
                label="Deposit record rent"
                value={`− ≈ ${formatTokenAmount(A0_RHO_MARKER_RENT_LAMPORTS, SOL_DECIMALS)} SOL`}
              />
            </Card>
          </>
        ) : null}
      </ScrollView>

      <View className="px-6 pb-8 pt-2 bg-bg-base border-t border-bg-surface-2 gap-3">
        {sim.kind === 'ready' ? (
          <Pressable
            onPress={tap(() => onContinue(intent))}
            accessibilityRole="button"
            accessibilityLabel="Continue to confirm"
            testID="shield-sim-continue"
            className="min-h-touch-rec rounded-pill items-center justify-center flex-row gap-2 bg-accent-shielded active:opacity-90">
            <ArrowRight size={18} color="#0A0A0A" strokeWidth={2} />
            <Text variant="body-lg" className="font-geist-semibold text-bg-base">
              Continue to confirm
            </Text>
          </Pressable>
        ) : sim.kind === 'failed' ? (
          <Button label="Retry simulation" variant="primary" onPress={tap(() => setAttempt(a => a + 1))} testID="shield-sim-retry" />
        ) : sim.kind === 'simulating' ? (
          <Button label="Simulating…" variant="primary" disabled onPress={() => {}} testID="shield-sim-continue" />
        ) : null}
        <Button label="Cancel" variant="tertiary" onPress={onCancel} testID="shield-sim-cancel" />
      </View>
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

function Eyebrow({sim}: {sim: SimState}) {
  if (sim.kind === 'simulating') {
    return (
      <View className="flex-row items-center gap-1 mb-2">
        <ActivityIndicator size="small" color="#5BE3C2" style={{transform: [{scale: 0.7}]}} />
        <Text variant="caption" className="text-accent-shielded">
          Simulating shield deposit
        </Text>
      </View>
    );
  }
  if (sim.kind === 'ready') {
    return (
      <View className="flex-row items-center gap-1 mb-2">
        <Check size={12} color="#3FD68B" strokeWidth={2.5} />
        <Text variant="caption" className="text-success">
          {sim.units !== null ? `Shield simulation passed · ${sim.units.toLocaleString('en-US')} CU` : 'Shield simulation passed'}
        </Text>
      </View>
    );
  }
  return (
    <View className="flex-row items-center gap-1 mb-2">
      <AlertTriangle size={12} color="#FF5C6A" strokeWidth={2} />
      <Text variant="caption" className="text-danger">
        {sim.kind === 'missing' ? 'Nothing to review' : "Couldn't simulate"}
      </Text>
    </View>
  );
}

/** The privacy row: what this deposit makes public (D27 copy; nothing claims unlinkability). */
function PublicRow() {
  return (
    <View className="flex-row items-start gap-3 py-3" testID="shield-sim-public-row">
      <View className="w-7 h-7 rounded-full items-center justify-center mt-0.5 bg-[rgba(245,166,35,0.16)]">
        <Eye size={14} color="#F5A623" strokeWidth={2} />
      </View>
      <View className="flex-1 gap-0.5">
        <Text variant="body-sm" className="text-fg-primary">
          A public deposit
        </Text>
        <Text variant="caption" className="text-fg-tertiary">
          Your main account signs it. Its amount and time are visible on chain.
        </Text>
      </View>
      <Text variant="caption" className="font-geist-semibold text-warning pt-0.5">
        PUBLIC
      </Text>
    </View>
  );
}

function CheckRow({check}: {check: TransferCheck}) {
  const color = check.status === 'ok' ? '#3FD68B' : check.status === 'warn' ? '#F5A623' : '#FF5C6A';
  const bg =
    check.status === 'ok'
      ? 'bg-[rgba(63,214,139,0.16)]'
      : check.status === 'warn'
        ? 'bg-[rgba(245,166,35,0.16)]'
        : 'bg-[rgba(255,92,106,0.16)]';
  const badge = check.status === 'ok' ? 'PASS' : check.status === 'warn' ? 'CHECK' : 'FAIL';
  const badgeCls = check.status === 'ok' ? 'text-success' : check.status === 'warn' ? 'text-warning' : 'text-danger';
  const Icon = check.status === 'ok' ? Check : check.status === 'warn' ? Info : AlertTriangle;
  return (
    <View className="flex-row items-start gap-3 py-3 border-t border-bg-surface-2">
      <View className={cn('w-7 h-7 rounded-full items-center justify-center mt-0.5', bg)}>
        <Icon size={14} color={color} strokeWidth={2} />
      </View>
      <View className="flex-1 gap-0.5">
        <Text variant="body-sm" className="text-fg-primary">
          {check.title}
        </Text>
        <Text variant="caption" mono className="text-fg-tertiary">
          {check.meta}
        </Text>
      </View>
      <Text variant="caption" className={cn('font-geist-semibold pt-0.5', badgeCls)}>
        {badge}
      </Text>
    </View>
  );
}

function DeltaRow({label, value, zk}: {label: string; value: string; zk?: boolean}) {
  return (
    <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between py-1">
      <Text variant="body-sm" className={zk ? 'text-accent-shielded' : 'text-fg-secondary'}>
        {label}
      </Text>
      <Text variant="body-sm" numeral className={cn('font-geist-semibold', zk ? 'text-fg-secondary' : 'text-danger')}>
        {value}
      </Text>
    </View>
  );
}
```

Create `src/screens/shielded/ShieldConfirmScreen.tsx` (#20):

```tsx
import React, {useCallback, useRef, useState} from 'react';
import {View, Pressable, ScrollView} from 'react-native';
import {SafeAreaView} from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import {ArrowLeft, ShieldCheck, Shield} from 'lucide-react-native';
import {Text, Button, Card} from '../../components/ui';
import {cn} from '../../utils/cn';
import {formatTokenAmount} from '../../utils/parseTokenAmount';
import {formatChecksumParts} from '../../modules/solana/transferRisk';
import {A0} from '../../modules/shielded/a0/constants';
import {
  A0_DEPOSIT_FEE_LAMPORTS,
  A0_RHO_MARKER_RENT_LAMPORTS,
  SOL_DECIMALS,
  displayAmount,
  preparedA0Deposit,
} from '../../modules/shielded/a0/screenSupport';
import type {ShieldIntent} from '../../types/shield';

/**
 * #20 tx-confirm for the A0 deposit — mirror /home/user/Downloads/index.html §s20, its SHIELDED
 * variant (state 4: "SHIELDED Confirm", the "You are about to send privately" card, From / To /
 * Anonymity / Network rows, Fees with the ZK proof row, the mint CTA with the shield glyph).
 *
 * Adapted to what a deposit is (D27 copy): "You are about to shield"; From = your main account
 * (checksum first-6 / last-6 highlighted, screen.md's convention) — it signs and pays; To = the
 * shielded pool (its address, devnet); Network = Solana devnet; fees = network fee, deposit record
 * rent, ZK proof none. The design's "Anonymity · Pool of N notes" row is #16's measured number and is
 * not repeated here; "PRIVATE" / "SHIELDED" pills are not drawn on a public deposit.
 *
 * The CTA runs the existing re-auth (#10 UnlockSend through `awaitUserAuth`, supplied by the
 * Navigator as `requestAuth`) and then hands over to #21, which owns the send. Debounced and
 * disabled while the auth is open (cardinal rule 6). No first-time-recipient callout and no
 * high-value gate: there is no recipient — the circuit binds the note to this wallet (§5.5).
 */

interface ShieldConfirmScreenProps {
  intent: ShieldIntent;
  /** the re-auth (#10); resolves true when approved */
  requestAuth: (intent: ShieldIntent) => Promise<boolean>;
  onAuthorized: (intent: ShieldIntent) => void;
  onCancel: () => void;
}

export function ShieldConfirmScreen({intent, requestAuth, onAuthorized, onCancel}: ShieldConfirmScreenProps) {
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const lastTapRef = useRef(0);
  const held = preparedA0Deposit(intent.preparedId) !== null;
  const amount = `${displayAmount(BigInt(intent.amount), intent.decimals)} ${intent.tokenSymbol}`;

  const handleShield = useCallback(async () => {
    const now = Date.now();
    if (now - lastTapRef.current < 500) return;
    lastTapRef.current = now;
    if (busy || !held) return;
    setBusy(true);
    const approved = await requestAuth(intent);
    if (!approved) {
      setBusy(false);
      return;
    }
    onAuthorized(intent);
  }, [busy, held, requestAuth, onAuthorized, intent]);

  return (
    <SafeAreaView edges={['top', 'left', 'right']} className="flex-1 bg-bg-base">
      <View className="flex-row items-center px-4 py-3 min-h-touch-min">
        <Pressable
          onPress={onCancel}
          accessibilityRole="button"
          accessibilityLabel="Back"
          className="w-12 h-12 items-center justify-center -ml-2">
          <ArrowLeft size={22} color="#A8ACB5" strokeWidth={1.75} />
        </Pressable>
        <View className="flex-row items-center gap-2 flex-1 ml-1">
          <ShieldCheck size={12} color="#5BE3C2" strokeWidth={2} />
          <Text variant="overline" className="text-accent-shielded">
            Shielded
          </Text>
          <Text variant="h2">Confirm</Text>
        </View>
        <Text variant="caption" className="text-fg-tertiary">
          4 of 4
        </Text>
      </View>

      <ScrollView contentContainerClassName="p-5 pb-4 gap-4">
        <Text variant="h1" className="text-center" testID="shield-confirm-headline">
          {`Shield ${amount}`}
        </Text>

        <View className="rounded-lg p-5 border border-[rgba(91,227,194,0.45)] bg-bg-surface-1">
          <Text variant="overline" className="text-accent-shielded mb-2">
            You are about to shield
          </Text>
          <Text variant="balance-lg" numeral className="text-fg-primary">
            {amount}
          </Text>
        </View>

        {!held ? (
          <View className="rounded-lg p-4 bg-bg-surface-2 border-l-2 border-l-warning" testID="shield-confirm-missing">
            <Text variant="body-sm" className="text-fg-secondary">
              This deposit is no longer prepared. Go back and start the shield again.
            </Text>
          </View>
        ) : null}

        <Card className="gap-3">
          <Row label="From">
            <Checksum address={intent.depositor} />
          </Row>
          <Row label="To">
            <Text variant="body-sm" className="text-accent-shielded">
              {`Shielded pool · ${A0.pool.slice(0, 4)}…${A0.pool.slice(-4)}`}
            </Text>
          </Row>
          <Row label="Signs">
            <Text variant="body-sm" className="text-fg-primary">
              Your main account
            </Text>
          </Row>
          <Row label="Network">
            <Text variant="body-sm" className="text-fg-primary">
              Solana devnet
            </Text>
          </Row>
        </Card>

        <Card className="gap-3">
          <Text variant="overline">Fees</Text>
          <Row label="ZK proof fee" zk>
            <Text variant="body-sm" className="text-fg-primary">
              None · on this device
            </Text>
          </Row>
          <Row label="Network fee">
            <Text variant="body-sm" numeral className="text-fg-primary">
              {`${formatTokenAmount(A0_DEPOSIT_FEE_LAMPORTS, SOL_DECIMALS)} SOL`}
            </Text>
          </Row>
          <Row label="Deposit record rent">
            <Text variant="body-sm" numeral className="text-fg-primary">
              {`≈ ${formatTokenAmount(A0_RHO_MARKER_RENT_LAMPORTS, SOL_DECIMALS)} SOL`}
            </Text>
          </Row>
        </Card>

        <Text variant="caption" className="text-fg-tertiary text-center px-2">
          The amount, the time and your main account are public in this deposit.
        </Text>
      </ScrollView>

      <View className="px-5 pb-8 pt-3 gap-3 border-t border-bg-surface-2">
        <Pressable
          onPress={() => {
            void handleShield();
          }}
          disabled={busy || !held}
          accessibilityRole="button"
          accessibilityState={{disabled: busy || !held}}
          accessibilityLabel={`Shield ${amount}`}
          testID="shield-confirm-send"
          className={cn(
            'min-h-touch-rec rounded-pill items-center justify-center flex-row gap-2',
            busy || !held ? 'bg-bg-surface-3' : 'bg-accent-shielded active:opacity-90',
          )}>
          <Shield size={18} color={busy || !held ? '#6E727A' : '#0A0A0A'} strokeWidth={2} />
          <Text variant="body-lg" className={cn('font-geist-semibold', busy || !held ? 'text-fg-disabled' : 'text-bg-base')}>
            {`Shield ${amount}`}
          </Text>
        </Pressable>
        <Button label="Cancel" variant="tertiary" disabled={busy} testID="shield-confirm-cancel" onPress={onCancel} />
      </View>
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

function Row({label, children, zk}: {label: string; children: React.ReactNode; zk?: boolean}) {
  return (
    <View className="flex-row items-start justify-between gap-3">
      <Text variant="overline" className={cn('pt-0.5', zk ? 'text-accent-shielded' : 'text-fg-tertiary')}>
        {label}
      </Text>
      <View className="flex-1 items-end">{children}</View>
    </View>
  );
}

function Checksum({address}: {address: string}) {
  const {head, tail} = formatChecksumParts(address);
  if (!tail) {
    return (
      <Text variant="body-sm" mono className="text-fg-primary">
        {head}
      </Text>
    );
  }
  return (
    <Text variant="body-sm" mono className="text-fg-primary text-right" testID="shield-confirm-from">
      <Text variant="body-sm" mono className="text-accent-shielded">
        {head}
      </Text>
      {address.slice(6, -6)}
      <Text variant="body-sm" mono className="text-accent-shielded">
        {tail}
      </Text>
    </Text>
  );
}
```

Create `src/screens/shielded/ShieldStatusScreen.tsx` (#21):

```tsx
import React, {useEffect, useRef, useState} from 'react';
import {View, Pressable, ActivityIndicator, Linking, ScrollView, BackHandler, Alert} from 'react-native';
import {SafeAreaView} from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import Clipboard from '@react-native-clipboard/clipboard';
import {Check, X, Clock, Copy, ShieldCheck, Lock, FileText} from 'lucide-react-native';
import {Text, Button} from '../../components/ui';
import {cn} from '../../utils/cn';
import {formatTokenAmount} from '../../utils/parseTokenAmount';
import {submitA0Deposit} from '../../modules/shielded/a0/depositFlow';
import type {A0DepositOutcome, A0SubmitStage} from '../../modules/shielded/a0/depositFlow';
import {a0UnspentBalance} from '../../modules/shielded/a0/noteStore';
import {
  A0_DEPOSIT_FEE_LAMPORTS,
  A0_RHO_MARKER_RENT_LAMPORTS,
  SOL_DECIMALS,
  a0ErrorText,
  displayAmount,
  releasePreparedA0Deposit,
} from '../../modules/shielded/a0/screenSupport';
import {keychainManager} from '../../modules/keychain/keychainModule';
import {mnemonicToSeed} from '../../modules/keyDerivation/mnemonicUtils';
import {getConnection} from '../../modules/solana/connection';
import type {ShieldIntent} from '../../types/shield';

/**
 * #21 tx-status for the A0 deposit — mirror /home/user/Downloads/index.html §s21: the loading state
 * (state 1), and the SHIELDED success variant (state 4: lock ring, "SHIELDED" amount card, Tx hash /
 * position rows, View details + Done). Its "Sent privately" sub-line (a claim about the sender)
 * does not describe a deposit and is not used (D27; privacyClaims.test refuses it).
 *
 * THIS SCREEN OWNS THE SEND: it TAKES the prepared deposit (`releasePreparedA0Deposit`, once) and
 * calls `submitA0Deposit` with a second keychain read (Task 4). Its `onStage` drives the copy
 * (signing → recorded → submitted → confirming → settling) — the signature is shown from `recorded`
 * on. The outcomes, said as what they are:
 *   - unspent  → "Shielded", the note's position (leaf index) in the pool, the new shielded balance;
 *   - pending  → "Not confirmed yet": the note is kept and settled at the next start — NEVER
 *                "failed" (Task 4: the startup reconciliation is the authority on a pending note);
 *   - dropped  → "Not shielded": another deposit holds this note's number; no tokens moved;
 *   - a refusal before the send (keychain cancelled, signer mismatch, store refusal) → "Not sent",
 *     its code; nothing was broadcast.
 * No retry and no re-sign on this screen (one prepared deposit → one send); a new shield starts at #16.
 *
 * Back is locked while the send runs (screen.md #21 "Predictive-back LOCKED"): leaving would not stop
 * it, so the gesture explains that instead of pretending to cancel.
 */

type Phase =
  | {kind: 'running'; stage: A0SubmitStage | 'auth'}
  | {kind: 'done'; outcome: A0DepositOutcome}
  /** a throw: before the pending write nothing was broadcast; after it (`recorded`) the note is kept */
  | {kind: 'refused'; code: string | null; message: string; recorded: boolean}
  | {kind: 'missing'};

const STAGE_TEXT: Record<A0SubmitStage | 'auth', string> = {
  auth: 'Unlock with your fingerprint or passcode to sign.',
  signing: 'Signing with your main account.',
  recorded: 'Recorded on this device · sending to Solana devnet.',
  submitted: 'Submitted to Solana devnet · waiting for confirmation.',
  confirming: 'Submitted to Solana devnet · waiting for confirmation.',
  settling: "Confirmed · reading the note's position from the pool.",
};

interface ShieldStatusScreenProps {
  intent: ShieldIntent;
  onDone: () => void;
}

export function ShieldStatusScreen({intent, onDone}: ShieldStatusScreenProps) {
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<Phase>({kind: 'running', stage: 'auth'});
  const [signature, setSignature] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [balance, setBalance] = useState<bigint | null>(null);
  const started = useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (started.current) return; // one send per mount, whatever re-renders
    started.current = true;
    const prepared = releasePreparedA0Deposit(intent.preparedId);
    if (!prepared) {
      setPhase({kind: 'missing'});
      return;
    }
    (async () => {
      let seed: Uint8Array;
      try {
        seed = await mnemonicToSeed(await keychainManager.retrieveSeed());
      } catch (e) {
        setPhase({kind: 'refused', ...a0ErrorText(e), recorded: false});
        return;
      }
      let recorded = false;
      try {
        const outcome = await submitA0Deposit(getConnection(), prepared, seed, {
          onStage: (stage, sig) => {
            if (stage === 'recorded') recorded = true;
            if (sig) setSignature(sig);
            setPhase({kind: 'running', stage});
          },
        });
        setSignature(outcome.signature);
        if (outcome.status === 'unspent') {
          try {
            setBalance(a0UnspentBalance());
          } catch {
            setBalance(null);
          }
        }
        setPhase({kind: 'done', outcome});
      } catch (e) {
        setPhase({kind: 'refused', ...a0ErrorText(e), recorded});
      }
    })();
  }, [intent.preparedId]);

  const running = phase.kind === 'running';
  useEffect(() => {
    const sub = BackHandler.addEventListener('hardwareBackPress', () => {
      if (running) {
        Alert.alert('Shield in progress', 'Leaving does not stop it. The result is recorded on this device either way.');
        return true;
      }
      onDone();
      return true;
    });
    return () => sub.remove();
  }, [running, onDone]);

  const amount = `${displayAmount(BigInt(intent.amount), intent.decimals)} ${intent.tokenSymbol}`;
  const view = viewOf(phase);
  const shortSig = signature && signature.length > 16 ? `${signature.slice(0, 6)}…${signature.slice(-4)}` : signature;

  const copySig = () => {
    if (!signature) return;
    try {
      Clipboard.setString(signature);
      setTimeout(() => Clipboard.setString(''), 30_000);
    } catch {
      // clipboard unavailable — no-op
    }
  };

  return (
    <SafeAreaView className="flex-1 bg-bg-base">
      <View className="flex-row items-center px-4 py-3 gap-2">
        <ShieldCheck size={12} color="#5BE3C2" strokeWidth={2} />
        <Text variant="overline" className="text-accent-shielded">
          Shielded
        </Text>
        <Text variant="h2" className="flex-1">
          {running ? 'Shielding…' : 'Shield'}
        </Text>
        {view.badge ? (
          <Text variant="overline" className={view.tone === 'ok' ? 'text-accent-shielded' : 'text-warning'}>
            {view.badge}
          </Text>
        ) : null}
      </View>

      <ScrollView contentContainerClassName="flex-grow items-center px-5 pb-8">
        <View className="items-center justify-center py-8 gap-5 w-full">
          <Ring tone={view.tone} />
          <Text
            variant="h1"
            testID="shield-status-title"
            className={cn(
              'text-center',
              view.tone === 'ok' ? 'text-accent-shielded' : view.tone === 'bad' ? 'text-danger' : view.tone === 'warn' ? 'text-warning' : '',
            )}>
            {view.title}
          </Text>
          <Text variant="body-sm" className="text-center text-fg-secondary" style={{maxWidth: 320}} testID="shield-status-sub">
            {view.sub}
          </Text>
        </View>

        <View className="w-full rounded-2xl p-5 items-center gap-2 border border-[rgba(91,227,194,0.45)] bg-bg-surface-1">
          <Text variant="overline" className="text-accent-shielded">
            Shielded
          </Text>
          <Text variant="balance-lg" numeral className="text-fg-primary">
            {amount}
          </Text>
          {balance !== null ? (
            <Text variant="caption" className="text-fg-tertiary" testID="shield-status-balance">
              {`Shielded balance now ${displayAmount(balance, intent.decimals)} ${intent.tokenSymbol}`}
            </Text>
          ) : null}
        </View>

        {signature ? (
          <View className="w-full bg-bg-surface-1 rounded-lg px-5 mt-3">
            <MetaRow label="Tx hash" value={shortSig ?? ''} onCopy={copySig} />
            {phase.kind === 'done' && phase.outcome.status === 'unspent' ? (
              <MetaRow label="Position" value={`#${phase.outcome.leafIndex} in the pool`} />
            ) : null}
            <MetaRow
              label="Fees"
              value={`${formatTokenAmount(A0_DEPOSIT_FEE_LAMPORTS, SOL_DECIMALS)} SOL + ≈ ${formatTokenAmount(A0_RHO_MARKER_RENT_LAMPORTS, SOL_DECIMALS)} SOL rent`}
            />
          </View>
        ) : null}
      </ScrollView>

      <View className="px-6 pb-2 pt-2 gap-2">
        {running ? (
          <Button label="Don't close · waiting for confirmation" variant="primary" disabled onPress={() => {}} />
        ) : (
          <View className="flex-row gap-2">
            {signature ? (
              <Pressable
                testID="shield-status-details"
                onPress={() => {
                  Linking.openURL(`https://explorer.solana.com/tx/${signature}?cluster=devnet`).catch(() => {});
                }}
                accessibilityRole="button"
                accessibilityLabel="View details"
                className="flex-1 min-h-touch-rec rounded-pill items-center justify-center flex-row gap-2 bg-bg-surface-1">
                <FileText size={16} color="#E7E9EE" strokeWidth={1.75} />
                <Text variant="body-lg" className="font-geist-semibold text-fg-primary">
                  View details
                </Text>
              </Pressable>
            ) : null}
            <Pressable
              testID="shield-status-done"
              onPress={onDone}
              accessibilityRole="button"
              accessibilityLabel="Done"
              className="flex-1 min-h-touch-rec rounded-pill items-center justify-center flex-row gap-2 bg-accent-shielded active:opacity-90">
              <Check size={18} color="#0A0A0A" strokeWidth={2} />
              <Text variant="body-lg" className="font-geist-semibold text-bg-base">
                Done
              </Text>
            </Pressable>
          </View>
        )}
      </View>
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

type Tone = 'busy' | 'ok' | 'warn' | 'bad';

function viewOf(phase: Phase): {title: string; sub: string; tone: Tone; badge: string | null} {
  switch (phase.kind) {
    case 'running':
      return {title: 'Shielding…', sub: STAGE_TEXT[phase.stage], tone: 'busy', badge: null};
    case 'missing':
      return {
        title: 'Nothing to send',
        sub: 'This deposit is no longer prepared (it was already sent, or replaced). Start the shield again.',
        tone: 'warn',
        badge: null,
      };
    case 'refused':
      return phase.recorded
        ? {
            title: 'Not confirmed yet',
            sub: `${phase.code ? `${phase.code} · ` : ''}${phase.message}. Your deposit is kept on this device and will be settled the next time the wallet starts.`,
            tone: 'warn',
            badge: 'PENDING',
          }
        : {
            title: 'Not sent',
            sub: `${phase.code ? `${phase.code} · ` : ''}${phase.message}. Nothing was broadcast.`,
            tone: 'bad',
            badge: null,
          };
    case 'done': {
      const o = phase.outcome;
      if (o.status === 'unspent') {
        return {
          title: 'Shielded',
          sub: `Confirmed on Solana devnet · your note is at position #${o.leafIndex} in the pool.`,
          tone: 'ok',
          badge: 'CONFIRMED',
        };
      }
      if (o.status === 'dropped') {
        return {
          title: 'Not shielded',
          sub: 'Another deposit already used this note’s number, so yours did not land. No tokens moved; the network fee may have been charged.',
          tone: 'bad',
          badge: null,
        };
      }
      const why =
        o.reason === 'send-failed'
          ? 'The network did not accept the transaction.'
          : o.reason === 'not-confirmed'
            ? 'The network has not confirmed it yet.'
            : 'It is confirmed, but the pool’s history does not list it yet.';
      return {
        title: 'Not confirmed yet',
        sub: `${why} Your deposit is kept on this device and will be settled the next time the wallet starts.${o.detail ? ` (${o.detail})` : ''}`,
        tone: 'warn',
        badge: 'PENDING',
      };
    }
  }
}

function Ring({tone}: {tone: Tone}) {
  if (tone === 'ok') {
    return (
      <View className="w-32 h-32 rounded-full items-center justify-center border-2 border-accent-shielded bg-[rgba(91,227,194,0.10)]">
        <Lock size={52} color="#5BE3C2" strokeWidth={1.75} />
      </View>
    );
  }
  if (tone === 'bad') {
    return (
      <View className="w-32 h-32 rounded-full items-center justify-center border-2 border-danger bg-[rgba(248,113,113,0.10)]">
        <X size={56} color="#F87171" strokeWidth={2} />
      </View>
    );
  }
  if (tone === 'warn') {
    return (
      <View
        className="w-32 h-32 rounded-full items-center justify-center bg-[rgba(242,181,59,0.08)]"
        style={{borderWidth: 1.5, borderColor: '#F2B53B', borderStyle: 'dashed'}}>
        <Clock size={52} color="#F2B53B" strokeWidth={1.75} />
      </View>
    );
  }
  return (
    <View className="w-32 h-32 rounded-full items-center justify-center border border-[rgba(91,227,194,0.35)]">
      <ActivityIndicator size="large" color="#5BE3C2" />
    </View>
  );
}

function MetaRow({label, value, onCopy}: {label: string; value: string; onCopy?: () => void}) {
  return (
    <View className="flex-row items-center gap-3 py-3 border-t border-bg-surface-3">
      <Text variant="overline" className="text-fg-tertiary w-[76px]">
        {label}
      </Text>
      <Text variant="body-sm" className="flex-1 font-geist-mono text-fg-secondary" numberOfLines={2}>
        {value}
      </Text>
      {onCopy ? (
        <Pressable
          onPress={onCopy}
          className="w-8 h-8 rounded-sm items-center justify-center bg-bg-surface-2"
          accessibilityLabel={`Copy ${label}`}>
          <Copy size={14} color="#A8ACB5" strokeWidth={1.75} />
        </Pressable>
      ) : null}
    </View>
  );
}
```

#### Notes for the executor (Task 5)

- **The rulings this task took (each the most secure default; the owner may overturn any):**
  - **A sibling `ShieldIntent` and sibling #19–#21 screens, not a variant of `TransferIntent` in the transparent screens.** The brief preferred a typed variant through the existing screens. Measured against their code: `TxSimulateScreen` and `TransactionStatusScreen` REBUILD a transfer from the intent (`buildTransferTx` / `submitTransparentTransfer`), and #21 re-broadcasts with a fresh blockhash up to 3 times on expiry (`MAX_ATTEMPTS`, `attemptSubmit`) — exactly what a deposit must never do (Task 4: one blockhash, one pending note, one send; a re-sign would store the wrong `lastValidBlockHeight`). A variant would put a branch into every effect of three money-moving screens and keep a re-send path one condition away from the deposit. So the deposit has its own three screens built to the SAME design states (the design draws a SHIELDED variant of each of #19, #20, #21 — those are what was built), and the transparent ones are untouched (their suites unchanged and green). Cost: ~60 lines of presentational overlap (check row, delta row, meta row) not shared with the transparent screens; cost if wrong: an extraction refactor later, no behaviour.
  - **The prepared deposit is held in memory under an opaque id, never in navigation params** (`screenSupport`'s holder): params must be serializable (a 256-byte proof, BigInts) and can be forged by a deep link. One deposit is held at a time (every prepare takes the same next counter, so an older one is worthless); #21 TAKES it (`releasePreparedA0Deposit`) before anything else, so a second mount, a re-render, a back-and-forward or a forged `ShieldStatus` route sends nothing (tested: "a second mount for the same intent finds nothing to send"). A killed app loses the held deposit — nothing was written for it (prepare writes only pre-check imports), so nothing is lost.
  - **No "Continue anyway" on #19 for a deposit** (the design's failed state has it): `submitA0Deposit` sends with preflight ON, so a deposit whose simulation fails is refused by the RPC; the button could only write a pending note, burn the counter and leave the reconciliation to drop it. Failed = "Retry simulation" or Cancel.
  - **#18 shows no percentage and no hosted prover.** `prepareA0Deposit` reports stages, not fractions; a percentage would be invented (the v1 screen's fixed 2 s/3 s/2 s animation with its 90 %/100 % trap is exactly what the brief retires). Each row shows its measured time instead. A0 has no hosted proving (§1), so the design's "Use Noctura hosted prover", its disclosure sheet and the "Local prover slow?" link that leads there are not built; the failed state has "Retry on this device" only. **Said loudly for the owner's design.**
  - **The six `onStage` stages map onto the design's four rows** (checking, keyFiles, precheck, commitment → "Build witness"; proving → "Prove"; verifying → "Verify locally"; the returned deposit → "Ready"), the live sub-step named in row 1's meta. The brief's "sync / keys / proof / ready" is this mapping: the pre-check's sync and the key files are row 1. Cost if wrong: copy.
  - **The SOL a deposit costs is shown as what it is:** the network fee 0.000005 SOL (one signature, no CU price — Task 4's tx sets only the limit) and the rho marker's rent ≈ 0.00069596 SOL, both read back in `screenSupport.test.ts` from the landed deposit `3DR6F7oW…` (the fee from `meta.fee`; the rent from the one account the tx created; the depositor paid exactly their sum) — never computed by the code under test. "ZK proof fee: None · made on this device" keeps the design's row with the truth. The token amount is shielded exactly (the v1 screen subtracted a SOL fee from the token amount). #16 refuses (warning, CTA off) when the SOL balance is below fee + rent.
  - **The shielded balance is the A0 view's (`useA0Shielded`), and only in the startup step's `ready` phase** (Task 4's rule); `running`, `idle`, `error` and `unsupported` are each a stated state; `idle` and `error` offer Retry (`retryA0Startup`: one keychain read, `ensureA0Startup`) — so no screen waits on a state that never changes (the M1a splash-hang lesson). A store read that throws in `ready` is an error with its code, never 0.
  - **Hidden at the route, not the button.** The shield routes (#17, #16, #18–#21) are registered only when `isShieldedEnabled()` (before this task #16, #17 and #18 were registered in every build); `ShieldedTransfer`, `ShieldedBalance`, `Deposit` and any `Withdraw` have no route in any build — even with `SHIELDED_TRANSFER=true`; the deep links are `deposit` → #16 only (devnet build). #16 has no public side at all and its route ignores `direction`. `shieldedRoutes.test.tsx` renders the REAL `RootNavigator` (only the splash stubbed) and reads its route names, navigates to a hidden name (nothing happens; positive control: a shield route does) and resolves the real deep-link config with React Navigation's `getStateFromPath`.
  - **The v1-only screens are deleted, not rewired:** `DepositScreen` (an undesigned form duplicating #16, reached only by the `deposit` deep link), `ShieldedTransferScreen` (the v1 transfer, M2's to rebuild) and `ShieldedBalanceScreen` (unreachable from the UI; it read `walletStore.shieldedBalances`, which nothing writes, and offered Deposit / Send / Withdraw). Keeping them would mean keeping v1 imports in screens or stubbing them.
  - **The dashboard's shielded mode is changed only to say what is true** (#11 is M1d's): its balance, assets row and anonymity set came from the v1 store / the NPkc pool — after A0's first run (Task 3 clears the v1 notes) they would show 0 next to a real A0 note. They now read the A0 view and the A0 tree; the v1 warm-up effect (`syncLeaves`, `warmProver` = the hosted `/zk/warm`, `scanIncomingNotes`) is gone; there is no Send action in shielded mode (the shielded transfer is hidden), and Send from the transparent mode is always the transparent send. This is §12's budgeted `DashboardScreen` edit, done here because the screen had to stop showing v1 numbers.
  - **The token is called "TEST" (`A0_TOKEN`)** — devnet's A0 mint `ERkp…` stands in for NOC; `poolTokenMeta` keys "TEST" on the env's `SHIELDED_DEVNET_MINT` (v1's mint), so it is not used. The S13 work may name the devnet build's token once for both.
- **Measured facts:** the design's ids are `s16`…`s21` (`#s16 .phone` ×5, `#s18` ×7, `#s19` ×5, `#s20` ×4, `#s21` ×4), counted without reading text. `RootNavigator` renders in Jest with only `SplashScreen` mocked (Splash is the initial route; no other screen mounts) — 14 routes in a production render. `jest.isolateModules` cannot be used to re-render the navigator under other flags (a second React instance: "Cannot read properties of null (reading 'useId')"); the navigator reads `isShieldedEnabled()` while rendering, so the test flips a mock flag instead, and only the deep-link config (built at import) is loaded in isolation. The privacy guard caught this task's own first draft: two doc comments quoting the design's refused copy ("… sender unlink…") failed `privacyClaims.test.ts` — the comments now describe it without the word; the guard's regexes are unchanged.
- **Deviations from the brief:** the intent is a sibling type, not a variant (ruling above, with the measured reason). The brief's row 6 is this task (the controller's swap). No Android build was needed.
- **What the next task must know:** Interfaces → "What later tasks rely on". In short: (1) after this task the v1 shielded modules are imported by no screen except `NativeProveDebugScreen` (debug, route-gated), and the now-unused components `PrivacyMeter` / `ShieldedAddressInput`; `ReceiveScreen`'s shielded option still shows the v1 `WALLET_SHIELDED_ADDRESS` (I9 — the removals task hides it); (2) `isShieldedTransferEnabled`, `FEATURES.shieldedTransfer` and `walletStore.shieldedBalances` are read by no route any more (the wipe screen's `hasShieldedFunds` reads the latter and is therefore always false — an A0 note survives a wipe only through the seed: say so in the wipe copy or read A0 there, the removals task decides); (3) the deposit's explorer link (`ShieldStatusScreen.tsx`) is the one place S13's devnet link helper replaces; (4) `ShieldUnshieldScreen`'s Navigator wrapper ignores `direction` — M1c re-adds the public side with its own param.
- **The owner's visual pass (undrawn or changed surfaces, to look at on the phone at Task 7's checkpoint):**
  1. #16: the single "Make private" tab (full width); the shielded-balance line and its four state banners (restoring / not loaded + Retry / could not be restored · code + Retry / no prover); the "Deposit record rent" fee row; "ZK proof fee · None · made on this device"; "Notes in the pool after this deposit" without the meter; the "Not enough SOL" warning; no USD lines.
  2. #18: the stage rows with measured times instead of "%"; the auth state ("waiting for you to unlock"); the failed state with one CTA and the E_A0 code in the hero and on the failing row; no "Local prover slow?".
  3. #19: the "A public deposit · PUBLIC" privacy row; the CU in the eyebrow; the failed state without "Continue anyway"; "Nothing to review".
  4. #20: FROM / TO / SIGNS / NETWORK rows; the caption; the stale state.
  5. #21: "Not confirmed yet" (PENDING), "Not shielded", "Not sent", "Nothing to send"; the Position and Fees rows.

- **Stated limits:**
  - The shielded copy outside `src/screens/shielded/` (the dashboard footer and hero states) is not under the privacy guard — §11 widens the guard in M1c; the strings added there claim nothing (they say "public on chain").
  - A cancelled biometric at #21 (the second keychain read) ends the flow at "Not sent" with the prepared deposit already taken: the user starts again at #16 (nothing was written or sent). Keeping the deposit for a retry would re-open the double-submit door the take closes.
  - `ShieldStatusScreen` does not show a separate "slow" state after 90 s (screen.md's #54 redirect): `submitA0Deposit`'s polling confirm ends in an outcome (unspent / pending), and a pending note is the reconciliation's.

The guard's lists are where a v1 name would come back — a new A0 module must not reuse a removed module path (`shielded/noteStore.ts`, …): the guard resolves imports and would flag it.
  - **M2:** the shielded Receive is to be rebuilt (route param, dashboard action); `ReceiveScreen`'s `shielded` prop is the M1b-era presentational code, not a working path. `noteEncryption.ts` still carries the v1 payload `{amount, noteSecret}` (an allowed name in the guard, for that file and its two suites only) — M2 revalidates it and then removes it from the guard's exceptions.

**The rule, stated once.** After this task the app has one shielded path, A0, and one chain per build: `NETWORK` names the cluster the RPC is on, every screen that names a network reads it, every explorer link carries it, and a value that is missing, misspelled or incoherent with shielded mode refuses to start rather than guessing mainnet. What exists only on mainnet — presale and the rest of the Phase 1 program — has no route, no link and no request in the devnet build. Nothing of v1 remains reachable: its files are gone, a Jest guard resolves every import and reads every code file for their names, and what an older install left in storage (the v1 receive address, the v1 sync caches, the v1 proof queue's record of witnesses) is removed at unlock.

- [ ] **Step 1: Inventory the v1 path by its import graph (measured, not assumed).**

Before deleting anything, resolve every relative import of `src/` and walk the graph from `index.js` (an offline script; it reads files only):

```bash
node scratchpad/t6/graph.mjs . unreach   # production files no path from index.js reaches
node scratchpad/t6/graph.mjs . who src/modules/shielded/shieldedIdentity.ts
```

(`graph.mjs`, a scratch script, not committed — run from the repository root:)

```js
import fs from 'fs'; import path from 'path';
const root = process.argv[2]; process.chdir(root);
const exts=['.ts','.tsx','.js','/index.ts','/index.tsx','/index.js'];
function resolve(from, spec){ if(!spec.startsWith('.')) return null; const b=path.normalize(path.join(path.dirname(from),spec)); if(fs.existsSync(b)&&fs.statSync(b).isFile()) return b; for(const e of exts){ if(fs.existsSync(b+e)) return b+e;} return null;}
const graph={};
function walk(d){ for(const f of fs.readdirSync(d)){ const p=path.join(d,f); if(f==='node_modules') continue; const s=fs.statSync(p); if(s.isDirectory()) walk(p); else if(/\.(tsx?|js)$/.test(f)) { const src=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'); const deps=[]; for(const m of src.matchAll(/(?:from\s+|import\s*\(\s*|require\(\s*|import\s+)'([^']+)'/g)){ const r=resolve(p,m[1]); if(r) deps.push(r);} graph[p]=deps; } } }
walk('src'); graph['index.js']=[]; { const src=fs.readFileSync('index.js','utf8'); for(const m of src.matchAll(/(?:from\s+|import\s+|require\()'([^']+)'/g)){const r=resolve('index.js',m[1]); if(r) graph['index.js'].push(r);} }
const isTest=p=>/__tests__|__testing__|\.test\./.test(p);
const seen=new Set(); const st=['index.js']; while(st.length){const n=st.pop(); if(seen.has(n)) continue; seen.add(n); for(const d of graph[n]||[]) if(!isTest(d)) st.push(d);}
const mode=process.argv[3];
if(mode==='unreach'){ for(const p of Object.keys(graph)) if(!seen.has(p)&&!isTest(p)) console.log(p);} 
else if(mode==='who'){ const t=process.argv[4]; for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(graph)) if(v.includes(t)) console.log(k);} 
else if(mode==='deps'){ const t=process.argv[4]; const s2=new Set(); const q=[t]; while(q.length){const n=q.pop(); if(s2.has(n)) continue; s2.add(n); for(const d of graph[n]||[]) q.push(d);} console.log([...s2].sort().join('\n'));}
```
 At the base `43f45c5` it measured:
- **unreachable from `index.js`** (only tests import them): the v1 `depositEvents`, `depositFlow`, `fieldCodec`, `leafResolver`, `merkleSync`, `merkleTreeAccount`, `noteCiphertextEvents`, `noteEncryption`, `noteScan`, `noteSelect`, `noteStore`, `poolInstructions`, `poolPdas`, `poolState`, `poolTokens`, `poolTx`, `privacyMeter`, `relayerSubmit`, `shieldedBalances`, `transferFlow`, `transferWitness`, `types`, `withdrawChangeWitness`, `withdrawFlow`, `withdrawWitness`, `zkManifest`, `solana/relayer.ts`, `components/{PrivacyMeter,ShieldedAddressInput,ProofProgressOverlay}.tsx` (plus pre-existing dead files outside §12 — `BalanceCard`, `QuickActions`, `deepLinkModule`, … — not touched);
- **still reachable, through four import sites**: `secureStorageSession.ts` → `shieldedViewSession` / `shieldedIdentity` / `shieldedAddressCodec` (→ `noteCrypto`); `sessionStore.ts` → `shieldedViewSession`; `NativeProveDebugScreen.tsx` → `depositWitness`, `zkProverModule` (→ `proofQueue`, `localProver`), `constants/programs`' `SHIELDED_DEVNET_MINT`; `Navigator.tsx` → `ExportViewKeyScreen`, `NativeProveDebugScreen`;

**4b — create (the new module and the new suites, in full):**

`src/app/__tests__/presaleRoutes.test.tsx`:

```ts
/**
 * Presale is DISABLED in the devnet build (spec S13): presale — and the rest of the Phase 1
 * program's surfaces, staking, the purchase geo gate and the presale referral — exists on mainnet
 * only, so in a build whose chain is devnet their ROUTES are not registered (unreachable by name
 * or by deep link), onboarding goes straight to the wallet, and the deep-link config has no path
 * for them. The REAL RootNavigator renders (its screens stubbed); the nested stacks' route names
 * are read after navigating into them. Every case runs both ways (mainnet = the positive control).
 */
import React from 'react';
import {render, act} from '@testing-library/react-native';
import {NavigationContainer, createNavigationContainerRef, getStateFromPath} from '@react-navigation/native';
import type {LinkingOptions, NavigationState, PartialState} from '@react-navigation/native';
import {RootNavigator} from '../Navigator';

jest.mock('../../screens/SplashScreen', () => ({SplashScreen: () => null}));
jest.mock('../../screens/dashboard/DashboardScreen', () => ({DashboardScreen: () => null}));
jest.mock('../../screens/onboarding/WelcomeScreen', () => ({WelcomeScreen: () => null}));
jest.mock('../../screens/settings/SettingsScreen', () => ({SettingsScreen: () => null}));
jest.mock('../../screens/PresaleScreen', () => ({PresaleScreen: () => null}));
// Success completes on mount, so the test sees where onboarding goes next.
jest.mock('../../screens/onboarding/SuccessScreen', () => ({
  SuccessScreen: ({onComplete}: {onComplete: () => void}) => {
    const R = jest.requireActual('react') as typeof React;
    R.useEffect(() => onComplete(), [onComplete]);
    return null;
  },
}));

let mockPresale = true;
jest.mock('../../constants/chain', () => {
  const actual = jest.requireActual('../../constants/chain');
  return {...actual, isPresaleEnabled: () => mockPresale};
});

/** The Phase 1 program's routes (mainnet only). */
const DASHBOARD_PRESALE = ['Presale', 'PresaleBuyConfirm', 'PresaleBuyStatus', 'Staking', 'GeoBlocked'];

type AnyState = NavigationState | PartialState<NavigationState> | undefined;
function findNested(state: AnyState, name: string): AnyState {
  for (const r of state?.routes ?? []) {
    if (r.name === name) {
      return r.state as AnyState;
    }
    const inner = findNested(r.state as AnyState, name);
    if (inner) {
      return inner;
    }
  }
  return undefined;
}

function mount(presale: boolean) {
  mockPresale = presale;
  const ref = createNavigationContainerRef();
  render(
    <NavigationContainer ref={ref}>
      <RootNavigator />
    </NavigationContainer>,
  );
  const go = (name: string, params?: object) =>
    act(() => {
      (ref.navigate as (n: string, p?: object) => void)(name, params);
    });
  return {ref, go};
}

describe('presale routes follow the chain (S13)', () => {
  it.each([
    [false, 'devnet'],
    [true, 'mainnet'],
  ])('dashboard stack, presale=%s (%s)', (presale) => {
    const {ref, go} = mount(presale);
    go('MainTabs');
    const home = findNested(ref.getRootState(), 'HomeTab');
    const names = (home?.routeNames ?? []) as string[];
    expect(names).toContain('Dashboard'); // non-vacuous: the stack was read
    for (const r of DASHBOARD_PRESALE) {
      expect(names.includes(r)).toBe(presale);
    }
  });

  it.each([
    [false, 'devnet'],
    [true, 'mainnet'],
  ])('settings stack: the presale referral, presale=%s (%s)', (presale) => {
    const {ref, go} = mount(presale);
    go('MainTabs', {screen: 'ProfileTab'});
    const profile = findNested(ref.getRootState(), 'ProfileTab');
    const names = (profile?.routeNames ?? []) as string[];
    expect(names).toContain('Settings');
    expect(names.includes('Referral')).toBe(presale);
    // the removed screens have no route in any build
    expect(names).not.toContain('ExportViewKey');
    expect(names).not.toContain('NativeProveDebug');
  });

  it.each([
    [false, 'devnet'],
    [true, 'mainnet'],
  ])('onboarding stack: the Presale step, presale=%s (%s)', (presale) => {
    const {ref, go} = mount(presale);
    go('Onboarding');
    const names = (findNested(ref.getRootState(), 'Onboarding')?.routeNames ?? []) as string[];
    expect(names).toContain('Welcome');
    expect(names.includes('Presale')).toBe(presale);
  });

  it('devnet: onboarding has no Presale step and Success goes straight to the wallet', () => {
    const {ref, go} = mount(false);
    go('Onboarding', {screen: 'Success'});
    const root = ref.getRootState();
    expect(root?.routes[root.index ?? 0]?.name).toBe('MainTabs');
    expect(findNested(root, 'Onboarding')).toBeUndefined(); // replaced, not stacked
  });

  it('mainnet (control): Success goes to the Presale step', () => {
    const {ref, go} = mount(true);
    go('Onboarding', {screen: 'Success'});
    const onboarding = findNested(ref.getRootState(), 'Onboarding');
    expect(onboarding?.routeNames).toContain('Presale');
    const routes = (onboarding?.routes ?? []).map(r => r.name);
    expect(routes[routes.length - 1]).toBe('Presale');
  });

  it('devnet: navigating to Presale by name goes nowhere (positive control: Dashboard is there)', () => {
    const {ref, go} = mount(false);
    go('MainTabs');
    const err = jest.spyOn(console, 'error').mockImplementation(() => {});
    go('Presale');
    go('Staking');
    const home = findNested(ref.getRootState(), 'HomeTab');
    expect((home?.routes ?? []).map(r => r.name)).toEqual(['Dashboard']);
    err.mockRestore();
  });
});

describe('presale deep links follow the chain (S13)', () => {
  const resolve = (presale: boolean, path: string): string[] => {
    mockPresale = presale;
    let links: typeof import('../deepLinkConfig') | null = null;
    jest.isolateModules(() => {
      links = require('../deepLinkConfig');
    });
    const state = getStateFromPath(path, (links!.deepLinkConfig as LinkingOptions<object>).config);
    const names: string[] = [];
    const walk = (s: AnyState) =>
      s?.routes.forEach(r => {
        names.push(r.name);
        walk(r.state as AnyState);
      });
    walk(state as AnyState);
    return names;
  };

  it.each([
    ['presale', 'Presale'],
    ['stake', 'Staking'],
    ['referral', 'Referral'],
```

`src/constants/chain.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * The build's chain identity (spec S13): which Solana cluster this build talks to, as the
 * screens name it and as explorer links carry it — read from NETWORK, which programs.ts
 * refuses at import unless it is exactly `devnet` or `mainnet-beta` (networkGuard: an unknown or
 * missing value never falls back to mainnet).
 *
 * Separate from presale on purpose. The devnet build used to set NETWORK=mainnet-beta so the
 * presale constants would not hit their devnet placeholders, and so it said "Solana mainnet" and
 * linked mainnet explorers over devnet transactions. Now NETWORK says what the RPC is on, and
 * presale — which exists on mainnet only — is simply not offered on devnet.
 */
import {NETWORK} from './programs';
import type {KnownNetwork} from './networkGuard';

export interface ChainIdentity {
  readonly network: KnownNetwork;
  /** The network as a screen names it ("Network" rows, "Confirmed on …"). */
  readonly label: 'Solana devnet' | 'Solana mainnet';
  /** The short form for "Simulating on … RPC". */
  readonly short: 'devnet' | 'mainnet';
}

export function chainIdentity(network: KnownNetwork): ChainIdentity {
  return network === 'devnet'
    ? {network, label: 'Solana devnet', short: 'devnet'}
    : {network, label: 'Solana mainnet', short: 'mainnet'};
}

/** This build's chain. */
export const CHAIN: ChainIdentity = chainIdentity(NETWORK);

/**
 * Presale, and every surface of the Phase 1 program it belongs to (staking, the presale
 * referral, the purchase geo gate), exists on mainnet only: there is no devnet deployment, so
 * the devnet build does not offer it (S13: disabled, never run on placeholders).
 */
export function isPresaleEnabled(network: KnownNetwork = NETWORK): boolean {
  return network === 'mainnet-beta';
}

export type Explorer = 'solscan' | 'solanaexplorer' | 'solanafm';

const TX_BASE: Record<Explorer, string> = {
  solscan: 'https://solscan.io/tx/',
  solanaexplorer: 'https://explorer.solana.com/tx/',
  solanafm: 'https://solana.fm/tx/',
};

/**
 * A transaction's explorer link on this build's chain. On devnet every link carries
 * `?cluster=devnet` — the query Solscan and the Solana Explorer read; Solana FM's devnet
 * parameter is not that one, so on devnet a Solana FM choice links the Solana Explorer instead
 * (a link without its cluster would open the mainnet page of a devnet signature).
 */
export function explorerTxUrl(
  signature: string,
  explorer: Explorer = 'solscan',
  network: KnownNetwork = NETWORK,
): string {
  if (network === 'devnet') {
    const base = explorer === 'solanafm' ? TX_BASE.solanaexplorer : TX_BASE[explorer];
    return `${base}${signature}?cluster=devnet`;
  }
  return `${TX_BASE[explorer]}${signature}`;
}
```

`src/modules/shielded/__tests__/v1Removed.test.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * The v1 shielded path is gone and stays gone (spec 2026-11-08 shielded A0 M1 §12, every removal
 * tagged M1b): the NPkc… pool, its instruction builders, flows, witnesses, note schema, note
 * scanning, view session and identity, the v1 asset set and the hosted-proof client, the v1 native
 * prover (its JS call, its React method, its JNI binding, its Rust code and its examples), the
 * self-relay and transfer flags, the v1 lookup-table relayer client, the Export View Key and native
 * prover debug screens, the devnet presale placeholders (S13), and the v1 view key (its EIP-2333
 * derivation in JS and its keychain entry — the A0 keys are derived inside the Rust core).
 *
 * Read three ways, like M1a's keyModuleRemoved guard:
 *  1. the removed FILES do not exist;
 *  2. no code file IMPORTS a removed module — every relative import / require / jest.mock / import()
 *     specifier under the code trees is resolved against its file and compared with the removed
 *     paths (so `a0/noteStore` stays legal while the v1 `shielded/noteStore` is caught);
 *  3. no code file NAMES a removed symbol — a list of patterns over the whole text, comments
 *     included (a comment naming a removed call is how a removal starts to be reverted).
 * Markdown (history, plans, specs) is not code and is not read. Each reading has a positive control.
 */
import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';

const ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, '../../../..');
const SELF = path.relative(ROOT, __filename);

/** The removed files (§12 M1b), extension included. */
const REMOVED_FILES = [
  ...[
    'depositEvents', 'depositFlow', 'depositWitness', 'fieldCodec', 'leafResolver', 'merkleSync',
    'merkleTreeAccount', 'noteCiphertextEvents', 'noteCrypto', 'noteScan', 'noteSelect', 'noteStore',
    'poolInstructions', 'poolPdas', 'poolState', 'poolTokens', 'poolTx', 'privacyMeter',
    'relayerSubmit', 'shieldedAddressCodec', 'shieldedBalances', 'shieldedIdentity',
    'shieldedViewSession', 'transferFlow', 'transferWitness', 'types', 'withdrawChangeWitness',
    'withdrawFlow', 'withdrawWitness',
  ].map(m => `src/modules/shielded/${m}.ts`),
  'src/modules/zkProver/zkProverModule.ts',
  'src/modules/zkProver/proofQueue.ts',
  'src/modules/zkProver/localProver.ts',
  'src/modules/zkProver/types.ts',
  'src/constants/provingAssets.ts',
  'src/modules/solana/relayer.ts',
  'src/screens/debug/NativeProveDebugScreen.tsx',
  'src/screens/settings/ExportViewKeyScreen.tsx',
  'src/components/PrivacyMeter.tsx',
  'src/components/ShieldedAddressInput.tsx',
  'src/components/ProofProgressOverlay.tsx',
  'native/noctura-prover/src/prover.rs',
  'native/noctura-prover/tests/prove_to_bytes.rs',
  'native/noctura-prover/examples/deposit_prove.rs',
  'native/noctura-prover/examples/onchain_format_check.rs',
  'native/noctura-prover/examples/zkey_check.rs',
  'native/noctura-prover/artifacts/deposit_input.json',
  'android/app/src/test/java/com/nocturawallet/prover/ProveV1RemovedTest.kt',
  // the v1 view-key path (controller ruling on Task 6 concern 4)
  'src/modules/keyDerivation/shielded.ts',
];
const REMOVED_MODULES = new Set(
  REMOVED_FILES.filter(f => /\.(ts|tsx)$/.test(f)).map(f => f.replace(/\.(ts|tsx)$/, '')),
);

/** Names of removed things. Comments count: see the header. */
const FORBIDDEN: Array<[string, RegExp]> = [
  ['the v1 pool program', /NPkc/],
  ['the v1 spend secret', /noteSecret/],
  ['the v1 native prove', /\bnativeProve\b|\bproveV1\b|E_V1_REMOVED|prove_to_bytes|crate::prover\b|\bprover::prove/],
  ['the v1 prover RNG', /seed_from_u64\(0\)/],
  ['a removed flag', /SHIELDED_RELAYER|shieldedRelayer|SHIELDED_TRANSFER|shieldedTransfer|isShieldedTransferEnabled|NATIVE_PROVER_DEBUG|SHIELDED_DEVNET_MINT/],
  ['a removed screen', /NativeProveDebug|\bExportViewKey(Screen)?\b/],
  ['the v1 state', /shieldedBalances|primeViewSession|ShieldedViewSession|SHIELDED_ADDRESS_HRP|SHIELDED_POOL_PROGRAM_ID|SHIELDED_POOL_MINTS/],
  ['the v1 asset set / hosted proving', /ZKEY_ASSETS\b|ensureCircuitAssets|constants\/provingAssets|proveShielded|warmProver/],
  ['a devnet placeholder', /TODO_DEVNET/],
  ['the v1 view key', /deriveShieldedViewKey|deriveDisclosureKey|storeViewKey|retrieveViewKey|keyDerivation\/shielded\b/],
];

/**
 * The files allowed to carry one named pattern, each with its reason. Nothing else is exempt.
 *  - noteEncryption is KEPT (spec §12 "Kept but unused in M1": M2 revalidates its v1 payload);
 *  - the A0 store's tests assert that no `noteSecret` field is stored and that a v1 record is cleared;
 *  - the route tests assert that the removed screens have no route.
 */
const ALLOWED: Record<string, string[]> = {
  'src/modules/shielded/noteEncryption.ts': ['the v1 spend secret'],
  'src/modules/shielded/__tests__/noteEncryption.test.ts': ['the v1 spend secret'],
  'src/modules/shielded/__tests__/noteEncryption.golden.test.ts': ['the v1 spend secret'],
  'src/modules/shielded/a0/__tests__/noteStore.test.ts': ['the v1 spend secret'],
  'src/app/__tests__/presaleRoutes.test.tsx': ['a removed screen'],
};

const TREES = ['src', 'android', 'native/noctura-prover', 'scripts', '.github', '__mocks__', 'index.js', 'globalBuffer.js', 'package.json', 'jest.config.js'];
const SKIP_DIRS = new Set(['node_modules', 'build', '.gradle', '.cxx', 'Pods', 'target', 'artifacts', 'jniLibs', '.kotlin', 'fixtures']);
const CODE = /\.(ts|tsx|js|mjs|cjs|json|kt|kts|java|gradle|properties|rs|toml|map|sh|txt|yml|yaml|xml|pro)$/;

function walk(rel: string, out: string[]): void {
  const abs = path.join(ROOT, rel);
  if (!fs.existsSync(abs)) {
    return;
  }
  const st = fs.statSync(abs);
  if (st.isFile()) {
    if (CODE.test(path.basename(rel)) && rel !== SELF) {
      out.push(rel);
    }
    return;
  }
  for (const name of fs.readdirSync(abs)) {
    if (!SKIP_DIRS.has(name)) {
      walk(path.join(rel, name), out);
    }
  }
}

function findings(text: string): string[] {
  return FORBIDDEN.filter(([, re]) => re.test(text)).map(([what]) => what);
}

/** Every module specifier a JS/TS file names (import, export … from, require, jest.mock, import()). */
function specifiers(text: string): string[] {
  const re = /(?:\bfrom\s+|\bimport\s+|\brequire\(\s*|\bjest\.(?:mock|doMock|requireActual|requireMock)\(\s*|\bimport\(\s*)['"]([^'"]+)['"]/g;
  return [...text.matchAll(re)].map(m => m[1]!);
}

/** The repo-relative module a specifier names (extension and /index stripped), or null if external. */
function resolveModule(fromFile: string, spec: string): string | null {
  let target: string;
  if (spec.startsWith('.')) {
    target = path.normalize(path.join(path.dirname(fromFile), spec));
  } else if (spec.startsWith('@/')) {
    target = path.normalize(path.join('src', spec.slice(2)));
  } else {
    return null;
  }
  return target.replace(/\.(ts|tsx|js|mjs)$/, '').replace(/\/index$/, '');
}

function removedImports(file: string, text: string): string[] {
  return specifiers(text)
    .map(s => resolveModule(file, s))
    .filter((m): m is string => m !== null && REMOVED_MODULES.has(m));
}

const files: string[] = [];
TREES.forEach(t => walk(t, files));
const JS = files.filter(f => /\.(ts|tsx|js|mjs|cjs)$/.test(f));

describe('the v1 shielded path (§12 M1b) is removed', () => {
  it('reads the trees it claims to (non-vacuous)', () => {
    expect(files.length).toBeGreaterThan(300);
    for (const known of [
      'src/modules/shielded/a0/noteStore.ts',
      'src/modules/shielded/a0/depositFlow.ts',
      'src/modules/zkProver/nativeProverBridge.ts',
      'native/noctura-prover/src/android.rs',
      'native/noctura-prover/jni-exports.txt',
      'android/app/src/main/java/com/nocturawallet/prover/NocturaProverModule.kt',
      '.github/workflows/native-prover.yml',
      'scripts/mutation-sweep.mjs',
    ]) {
      expect(files).toContain(known);
    }
  });

  it('its files are gone', () => {
    const present = REMOVED_FILES.filter(f => fs.existsSync(path.join(ROOT, f)));
    expect(present).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('no code file imports a removed module (resolved, so a0/noteStore is not v1 noteStore)', () => {
    const hits = JS.map(f => ({f, m: removedImports(f, fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, f), 'utf8'))})).filter(h => h.m.length > 0);
    expect(hits).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('no code file names a removed thing (outside the listed exceptions)', () => {
    const hits = files
      .map(f => {
        const allowed = ALLOWED[f] ?? [];
        return {f, what: findings(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, f), 'utf8')).filter(w => !allowed.includes(w))};
      })
      .filter(h => h.what.length > 0);
    expect(hits).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('every exception is still needed (a stale exception would hide a reference)', () => {
    for (const [f, labels] of Object.entries(ALLOWED)) {
      const found = findings(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, f), 'utf8'));
      for (const l of labels) {
        expect(`${f}: ${found.includes(l) ? l : 'unused'}`).toBe(`${f}: ${l}`);
      }
    }
  });
});

describe('the readers can fail (positive controls)', () => {
  it('the import resolver catches a v1 import from inside and outside shielded/, and not the A0 namesakes', () => {
    expect(removedImports('src/modules/shielded/eventLogs.ts', "import {x} from './noteStore';")).toEqual(['src/modules/shielded/noteStore']);
    expect(removedImports('src/screens/dashboard/DashboardScreen.tsx', "import {scanIncomingNotes} from '../../modules/shielded/noteScan';")).toEqual([
      'src/modules/shielded/noteScan',
    ]);
    expect(removedImports('src/store/zustand/sessionStore.ts', "jest.mock('../../modules/shielded/shieldedViewSession')")).toEqual([
      'src/modules/shielded/shieldedViewSession',
    ]);
    expect(removedImports('src/x.ts', "const m = require('./constants/provingAssets.ts');")).toEqual(['src/constants/provingAssets']);
    expect(removedImports('src/x.ts', "import('@/modules/zkProver/zkProverModule')")).toEqual(['src/modules/zkProver/zkProverModule']);
    // not removed: the A0 store / flow, the kept modules
    expect(removedImports('src/modules/shielded/a0/startup.ts', "import {x} from './noteStore';")).toEqual([]);
    expect(removedImports('src/modules/shielded/a0/startup.ts', "import {x} from './depositFlow';")).toEqual([]);
    expect(removedImports('src/modules/shielded/a0/syncedTx.ts', "import {poolLeafBlobs} from '../eventLogs';")).toEqual([]);
    expect(removedImports('src/x.ts', "import {Connection} from '@solana/web3.js';")).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('the name patterns flag each kind', () => {
    expect(findings("const SHIELDED_POOL_PROGRAM_ID = 'NPkcpUdnm1JZhndur3ggQZwo86yWgcU6Ry28T3zHfES';")).toEqual(['the v1 pool program', 'the v1 state']);
    expect(findings('note.noteSecret')).toEqual(['the v1 spend secret']);
    expect(findings('export async function nativeProve(')).toEqual(['the v1 native prove']);
    expect(findings('fun proveV1(')).toEqual(['the v1 native prove']);
    expect(findings('let out = crate::prover::prove_to_bytes(&cid, &wj, &zk, &wp)?;')).toEqual(['the v1 native prove']);
    expect(findings('StdRng::seed_from_u64(0)')).toEqual(['the v1 prover RNG']);
    expect(findings("shieldedRelayer: Config.SHIELDED_RELAYER === 'true'")).toEqual(['a removed flag']);
    expect(findings("navigation.navigate('ExportViewKey')")).toEqual(['a removed screen']);
    expect(findings('const {shieldedBalances} = useWalletStore();')).toEqual(['the v1 state']);
    expect(findings('await ensureCircuitAssets(id, io)')).toEqual(['the v1 asset set / hosted proving']);
    expect(findings("? 'TODO_DEVNET_MINT'")).toEqual(['a devnet placeholder']);
    expect(findings('const viewKey = deriveShieldedViewKey(seed);')).toEqual(['the v1 view key']);
    expect(findings('await keychainManager.storeViewKey(viewKeyRef.current);')).toEqual(['the v1 view key']);
    expect(removedImports('src/screens/onboarding/SuccessScreen.tsx', "import {x} from '../../modules/keyDerivation/shielded';")).toEqual([
      'src/modules/keyDerivation/shielded',
    ]);
    // not references: the A0 names, the disabled row's label, the seeded test RNGs
    expect(findings('a0Prove(handle, circuit, witnessJson, null, z, w)')).toEqual([]);
    expect(findings('label="Export View Key"')).toEqual([]);
    expect(findings('StdRng::seed_from_u64(7)')).toEqual([]);
    expect(findings("Java_com_nocturawallet_prover_NocturaProverModule_nativeIsSupported")).toEqual([]);
    expect(findings('await keychainManager.dropV1ViewKey();')).toEqual([]);
  });
});
```

```ts
/**
 * A missing RPC_ENDPOINT falls back to the public endpoint of the build's chain (S13): a devnet
 * build never talks to mainnet under a devnet label.
 */
const mockConnection = jest.fn();
jest.mock('@solana/web3.js', () => ({Connection: function C(...a: unknown[]) { mockConnection(...a); }}));

function connectWith(config: Record<string, string | undefined>): unknown[] {
  jest.resetModules();
  mockConnection.mockClear();
  jest.doMock('react-native-config', () => ({__esModule: true, default: {API_BASE: 'https://x/v1', ...config}}));
  const warn = jest.spyOn(console, 'warn').mockImplementation(() => {});
  (require('../connection') as typeof import('../connection')).getConnection();
  warn.mockRestore();
  return mockConnection.mock.calls[0]!;
}

afterEach(() => {
  jest.dontMock('react-native-config');
  jest.resetModules();
});

it('devnet without an RPC_ENDPOINT → the public DEVNET endpoint (http and ws)', () => {
  const [endpoint, opts] = connectWith({NETWORK: 'devnet'});
  expect(endpoint).toBe('https://api.devnet.solana.com');
  expect((opts as {wsEndpoint: string}).wsEndpoint).toBe('wss://api.devnet.solana.com');
});

it('mainnet-beta without an RPC_ENDPOINT → the public mainnet endpoint', () => {
  const [endpoint] = connectWith({NETWORK: 'mainnet-beta'});
  expect(endpoint).toBe('https://api.mainnet-beta.solana.com');
});

it('a configured RPC_ENDPOINT is used as is', () => {
  const [endpoint] = connectWith({NETWORK: 'devnet', HELIUS_RPC_URL: 'https://devnet.example/rpc', HELIUS_WS_URL: 'wss://devnet.example/rpc'});
  expect(endpoint).toBe('https://devnet.example/rpc');
});
```

```diff
+/**
+ * What wiping the app would lose from this store (the wipe warning, WipeWalletScreen) — read
+ * WITHOUT any write, never throws:
+ *  - `'notes'` — an `unspent` or `pending` note is recorded (a pending deposit may be landing);
+ *  - `'unreadable'` — the encrypted store is not open or the record does not decode: what it
+ *    holds is unknown, so the caller must warn as if it held notes;
+ *  - `'none'` — no record, or a record with only `spent` notes.
+ * Notes are recoverable from the seed phrase (restore), which is what the warning must say.
+ */
+export function a0WipeRisk(): 'none' | 'notes' | 'unreadable' {
+  const store = mmkvSecure();
+  if (!store) {
+    return 'unreadable';
+  }
+  const raw = store.getString(KEY);
+  if (raw === undefined) {
+    return 'none';
+  }
+  try {
+    return decode(raw).notes.some(n => n.status !== 'spent') ? 'notes' : 'none';
+  } catch {
+    return 'unreadable';
+  }
+}
```

```diff
+/** Big-endian bytes → BigInt, no reduction (byte[0] most significant). */
+function bytesToBigIntBE(bytes: Uint8Array): bigint {
+  let acc = 0n;
```

```diff
+
+/**
+ * A pinned URL must NAME the bytes it points at (`/h/<sha256>/`). The pin sets build their URLs
+ * from the digest, so this catches a literal written by hand later — a mutable pointer under an
+ * immutable promise. Run at import by each pin set.
+ */
+export function assertContentAddressed(assets: Readonly<Record<string, CircuitAssets>>): void {
+  for (const [id, circuit] of Object.entries(assets)) {
+    for (const [kind, asset] of Object.entries(circuit) as Array<[string, PinnedAsset]>) {
+      if (!asset.url.includes(`/h/${asset.sha256}/`)) {
+        throw new Error(`${id}.${kind} is pinned to a URL that does not name its digest: ${asset.url}`);
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
```

**4d — the gitignored env files of the BUILD (not committed; Notes give the owner's).** The Android build of Step 7 reads `.env.devnet` / `.env.production` from the checkout root. Before building, `.env.devnet` must be edited (the owner's file still has `NETWORK=mainnet-beta`, which the shielded build now refuses):

```bash
grep -v -E '^(SHIELDED_RELAYER|NATIVE_PROVER_DEBUG|SHIELDED_DEVNET_MINT)=' .env.devnet | sed 's/^NETWORK=mainnet-beta$/NETWORK=devnet/' > .env.devnet.new && mv .env.devnet.new .env.devnet
grep -E '^[A-Z_]+=' .env.devnet | sed -E 's/(api-key=)[^&]*/\1<redacted>/'
```
```
HELIUS_RPC_URL=https://devnet.helius-rpc.com/?api-key=<redacted>
HELIUS_WS_URL=wss://devnet.helius-rpc.com/?api-key=<redacted>
NETWORK=devnet
API_BASE=https://api.noc-tura.io/api/v1
SENTRY_DSN=
FEATURES_SHIELDED=true
LOCAL_PROVING=true
APP_ID_SUFFIX=.devnet
APP_LABEL=Noctura devnet
```
(The dry run did this in its build clone only; the owner's checkout was not touched. In the real execution the owner edits their own file — say so and wait, never edit it unasked.)
