#### Notes for the executor (Task 6)

- **The rulings this task took (each the most secure default; the owner may overturn any):**
  - **S13's chain identity is `NETWORK`, not a new key.** With presale disabled on devnet, nothing needs the devnet build to claim `mainnet-beta` any more, so the existing key says what it always claimed to say: the cluster the RPC is on. A second key (`CHAIN=`) would have kept two network notions — one of them false in the devnet build — and every reader would have to pick the right one. The fail-closed reading is the one `programs.ts` already had (`assertKnownNetwork`: exactly `devnet` or `mainnet-beta`, a missing / misspelled value refuses to start); `constants/chain.ts` derives everything from it. **Added:** shielded mode on any chain but devnet refuses to start (`assertShieldedRequiresDevnet`, at import in `features.ts`) — the A0 pool is a devnet deployment, and an `.env.devnet` left at `NETWORK=mainnet-beta` would otherwise put mainnet labels and mainnet explorer links over devnet transactions again (the S13 bug). Cost if wrong: a devnet build with the old env file does not open (loud, the first thing Task 7 checks).
  - **"Devnet presale constants simply do not exist":** `programs.ts` has no ternaries any more; `NOC_MINT`, `PROGRAM_ID`, `ADMIN_ADDRESS`, `SOL_TREASURY`, `NOCTURA_FEE_TREASURY` are the mainnet literals in every build (the presale modules read `core/presale/addresses` directly anyway). `NOC_MINT` names the token: on devnet no account of it exists, so the devnet dashboard's NOC row shows 0 — true. The `TODO_DEVNET_*` values and their startup warning loop are gone. The unused `PROGRAMS` object and the v1 pool constants (`SHIELDED_POOL_PROGRAM_ID`, `SHIELDED_DEVNET_MINT`, `SHIELDED_POOL_MINTS`, `SHIELDED_ADDRESS_HRP`, `SHIELDED_CU`) are gone; §12's "`SHIELDED_CU` ceilings stay at 200,000 for M1's paths" is `A0_CU = {deposit: 200_000, withdrawChange: 200_000}` in `a0/constants.ts` (Task 1), the only CU table any path reads.
  - **Presale "disabled" = the Phase 1 program's surfaces have no route, no link, no request:** `Presale`, `PresaleBuyConfirm`, `PresaleBuyStatus`, `Staking`, `GeoBlocked` (the purchase geo gate) and the Settings `Referral` (the presale referral) are registered only when `isPresaleEnabled()`; their deep links (`presale`, `stake`, `referral`) likewise; onboarding's Success goes straight to `MainTabs` (it used to push the presale screen); the dashboard gets no `onBuy` / `onPresale`, so no Buy action and no presale banner; `usePresaleSync` makes no request (it read the coordinator's stats and the MAINNET program's allocation through the DEVNET RPC). Staking, the geo gate and the referral are not named by S13: they are the same Phase 1 program (no devnet deployment), so running them on devnet is the same "placeholders" failure — stated here, the owner may narrow it. Cost if wrong: three routes to re-register.
  - **Every screen that names the network reads `CHAIN`:** transparent #20 "Network" (`TxConfirmScreen`), #21 "Submitted to / Confirmed on …" (`TransactionStatusScreen`), #19's "Simulating on … RPC" (`TxSimulateScreen`); the explorer links go through `explorerTxUrl` (`utils/explorerUrl.getExplorerUrl` is now a wrapper of it): on devnet `?cluster=devnet` always — Solscan and the Solana Explorer read that query; Solana FM's devnet parameter is a different one, so on devnet a Solana FM choice links the Solana Explorer (no caller passes Solana FM today; the Settings "Explorer" value is display-only). The shield screens (#19–#21 of Task 5) already said "Solana devnet" — A0 is devnet by fact — and #21's link now uses `explorerTxUrl(sig, 'solanaexplorer', A0.cluster)`. The presale screens' own "Solana mainnet" strings are left: they exist only where presale does. The connection's fallback RPC (when `HELIUS_RPC_URL` is empty) is the chain's public endpoint — it was `api.mainnet-beta` in every build, i.e. a devnet build without its key would have read mainnet under a devnet label.
  - **The v1 removal is by file, guarded three ways** (`v1Removed.test.ts`): the 47 removed files absent; every relative / `@/` import, `require`, `jest.mock`, `import()` of every code file RESOLVED and compared with the removed module paths (a path check, so `a0/noteStore` — the A0 store — stays legal while `shielded/noteStore` is caught; a name grep cannot tell them apart); and a list of names (`NPkc`, `noteSecret`, `nativeProve` / `proveV1` / `E_V1_REMOVED` / `prove_to_bytes`, `seed_from_u64(0)`, the removed flags, screens, state and pin-set names, `TODO_DEVNET`) over every code file of `src`, `android`, `native/noctura-prover`, `scripts`, `.github`, `__mocks__` and the root JS files — comments included, as in M1a's `keyModuleRemoved`. Five exceptions, each with its reason, and a test that each exception is still needed: `noteEncryption.ts` and its two suites (`noteSecret` — §12 keeps `noteEncryption` for M2), the A0 store's suite (it asserts no `noteSecret` field is stored and that a v1 record is cleared), `presaleRoutes.test.tsx` (it asserts the removed screens have no route). Markdown is not code and is not read (`STATUS.md`, plans, specs keep their history).
  - **`noteEncryption.ts` is kept as §12 says, though its payload is v1's `{amount, noteSecret}`.** Nothing imports it in M1; its one helper from the deleted `noteCrypto` is inlined; its interop test with the v1 view-key identity and the `noc1…` address is removed (both gone). M2 must revalidate it against the A0 note plaintext before any use — and then drop its guard exception. Cost if wrong (it should have gone): one file and two suites, removable any time.
  - **The v1 native prover is deleted whole:** the Kotlin `proveV1` React method and `external fun nativeProve` (and `ProveV1RemovedTest.kt`, which pinned them), the Rust `Java_…_nativeProve` export, `src/prover.rs` (its `prove_to_bytes` drew the proof randomness from `seed_from_u64(0)`), `tests/prove_to_bytes.rs`, the three v1 spike `examples/` (they ran only on the v1 deposit zkey/wasm) and `artifacts/deposit_input.json`; `jni-exports.txt` loses one line (9 symbols); `a0Boundary.test.ts` / `ReactSurfaceTest.kt` read 7 React methods and 9 natives. `proof_bytes.rs` and `witness_wasmi.rs` stay (A0's `prove.rs` uses both). The CI workflow loses its v1 artifact cache/fetch steps and the v1 interop line of its assertion (both controls kept and re-run here, Step 5), and reads the asset host's `BASE` from `a0/keyAssets.ts` — with a check that it found one. `Cargo.toml`'s dependencies are unchanged (ark-circom, ark-std … are A0's too), so `Cargo.lock` is untouched.
  - **`constants/provingAssets.ts` (the v1 pin set, pinned to `NPkc…`) is deleted; the two types A0 used from it and `assertContentAddressed` move to `zkProver/provingAssets.ts`, and `a0/keyAssets.ts` now asserts its own pin set content-addressed at import** (the v1 set had that guard, the A0 set did not). `ensureCircuitAssets` (v1) goes; `ensurePinnedAssets` stays.
  - **The wipe warning reads the A0 store, fail-safe:** `a0WipeRisk()` reads the record without writing (no first-run record, no v1 clear) and never throws: an `unspent` or `pending` note → `notes`; a locked store or a record that does not decode → `unreadable` — what it holds is unknown, so the warning fires with its own copy; no record or only `spent` notes → `none`. The production build (shielded off) does not read it (it never runs A0, and its app data is not the devnet app's). The copy names the recovery phrase: A0 notes come back with a restore (Task 3), which is the truth the old "PERMANENTLY LOST" line lacked.
  - **What an older install left in storage is removed at unlock** (`secureStorageSession`, right after the encrypted store opens, at unlock and onboarding): the v1 `noc1…` address (`v1_wallet.shieldedAddress`, public instance — the stated I9 surface), the v1 tree-sync caches (`shielded.syncCache.<mint>`) and note-scan cursors (`noctura.noteScanCursor.<mint>`), and the v1 proof queue's record (`v1_proofQueue`, ENCRYPTED instance — it persisted its jobs' witness JSON, the v1 note secrets among them). The v1 notes (`v1_notes_<mint>`) stay the A0 store's to clear (Task 3), so `MMKV_KEYS.SHIELDED_NOTES_PREFIX` stays.
  - **Receive is transparent only:** the route ignores any `shielded` param, the dashboard offers no Receive in shielded mode (there is no valid shielded receive address until M2, I9), the `ReceiveModal` param type is `undefined`. `ReceiveScreen`'s `shielded` prop and its shielded rendering are left as presentational code for M2 (no route passes it) — deleting the design's shielded variant now would mean redrawing it in M2.
  - **Export View Key:** the screen and route are gone; the Settings row stays in the shielded build, DISABLED (not pressable, `accessibilityState.disabled`), with §11's copy "Not available in this version." The production build has no row (as before).
  - **The v1 view key is removed (controller ruling on this task's concern 4):** onboarding's `SuccessScreen` no longer derives (`deriveShieldedViewKey`, EIP-2333 m/12381/371/2/0) nor stores (`keychainManager.storeViewKey`) a view key — under A0 the keys are derived from the seed inside the Rust core and the ivk never leaves it, so the stored key was seed-derived BLS key material on disk with no use. `src/modules/keyDerivation/shielded.ts` and its suite are deleted (nothing of A0 imports it; M1a's vector generator `scripts/a0-vectors/gen-key-vectors.mjs` and the checkpoint's `lib.mjs` call `micro-key-producer/bls.js` directly, offline and independent); `storeViewKey` / `retrieveViewKey` are gone; `keychainManager.dropV1ViewKey()` resets the `noctura.viewKey` entry and runs at unlock (awaited) and onboarding (not awaited, never rejects; a keychain failure does not block the unlock — retried next unlock), so existing installs lose it; `wipeKeys` still resets it. `keyDerivation/paths.ts`' `SHIELDED_PATHS` (documentation constants) stays. The guard refuses `deriveShieldedViewKey`, `deriveDisclosureKey`, `storeViewKey`, `retrieveViewKey` and the module path; mutations V1–V3.
  - **Small leftovers removed with their only users:** `rpcLimiter`'s `proveLimiter` (`/v1/prove/*`) and `relayerLimiter` (`/v1/relayer/submit`), unused; `walletStore.shieldedBalances` / `updateShieldedBalance` (never written; a persisted copy in an old install is an ignored extra key); the fake native module's `proveV1` (Task 3's `offlineA0.ts`); the `mutation-sweep.mjs` target on the deleted `merkleTreeAccount.ts` (the A0 tree layout is Task 2's `treeAccount.ts`, with its own tests and mutations); `pinFailurePropagation`'s denominator 13 → 11 (measured: 14 caller files before, three removed).
- **Measured facts:** jest 202 → 162 suites (+5 new, −45 deleted; 1 skipped both times), 1,554 → 1,371 tests (1 skipped both times); `cargo test --locked` 101 + 0 doc (the v1 prover's 2 unit tests and its integration test gone), the A0 key-file tests ran (no `A0-KEYS-SKIPPED`), `tests_android_refs` 3; the host `jni-host` library and the arm64 library both export exactly the 9 symbols; the arm64 library NEEDS `libc.so libdl.so` only; the devnet APK (`com.nocturawallet.devnet`, "Noctura devnet", BuildConfig `NETWORK = "devnet"`, `FEATURES_SHIELDED = "true"`) and the production APK (`com.nocturawallet`, `NETWORK = "mainnet-beta"`) built from the task commit — the devnet one in 34 min cold, the production one in 1 min 40 s after it; both carry the same JS bundle (sha256 `58181072…12b8`) and the same `libnoctura_prover.so` (`9c80dcc9…1f74`) — Config is read at run time. `ReactSurfaceTest` (Kotlin, JVM) 4/4 on the compiled classes. Diff vs base: 165 files, +1,506 / −9,265.

- **Stated limits:**
  - The guard reads names, not meaning: a v1 behaviour rebuilt under new names is not caught (the review is).
  - `shieldedStore`'s v1 fields (`merkleRoot`, `merkleLeafCount`, `privacyLevel`, `pendingProofs`) and `merkle/merkleModule.ts`'s `MerkleModule` class (a backend `/merkle/leaves` sync nothing calls) are v1-era state outside §12's list; left, unread by any A0 path.

**The rule, stated once.** The phone reports, the chain decides, the owner drives. The app writes what it already knows and is public anyway — never anything that only the seed or the note store knows — to the one channel a release app gives adb (the log), and only in the devnet build; the desk believes none of it until devnet's own transaction, `LeafInserted` and signature list say the same. Every adb call that could lose data is either M1a's fail-closed install or the single, named, confirmed, signer-checked clear of the devnet app; everything else the desk sends is a read, a log clear or a process stop.

```ts
/**
 * The M1b checkpoint readout (checkpointReadout.ts; spec §16 M1b): the lines the desk script reads
 * off the phone's log.
 *
 * THE CONTRACT. `scripts/m1b-checkpoint/fixtures/readout-sample.txt` was written by hand (JSON
 * objects in the documented field order, cut into 200-character chunks) — neither by this module
 * nor by the desk's parser. This suite holds the app's lines to it byte for byte; the desk's
 * `lib.test.mjs` parses the same file. A change on either side that the other does not follow
 * turns one of the two red.
 *
 * THE GATE. Only a shielded devnet build emits: under Jest's default config (the production one:
 * NETWORK=mainnet-beta, no FEATURES_SHIELDED) nothing reaches console.info — and, as the positive
 * control, the same module loaded under the devnet APK's config does emit.
 */
import {readFileSync} from 'fs';
import {join} from 'path';
import {
  A0_READOUT_TAG,
  a0ReadoutEnabled,
  a0ReadoutLines,
  readA0DepositOutcome,
  readA0DepositSubmitted,
  readA0Startup,
  resetA0ReadoutForTests,
} from '../checkpointReadout';
import type {A0Note} from '../noteStore';
import type {A0StartupState} from '../startup';

const SAMPLE = readFileSync(join(__dirname, '../../../../../scripts/m1b-checkpoint/fixtures/readout-sample.txt'), 'utf8')
  .split('\n')
  .filter(Boolean);

// The sample's inputs (the values written into the hand-made file).
const SESSION = 'kz3d9q2a';
const AT = new Date('2026-11-15T20:00:00.000Z');
const SIG = '3DR6F7oWXS4D5RSsDJAQMbYtQM4EW5Kp2qkJRVSHH72x2GPB4N4G93JkNK9uGGK9CpFeGuy7vtBVeaDHiVQ7b8sm';
const SIG2 = 'a7wDRKqvnNSkBAGs56ssKby9pqXQtc3eAv6W5sF1HAMWNiGYEkkjUPkeNJ4Ji3E2AjUfseiR3U65Fcr8kQvm5tY';
const DEP = 'GoBAmZzHvD6F4KHLNmBFh2wZAGE1dwwufeTbifSHEYfd';
const C1 = '040cee88a680ad589527dc07fe1cc7a15e2f3059c367bfac23dfcb3ee56219ad';
const C2 = '0'.repeat(63) + '7';
const ROOT = '1' + '0'.repeat(62) + '2';
// Values that must NEVER reach the log (rho, a depositIndex, an error message): distinct sentinels.
const RHO_A = 'aa'.repeat(32);
const RHO_B = 'bb'.repeat(32);
const RHO_C = 'cc'.repeat(32);
const RHO_D = 'dd'.repeat(32);
const SECRET_MESSAGE = 'E_A0_STORE_LOCKED: sentinel-message-' + 'ee'.repeat(32);

const NOTES: A0Note[] = [
  {commitment: C1, amount: 1_000_000n, rho: RHO_A, depositIndex: 7_777_777n, leafIndex: 0, status: 'unspent'},
  {commitment: C2, amount: 500_000n, rho: RHO_B, depositIndex: 8_888_888n, leafIndex: 17, status: 'unspent'},
  {commitment: '0'.repeat(63) + '9', amount: 3n, rho: RHO_C, depositIndex: 9_999_999n, lastValidBlockHeight: 123_456_789, status: 'pending'},
  {commitment: '0'.repeat(63) + 'a', amount: 4n, rho: RHO_D, leafIndex: 3, status: 'spent', spentTx: 'spentTxSentinel'},
];

const READY: A0StartupState = {
  phase: 'ready',
  result: {
    restoredBecause: 'no-record',
    restore: {
      treeTransactions: 16,
      failedTransactions: 0,
      listedSignatures: 16,
      fetchedTransactions: 16,
      syncDurationMs: 2400,
      durationMs: 3100,
      depositIndicesTried: 21,
      depositsInHistory: 8,
      withdrawNullifiersInHistory: 4_242_424,
      ownNotes: 1,
      spentNotes: 0,
      foreignRhoHits: 0,
      finishedAt: '2026-11-15T19:59:58.000Z',
      r13TriggerReached: false,
    },
    reconcile: {
      confirmed: [{rho: RHO_C, leafIndex: 17, signature: SIG2}],
      dropped: [{rho: RHO_D, reason: 'expired'}],
      stillPending: [],
    },
  },
};

function emitTheSample(): string[] {
  const lines: string[] = [];
  const o = {sink: (l: string) => lines.push(l), enabled: true, now: () => AT, chunk: 200, session: SESSION};
  readA0DepositSubmitted({signature: SIG, depositor: DEP, amount: 1_000_000n, commitment: C1}, o);
  readA0DepositOutcome({depositor: DEP, amount: 1_000_000n, commitment: C1}, {status: 'unspent', signature: SIG, leafIndex: 0, root: ROOT}, o);
  readA0Startup(READY, () => NOTES, o);
  readA0Startup({phase: 'error', code: 'E_A0_STORE_LOCKED', message: SECRET_MESSAGE}, () => NOTES, o);
  readA0DepositOutcome(
    {depositor: DEP, amount: 500_000n, commitment: C2},
    {status: 'pending', signature: SIG2, reason: 'not-confirmed', detail: SECRET_MESSAGE},
    o,
  );
  return lines;
}

/** The JSON texts of the lines, chunks re-joined (a value can be cut across two lines). */
function payloadTexts(lines: readonly string[]): string[] {
  const byId = new Map<string, string>();
  for (const l of lines) {
    const m = /^NOCTURA-A0-READOUT (\S+) \d+\/\d+ (.*)$/.exec(l)!;
    byId.set(m[1]!, (byId.get(m[1]!) ?? '') + m[2]!);
  }
  return [...byId.values()];
}

beforeEach(() => {
  resetA0ReadoutForTests();
});

describe('the contract with the desk (the hand-written sample)', () => {

    for (const l of emitTheSample()) {
      const m = /^NOCTURA-A0-READOUT (\S+) (\d+)\/(\d+) (.*)$/.exec(l);
      expect(m).not.toBeNull();
      byId.set(m![1]!, [...(byId.get(m![1]!) ?? []), m![4]!]);
    }
    expect([...byId.keys()]).toEqual([1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map(i => `${SESSION}-${i}`));
    const startup = JSON.parse(byId.get(`${SESSION}-3`)!.join(''));
    expect(startup.restore.treeTransactions).toBe(16);
    expect(startup.notes.unspentNotes).toEqual([
      {leafIndex: 0, commitment: C1, amount: '1000000'},
      {leafIndex: 17, commitment: C2, amount: '500000'},
    ]);
  });
  it('a line is at most TAG + id + counter + the chunk (the default chunk keeps it under logcat\'s ~4 KB)', () => {
    const lines = a0ReadoutLines('x-1', {k: 'v'.repeat(10_000)});
    expect(lines.length).toBe(4);
    expect(Math.max(...lines.map(l => l.length))).toBeLessThan(4000);
  });
});

describe('only public values', () => {
  it('no rho, no depositIndex, no lastValidBlockHeight, no spentTx, no error message or detail reaches a line', () => {
    // searched in the RE-JOINED payloads: a search over the raw lines misses a value the chunking cut
    const all = payloadTexts(emitTheSample()).join('\n');
    for (const secret of [RHO_A, RHO_B, RHO_C, RHO_D, '7777777', '8888888', '9999999', '123456789', 'spentTxSentinel', 'sentinel-message', '4242424']) {
      expect(all).not.toContain(secret);
    }
    // positive control: the same search finds what IS public
    expect(all).toContain(C1);
    expect(all).toContain(SIG2);
  });
  it('a store that cannot be read is reported by its code only, never as an empty store', () => {
    const lines: string[] = [];
    readA0Startup(READY, () => {
      throw Object.assign(new Error(SECRET_MESSAGE), {code: 'E_A0_STORE_CORRUPT'});
    }, {sink: l => lines.push(l), enabled: true});
    const [text] = payloadTexts(lines);
    const p = JSON.parse(text!);
    expect(p.notesError).toBe('E_A0_STORE_CORRUPT');
    expect(p.notes).toBeUndefined();
    expect(text).not.toContain('sentinel-message');
  });
  it('a sink that throws does not break the flow it reports on', () => {
    expect(() =>
      readA0DepositSubmitted({signature: SIG, depositor: DEP, amount: 1n, commitment: C1}, {
        enabled: true,
        sink: () => {
          throw new Error('logcat gone');
        },
      }),
    ).not.toThrow();
  });
  it('running / idle states emit nothing (only a settled startup is read out)', () => {
    const lines: string[] = [];
    readA0Startup({phase: 'running'}, () => NOTES, {sink: l => lines.push(l), enabled: true});
    readA0Startup({phase: 'idle'}, () => NOTES, {sink: l => lines.push(l), enabled: true});
    expect(lines).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe('the gate: a shielded build on devnet only', () => {
  it('a0ReadoutEnabled is true only for shielded + devnet', () => {
    expect(a0ReadoutEnabled(true, 'devnet')).toBe(true);
    expect(a0ReadoutEnabled(false, 'devnet')).toBe(false);
    expect(a0ReadoutEnabled(true, 'mainnet-beta')).toBe(false);
    expect(a0ReadoutEnabled(false, 'mainnet-beta')).toBe(false);
  });
  it('enabled: false emits nothing', () => {
    const lines: string[] = [];
    readA0DepositSubmitted({signature: SIG, depositor: DEP, amount: 1n, commitment: C1}, {enabled: false, sink: l => lines.push(l)});
    expect(lines).toEqual([]);
  });
  it('under the PRODUCTION config (Jest\'s default: NETWORK=mainnet-beta, no FEATURES_SHIELDED) the default gate and sink write nothing', () => {
    const info = jest.spyOn(console, 'info').mockImplementation(() => undefined);
    try {
      expect(a0ReadoutEnabled()).toBe(false);
      readA0DepositSubmitted({signature: SIG, depositor: DEP, amount: 1n, commitment: C1});
      readA0Startup(READY, () => NOTES);
      expect(info).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    } finally {
      info.mockRestore();
    }
  });
  it('positive control: under the DEVNET APK\'s config the same default gate and sink write the line to console.info', () => {
    const info = jest.spyOn(console, 'info').mockImplementation(() => undefined);
    try {
      jest.isolateModules(() => {
        jest.doMock('react-native-config', () => ({
          __esModule: true,
          default: {NETWORK: 'devnet', FEATURES_SHIELDED: 'true', LOCAL_PROVING: 'true'},
        }));
        const m = require('../checkpointReadout') as typeof import('../checkpointReadout');
        expect(m.a0ReadoutEnabled()).toBe(true);

    } finally {
      info.mockRestore();
      jest.dontMock('react-native-config');
    }
  });
});
```

Create `src/modules/shielded/a0/checkpointReadout.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * The M1b checkpoint readout (spec §16 "Checkpoints · M1b"): what the desk script reads off the
 * phone over adb — one logcat line (or a few chunks of one) after a deposit is submitted, after its
 * outcome, and after each startup step (restore + reconciliation). DEVNET BUILD ONLY.
 *
 * WHY A LOG LINE. The values the checkpoint judges live in the ENCRYPTED MMKV (the note store,
 * R13's counters in `v1_a0_last_restore`) of a release app, which adb cannot read (no `run-as` on a
 * release build). The desk does not trust the screen either: it compares every value here with
 * the chain (`scripts/m1b-checkpoint/`).
 *
 * ONLY PUBLIC VALUES, BY CONSTRUCTION. Each payload is built field by field from a fixed list —
 * never by spreading a record — so a field added to a note, a stats record or an outcome does not
 * reach the log by accident. What it carries is public on chain once the deposit is broadcast or
 * landed (signature, depositor = the main account, amount, commitment, leaf index, root), or a
 * count / duration / reason / error code. It never carries a rho, a depositIndex, a nullifier, an
 * error message (a message can quote anything), the seed or anything derived from it in Rust.
 *
 * THE GATE. `a0ReadoutEnabled()` is true only in a shielded build on devnet
 * (`FEATURES_SHIELDED=true` and `NETWORK=devnet` — the devnet APK's BuildConfig). The JS bundle is
 * the same in both APKs (Config is read at run time), so this code IS in the production bundle;
 * there the gate is false (`NETWORK=mainnet-beta`, no `FEATURES_SHIELDED`), and the production
 * build never runs the A0 startup or the deposit anyway. The checkpoint proves it three ways: a
 * Jest test under the production config, the production APK's BuildConfig read off the APK, and
 * no readout line in the phone's log after the production app's launch and unlock.
 *
 * FORMAT (the desk parses it; `scripts/m1b-checkpoint/fixtures/readout-sample.txt` is the
 * hand-written contract both sides are tested against):
 *   NOCTURA-A0-READOUT <id> <i>/<n> <chunk>
 * `<id>` = `<session>-<seq>` (session: this process's start time in base 36; seq: 1, 2, …), the
 * chunks of one JSON object in order (logcat truncates a line near 4 KB, so a long one is split).
 */
import {isShieldedEnabled} from '../../../constants/features';
import {NETWORK} from '../../../constants/programs';
import type {KnownNetwork} from '../../../constants/networkGuard';
import type {A0DepositOutcome} from './depositFlow';
import type {A0Note} from './noteStore';
import type {A0StartupState} from './startup';

export const A0_READOUT_TAG = 'NOCTURA-A0-READOUT';
export const A0_READOUT_SCHEMA = 'noctura.a0.readout/1';
/** Characters of JSON per logcat line (Android's logger payload limit is ~4 KB). */
export const A0_READOUT_CHUNK = 3000;

/** True only in a shielded build on devnet (the devnet APK). */
export function a0ReadoutEnabled(
  shielded: boolean = isShieldedEnabled(),
  network: KnownNetwork = NETWORK,
): boolean {
  return shielded === true && network === 'devnet';
}

type Json = string | number | boolean | null | Json[] | {[k: string]: Json};

export interface A0ReadoutOptions {
  /** where the lines go (default: console.info → logcat tag ReactNativeJS) */
  sink?: (line: string) => void;
  /** default: a0ReadoutEnabled() */
  enabled?: boolean;
  /** default: new Date() (UTC ISO in the payload) */
  now?: () => Date;
  chunk?: number;
  /** TEST-ONLY: a fixed session id (default: this process's start time) */
  session?: string;
}

const SESSION = Date.now().toString(36);
let seq = 0;
let testDefaults: A0ReadoutOptions = {};

/** TEST-ONLY: reset the counter and the defaults below. */
export function resetA0ReadoutForTests(): void {
  seq = 0;
  testDefaults = {};
}

/** TEST-ONLY: defaults for the call sites' readouts (a capturing sink, the gate forced on). */
export function setA0ReadoutDefaultsForTests(o: A0ReadoutOptions): void {
  testDefaults = o;
}

/** The lines of one readout (no gate, no side effect) — exported for the contract test. */
export function a0ReadoutLines(id: string, payload: {[k: string]: Json}, chunk: number = A0_READOUT_CHUNK): string[] {
  const text = JSON.stringify(payload);
  const n = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(text.length / chunk));
  const lines: string[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    lines.push(`${A0_READOUT_TAG} ${id} ${i + 1}/${n} ${text.slice(i * chunk, (i + 1) * chunk)}`);
  }
  return lines;
}

function emit(event: string, fields: {[k: string]: Json}, given: A0ReadoutOptions): void {
  const o = {...testDefaults, ...given};
  if (!(o.enabled ?? a0ReadoutEnabled())) {
    return;
  }
  const session = o.session ?? SESSION;
  seq += 1;
  const id = `${session}-${seq}`;
  const payload = {
    schema: A0_READOUT_SCHEMA,
    event,
    session,
    seq,
    at: (o.now ?? (() => new Date()))().toISOString(),
    ...fields,
  };
  const sink = o.sink ?? ((line: string) => console.info(line));
  try {
    for (const line of a0ReadoutLines(id, payload, o.chunk)) {
      sink(line);
    }
  } catch {
    // a readout never breaks the flow it reports on
  }
}

export interface A0ReadoutDeposit {
  signature: string;
  depositor: string;
  amount: bigint;
  commitment: string;
}

/** After the deposit's send was accepted (#21 "submitted") — the kill window opens here. */
export function readA0DepositSubmitted(d: A0ReadoutDeposit, o: A0ReadoutOptions = {}): void {
  emit(
    'deposit-submitted',
    {signature: d.signature, depositor: d.depositor, amount: d.amount.toString(), commitment: d.commitment},
    o,
  );
}

/** The deposit's outcome as `submitA0Deposit` returns it. */
export function readA0DepositOutcome(
  d: Omit<A0ReadoutDeposit, 'signature'>,
  outcome: A0DepositOutcome,
  o: A0ReadoutOptions = {},
): void {
  const f: {[k: string]: Json} = {
    signature: outcome.signature,
    status: outcome.status,
    depositor: d.depositor,
    amount: d.amount.toString(),
    commitment: d.commitment,
  };
  if (outcome.status === 'unspent') {
    f.leafIndex = outcome.leafIndex;
    f.root = outcome.root;
  } else if (outcome.status === 'pending') {
    f.reason = outcome.reason;
  } else {
    f.reason = outcome.reason;
    f.foreignSignature = outcome.foreignSignature;
  }
  emit('deposit-outcome', f, o);
}

/** The store as the desk needs it: counts, the unspent balance, each unspent note's public part. */
function notesFields(notes: () => readonly A0Note[]): {[k: string]: Json} {
  try {
    const all = notes();
    const unspent = all.filter(n => n.status === 'unspent');
    return {
      notes: {
        pending: all.filter(n => n.status === 'pending').length,
        unspent: unspent.length,
        spent: all.filter(n => n.status === 'spent').length,
        unspentBalance: unspent.reduce((s, n) => s + n.amount, 0n).toString(),
        unspentNotes: unspent.map(n => ({leafIndex: n.leafIndex ?? null, commitment: n.commitment, amount: n.amount.toString()})),
      },
    };
  } catch (e) {
    const code = typeof (e as {code?: unknown})?.code === 'string' ? (e as {code: string}).code : null;
    return {notesError: code};
  }
}

/** After the startup step settled (`ready` or `error`); `notes` reads the store (after it). */
export function readA0Startup(state: A0StartupState, notes: () => readonly A0Note[], o: A0ReadoutOptions = {}): void {
  if (state.phase === 'error') {
    emit('startup', {phase: 'error', code: state.code}, o);
    return;
  }
  if (state.phase !== 'ready') {
    return;
  }
  const {restoredBecause, restore: r, reconcile} = state.result;
  emit(
    'startup',
    {
      phase: 'ready',
      restoredBecause,
      restore: r
        ? {
            treeTransactions: r.treeTransactions,
            failedTransactions: r.failedTransactions,
            listedSignatures: r.listedSignatures,
            fetchedTransactions: r.fetchedTransactions,
            syncDurationMs: r.syncDurationMs,
            durationMs: r.durationMs,
            depositIndicesTried: r.depositIndicesTried,
            depositsInHistory: r.depositsInHistory,
            ownNotes: r.ownNotes,
            spentNotes: r.spentNotes,
            foreignRhoHits: r.foreignRhoHits,
            finishedAt: r.finishedAt,
            r13TriggerReached: r.r13TriggerReached,
          }
        : null,
      reconcile: {
        confirmed: reconcile.confirmed.map(c => ({leafIndex: c.leafIndex, signature: c.signature})),
        dropped: reconcile.dropped.map(d => ({reason: d.reason})),
        stillPending: reconcile.stillPending.map(p => ({reason: p.reason})),
      },
      ...notesFields(notes),
    },
    o,
  );
}
```

```diff
@@ -78,6 +78,7 @@ import {simulateTransaction} from '../../solana/simulation';
```

```js
const S2 = 'a7wDRKqvnNSkBAGs56ssKby9pqXQtc3eAv6W5sF1HAMWNiGYEkkjUPkeNJ4Ji3E2AjUfseiR3U65Fcr8kQvm5tY';
const GOBAM = 'GoBAmZzHvD6F4KHLNmBFh2wZAGE1dwwufeTbifSHEYfd';

describe('the readout parser (the hand-written sample)', () => {
  test('5 readouts in order, chunks re-joined; the sample\'s values', () => {

    assert.deepEqual(incomplete, []);
    assert.deepEqual(invalid, []);

    assert.equal(readouts[0].commitment, be(LANDED.commitment));

    const forged = SAMPLE.replace('"amount":"1000000","commitment":', '"amount":"9000000","commitment":');

    assert.deepEqual(idx.sort((a, b) => a - b), [...Array(17).keys()]);

// ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ the judge

const at = s => `2026-11-15T20:${s}.000Z`;
const leafOf = (sig, c) => L.decodeDevnetTx(TREE.transactions[sig]).leafInserted.find(l => l.commitment === c);
const dep1 = L.decodeDevnetTx(TREE.transactions[S1]).deposits[0];
const dep2 = L.decodeDevnetTx(TREE.transactions[S2]).deposits[0];
const l1 = leafOf(S1, dep1.commitment);
const l2 = leafOf(S2, dep2.commitment);
const head = (event, session, seq) => ({ schema: L.READOUT_SCHEMA, event, session, seq, at: '2026-11-15T19:00:00.000Z' });

/** A consistent run built from the recorded chain: deposit S1, the kill around S2, the wipe, prod. */
function scenario() {

    { seenAt: at('02:00'), readout: { ...head('deposit-submitted', 'aaa', 2), signature: S1, depositor: GOBAM, amount: dep1.amount.toString(), commitment: dep1.commitment } },
    { seenAt: at('02:10'), readout: { ...head('deposit-outcome', 'aaa', 3), signature: S1, status: 'unspent', depositor: GOBAM, amount: dep1.amount.toString(), commitment: dep1.commitment, leafIndex: l1.leafIndex, root: l1.root } },
    { seenAt: at('03:00'), readout: { ...head('deposit-submitted', 'aaa', 4), signature: S2, depositor: GOBAM, amount: dep2.amount.toString(), commitment: dep2.commitment } },
    { seenAt: at('04:00'), readout: { ...head('startup', 'bbb', 1), phase: 'ready', restoredBecause: null, restore: null, reconcile: { confirmed: [{ leafIndex: l2.leafIndex, signature: S2 }], dropped: [], stillPending: [] }, notes: { pending: 0, unspent: 2, spent: 0, unspentBalance: (dep1.amount + dep2.amount).toString(), unspentNotes: [{ leafIndex: l1.leafIndex, commitment: dep1.commitment, amount: dep1.amount.toString() }, { leafIndex: l2.leafIndex, commitment: dep2.commitment, amount: dep2.amount.toString() }] } } },
    { seenAt: at('06:00'), readout: { ...head('startup', 'ccc', 1), phase: 'ready', restoredBecause: 'no-record', restore: { treeTransactions: 15, durationMs: 5200, syncDurationMs: 4100, depositIndicesTried: 22, ownNotes: 2, finishedAt: at('05:58'), r13TriggerReached: false }, reconcile: { confirmed: [], dropped: [], stillPending: [] }, notes: { pending: 0, unspent: 2, spent: 0, unspentBalance: (dep1.amount + dep2.amount).toString(), unspentNotes: [{ leafIndex: l1.leafIndex, commitment: dep1.commitment, amount: dep1.amount.toString() }, { leafIndex: l2.leafIndex, commitment: dep2.commitment, amount: dep2.amount.toString() }] } } },
  ];
  return {
    readouts,
    kill: { at: at('03:01'), signature: S2, session: 'aaa' },
    wipe: { at: at('05:00'), pkg: L.DEVNET_PACKAGE, answer: 'Success' },
    main: GOBAM,
    chain: { txs: { [S1]: TREE.transactions[S1], [S2]: TREE.transactions[S2] }, tree: { pages: [TREE.signatures], readAt: at('07:00') } },
    launches: ['M1b.8', 'M1b.9', 'M1b.10'].map(id => ({ id, text: id, pass: true, detail: 'ok' })),
    apkLines: L.judgeApkConfig({ devnet: L.buildConfigFromDexdump(dex('devnet')), production: L.buildConfigFromDexdump(dex('production')) }),
    i3: { ran: true, passed: 5, failed: 0, pending: 0, file: '/x/src/modules/shielded/a0/__tests__/restoreRequests.test.ts', commit: 'c0ffee' },
    commit: { head: 'c0ffee', apks: 'c0ffee' },

// The recorded blockTimes are 2026-11-08/09; the scenario's finishedAt is later — every recorded tx counts.
const IDS = ['M1b.1', 'M1b.2', 'M1b.6', 'M1b.3', 'M1b.4', 'M1b.5', 'M1b.7', 'M1b.A1', 'M1b.A2', 'M1b.A3', 'M1b.8', 'M1b.9', 'M1b.10'];

    ['M1b.6', 'still pending after the next start', s => (s.readouts[4].readout.notes.pending = 1)],
    ['M1b.3', 'the wipe cleared another package', s => (s.wipe.pkg = L.PRODUCTION_PACKAGE)],
    ['M1b.3', 'the next start after the wipe did not restore (a record was found)', s => (s.readouts[5].readout.restoredBecause = null)],
    ['M1b.3', 'no wipe recorded', s => (s.wipe = null)],

    ['M1b.7', 'the I-3 test did not run', s => (s.i3 = null)],
    ['M1b.A3', 'the APKs are of another commit', s => (s.commit.apks = 'deadbeef')],

    ['M1b.7', 'the I-3 test ran on a dirty tree', s => Object.assign(s, { commit: { head: 'c0ffee (dirty)', apks: 'c0ffee' }, i3: { ...s.i3, commit: 'c0ffee (dirty)' } })],
    ['M1b.9', 'the production launch did not run', s => (s.launches = s.launches.filter(l => l.id !== 'M1b.9'))],
    ['M1b.10', 'the production check after the unlock failed', s => (s.launches.find(l => l.id === 'M1b.10').pass = false)],
```

```js
 * The M1b phone operations (device.mjs) over a MOCKED adb — no test touches a device. The wipe's
 * rules are the point: the ONE clear is `pm clear com.nocturawallet.devnet`, sent only by
 * clearDevnetAppData, only for exactly that package with the typed confirmation, only when the
 * installed app has this checkpoint's signer — and every STOP row asserts the exact adb calls
 * made (no clear among them). Run: `node --test scripts/m1b-checkpoint/*.test.mjs`.
 */
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { mkdtempSync, readFileSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { after, describe, test } from 'node:test';
import * as I from '../m1a-checkpoint/install.mjs';
import * as D from './device.mjs';
import { DEVNET_PACKAGE, PRODUCTION_PACKAGE } from './lib.mjs';

const SAMPLE = readFileSync(new URL('./fixtures/readout-sample.txt', import.meta.url), 'utf8');
const KEY_A = 'a'.repeat(64);
const KEY_B = 'b'.repeat(64);
const root = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'm1b-device-test-'));
after(() => rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true }));
let n = 0;
const out = () => mkdtempSync(join(root, `o${n++}-`));
const CLEAR = `shell pm clear ${DEVNET_PACKAGE}`;

/** A scripted phone: `installed` = package → its base.apk's signer; every call logged. */
function phone({ installed = { [DEVNET_PACKAGE]: KEY_A }, clear = { status: 0, out: 'Success\n' }, logcat = '', pid = '4242', start = 'Status: ok\n', crash = '' } = {}) {
  const calls = [];
  const adb = args => {
    const c = args.join(' ');
    calls.push(c);
    if (c === 'shell pm list packages') {
      return { status: 0, out: ['package:android', ...Object.keys(installed).map(p => `package:${p}`)].join('\n') + '\n' };
    }
    if (c.startsWith('shell pm path ')) {
      const p = args[3];
      return installed[p] ? { status: 0, out: `package:/data/app/~~x/${p}-y/base.apk\n` } : { status: 1, out: '' };
    }
    if (args[0] === 'pull') {
      const pkg = Object.keys(installed).find(p => args[1].includes(`/${p}-y/`));
      writeFileSync(args[2], `the installed ${pkg}`);
      return { status: 0, out: '1 file pulled\n' };
    }
    if (c === CLEAR) {
      return clear;
    }
    if (c.startsWith('shell am start')) {
      return { status: 0, out: start };
    }
    if (c.startsWith('shell pidof')) {
      return { status: pid ? 0 : 1, out: pid ? `${pid}\n` : '' };
    }
    if (c === 'logcat -b crash -d') {
      return { status: 0, out: crash };
    }
    if (c === 'logcat -d') {
      return { status: 0, out: logcat };
    }
    return { status: 0, out: '' };
  };
  // the new APK is signed with KEY_A; a pulled copy carries its package's installed signer
  const apkSigners = f => (f === '/apks/devnet.apk' ? [KEY_A] : [installed[readFileSync(f, 'utf8').slice('the installed '.length)]].filter(Boolean));
  const sha256File = f => readFileSync(f).toString('hex').padEnd(64, '0').slice(0, 64);
  return { adb, calls, apkSigners, sha256File };
}
const wipe = (p, over = {}) =>
  D.clearDevnetAppData({ adb: p.adb, pkg: DEVNET_PACKAGE, confirm: DEVNET_PACKAGE, apk: '/apks/devnet.apk', apkSigners: p.apkSigners, sha256File: p.sha256File, outDir: out(), ...over });

describe('the wipe: only com.nocturawallet.devnet, only confirmed, only our signer', () => {
  test('refused before ANY adb call for every other name, and without the exact typed confirmation', () => {
    for (const [pkg, confirm] of [
      [PRODUCTION_PACKAGE, PRODUCTION_PACKAGE],
      [`${DEVNET_PACKAGE}.test`, `${DEVNET_PACKAGE}.test`],
      [` ${DEVNET_PACKAGE}`, ` ${DEVNET_PACKAGE}`],
      [`${DEVNET_PACKAGE} `, DEVNET_PACKAGE],
      ['com.nocturawallet.devnet2', 'com.nocturawallet.devnet2'],
      [DEVNET_PACKAGE, undefined],
      [DEVNET_PACKAGE, PRODUCTION_PACKAGE],
      [DEVNET_PACKAGE, 'yes'],
    ]) {
      const p = phone({ installed: { [DEVNET_PACKAGE]: KEY_A, [PRODUCTION_PACKAGE]: KEY_A } });
      assert.throws(() => wipe(p, { pkg, confirm }), I.CheckpointStop, `${pkg} / ${confirm}`);
      assert.deepEqual(p.calls, [], `${pkg} / ${confirm}`);
    }
    assert.equal(D.wipeRefusal(DEVNET_PACKAGE, DEVNET_PACKAGE), null);
  });
  test('the installed devnet app under ANOTHER signing key → STOP, no clear', () => {
    const p = phone({ installed: { [DEVNET_PACKAGE]: KEY_B } });
    assert.throws(() => wipe(p), /ANOTHER signing key/);
    assert.ok(!p.calls.includes(CLEAR));
  });
  test('the devnet app not installed → STOP, no clear', () => {
    const p = phone({ installed: {} });
    assert.throws(() => wipe(p), /not installed — nothing to wipe/);
    assert.ok(!p.calls.includes(CLEAR));
  });
  test('the clear answering anything but Success → STOP', () => {
    const p = phone({ clear: { status: 1, out: 'Failed\n' } });
    assert.throws(() => wipe(p), /answered Failed/);
  });
  test('a confirmed wipe of our devnet app: the signer read first, then EXACTLY one clear, of exactly that package, last', () => {
    const p = phone({ installed: { [DEVNET_PACKAGE]: KEY_A, [PRODUCTION_PACKAGE]: KEY_A } });
    const r = wipe(p);
    assert.equal(r.answer, 'Success');
    assert.deepEqual(p.calls.filter(c => /\bclear\b/.test(c)), [CLEAR]);
    assert.equal(p.calls.at(-1), CLEAR);
    assert.ok(p.calls.indexOf(`shell pm path ${DEVNET_PACKAGE}`) < p.calls.indexOf(CLEAR));
    assert.ok(!p.calls.some(c => c.includes(`pm clear ${PRODUCTION_PACKAGE}`) && !c.includes(DEVNET_PACKAGE)));
  });
  test('only clearDevnetAppData can send it: the guarded adb refuses the very same arguments, and the list is frozen', () => {
    const p = phone();
    assert.throws(() => I.guarded(p.adb)([...D.CLEAR_ARGS]), I.CheckpointStop);
    assert.deepEqual(p.calls, []);
    assert.throws(() => D.CLEAR_ARGS.push('x'), TypeError);
    assert.deepEqual([...D.CLEAR_ARGS], ['shell', 'pm', 'clear', DEVNET_PACKAGE]);
  });
});

describe('the kill: force-stop of the devnet app, once, at the first "deposit-submitted"', () => {
  const lines = SAMPLE.split('\n').filter(Boolean);
  test('fed the log in pieces cut mid-line: the kill fires once, when the submitted readout completes, before the next line', () => {
    const p = phone();
    let killedAfterCalls = -1;
    const w = new D.KillWatcher({
      killAfterSubmit: true,
      now: () => 'T',
      kill: () => {
        killedAfterCalls = p.calls.length;
        return D.killDevnetApp(p.adb);
      },
    });
    const text = lines.join('\n') + '\n';
    w.push(text.slice(0, 50));
    assert.equal(w.killed, null); // half a line: nothing yet
    w.push(text.slice(50, text.indexOf(lines[2]))); // the two chunks of the submitted readout
    assert.equal(killedAfterCalls, 0);
    assert.deepEqual(p.calls, [`shell am force-stop ${DEVNET_PACKAGE}`]);
    assert.equal(w.killed.signature, '3DR6F7oWXS4D5RSsDJAQMbYtQM4EW5Kp2qkJRVSHH72x2GPB4N4G93JkNK9uGGK9CpFeGuy7vtBVeaDHiVQ7b8sm');
    assert.equal(w.killed.session, 'kz3d9q2a');
    w.push(text.slice(text.indexOf(lines[2])));
    assert.deepEqual(p.calls, [`shell am force-stop ${DEVNET_PACKAGE}`]); // once
    assert.equal(w.readouts.length, 5);
  });
  test('a startup or outcome readout before the submitted one does not kill; the submitted one does', () => {
    const p = phone();
    const w = new D.KillWatcher({ killAfterSubmit: true, kill: () => D.killDevnetApp(p.adb) });
    const of = id => lines.filter(l => l.includes(` kz3d9q2a-${id} `)).join('\n') + '\n';
    w.push(of(4) + of(2)); // a startup (error) and an outcome
    assert.equal(w.readouts.length, 2);
    assert.deepEqual(p.calls, []);
    w.push(of(1));
    assert.deepEqual(p.calls, [`shell am force-stop ${DEVNET_PACKAGE}`]);
  });
  test('without --kill-after-submit nothing is killed (positive control of the flag)', () => {
    const p = phone();
    const w = new D.KillWatcher({ killAfterSubmit: false, kill: () => D.killDevnetApp(p.adb) });
    w.push(SAMPLE);
    assert.deepEqual(p.calls, []);
    assert.equal(w.readouts.length, 5);
  });
  test('killDevnetApp stops ONLY the devnet package', () => {
    const p = phone();
    D.killDevnetApp(p.adb);
    assert.deepEqual(p.calls, [`shell am force-stop ${DEVNET_PACKAGE}`]);
  });
  test('mergeReadouts keeps the first sighting of each id', () => {
    const r = D.mergeReadouts([], [{ session: 's', seq: 1 }, { session: 's', seq: 2 }], 'T1');
    const again = D.mergeReadouts(r.all, [{ session: 's', seq: 2 }, { session: 's', seq: 3 }], 'T2');
    assert.deepEqual(again.all.map(x => `${x.readout.seq}@${x.seenAt}`), ['1@T1', '2@T1', '3@T2']);
  });
});

describe('the launches (M1a\'s cold-start rule) and the production app\'s silence', () => {
  const launch = (p, expectNoReadout = false) =>
    D.launchCheck({ adb: p.adb, pkg: PRODUCTION_PACKAGE, id: 'M1b.9', text: 't', wait: () => undefined, expectNoReadout });
  test('started, alive, clean crash buffer, no readout line → pass; force-stop first, log cleared before the start', () => {
    const p = phone();
    const l = launch(p, true);
    assert.equal(l.pass, true, l.detail);
    assert.deepEqual(p.calls.slice(0, 4), [`shell am force-stop ${PRODUCTION_PACKAGE}`, 'logcat -b crash -c', 'logcat -c', `shell am start -W -n ${PRODUCTION_PACKAGE}/com.nocturawallet.MainActivity`]);
  });
  test('a readout line in the production app\'s log → FAIL (the gate leaked)', () => {
    const l = launch(phone({ logcat: `11-15 I ReactNativeJS: ${SAMPLE.split('\n')[0]}\n` }), true);
    assert.equal(l.pass, false);
    assert.match(l.detail, /readout lines: 1/);
  });
  test('a crash, a dead process, or no "Status: ok" → FAIL', () => {
    assert.equal(launch(phone({ crash: `FATAL EXCEPTION: main\nProcess: ${PRODUCTION_PACKAGE}\n` })).pass, false);
    assert.equal(launch(phone({ pid: '' })).pass, false);
    assert.equal(launch(phone({ start: 'Status: timeout\n' })).pass, false);
  });
  test('no call of the launch or the check uninstalls or clears app data', () => {
    const p = phone();
    launch(p, true);
    D.afterCheck({ adb: p.adb, pkg: PRODUCTION_PACKAGE, id: 'M1b.10', text: 't', expectNoReadout: true });
    assert.ok(!p.calls.some(c => /uninstall|pm clear/.test(c)));
  });
});
```

Create `scripts/m1b-checkpoint/lib.mjs`:

```js
/**
 * The M1b checkpoint's desk logic (spec 2026-11-08 shielded A0 M1 §16 "Checkpoints · M1b"): the
 * phone's readout lines parsed, the devnet transactions they name decoded, the APKs' BuildConfig
 * read, and the judge that turns all of it into one PASS / FAIL per §16 line.
 *
 * THE ANTI-CIRCULARITY BOUNDARY. Nothing here imports the app (src/): the phone REPORTS values
 * (checkpointReadout.ts), the chain DECIDES them. The deposit instruction and the `LeafInserted`
 * event are decoded here from the program side's layout (spec §1: `deposit` = f223c68952e1f2b6 +
 * amount u64 LE + commitment[32] + rho[32] + proof; `LeafInserted` = 59f3d408d7bfbb98 +
 * commitment[32] + leaf_index u64 LE + root[32], 80 bytes) with a log-frame walk of our own — not
 * with the app's `syncedTx.ts` — and held in lib.test.mjs to the program side's landed public
 * inputs and to the recorded tree's 17 leaves.
 *
 * Pure functions only (no network, no adb): m1b-checkpoint.mjs does the I/O. Tested by
 * lib.test.mjs and device.test.mjs (`node --test scripts/m1b-checkpoint/*.test.mjs`).
 */
import { base58, base64 } from '@scure/base';

/** spec §1 — the deployed devnet A0 pool (facts). */
export const DEVNET = {
  genesisHash: 'EtWTRABZaYq6iMfeYKouRu166VU2xqa1wcaWoxPkrZBG',
  programId: 'FeGSSsJtmA7GnMgnpj33JsiceSk1NyFopff2FtQFsMuH',
  pool: '8VMe4iZWiq3xQySywih9cciAmzTxMtkawMRYK6JuDdoT',
  mint: 'ERkpCFGaoWmeZPhKTUHumrqHTP1QmyHVhMJUnxbRPKCs',
  mintDecimals: 9,
  merkleTree: '5URdh1uLKXPh28AbcXBK1oWYGpQjVbMSjrKiAkt1q1Gc',
  /** the mint authority of ERkp… (read from devnet at slot 522688040, 2026-11-15) */
  mintAuthority: 'GoBAmZzHvD6F4KHLNmBFh2wZAGE1dwwufeTbifSHEYfd',
};
export const DEVNET_PACKAGE = 'com.nocturawallet.devnet';
export const PRODUCTION_PACKAGE = 'com.nocturawallet';
/** spec R13: more than 5,000 tree transactions or more than 60 s makes an indexer pre-mainnet. */
export const R13_TRIGGER = { treeTransactions: 5000, durationMs: 60000 };
export const READOUT_TAG = 'NOCTURA-A0-READOUT';
export const READOUT_SCHEMA = 'noctura.a0.readout/1';

const DEPOSIT_DISC = 'f223c68952e1f2b6';
const DEPOSIT_DATA_BYTES = 8 + 8 + 32 + 32 + 4 + 256; // 340
const DEPOSIT_ACCOUNTS = [
  'pool',
  'merkle_tree',
  'vault',
  'depositor',
  'depositor_token_account',
  'rho_marker',
  'token_program',
  'system_program',
];
const LEAF_DISC = '59f3d408d7bfbb98';
const LEAF_BYTES = 80;

const hex = b => Buffer.from(b).toString('hex');
const u64le = b => Buffer.from(b).readBigUInt64LE(0);

// ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- the readout

/**
 * The readouts in a log text (logcat output: any prefix before the tag is ignored). Lines are
 * `NOCTURA-A0-READOUT <id> <i>/<n> <chunk>`; one id's chunks, all present, re-joined in order,
 * are one JSON object. Returns `{readouts, incomplete, invalid}` in first-seen order; a chunk
 * seen twice (two dumps of one buffer) counts once, a chunk seen twice with OTHER text makes
 * the id invalid (never guessed).
 */
export function readoutsFromLog(text) {
  const ids = new Map();
  const re = new RegExp(`${READOUT_TAG} (\\S+) (\\d+)/(\\d+) (.*?)\\s*$`);
  for (const line of String(text).split('\n')) {
    const m = re.exec(line);
    if (!m) {
      continue;
    }
    const [, id, i, n, chunk] = m;
    const e = ids.get(id) ?? { n: Number(n), parts: new Map(), conflict: false };
    if (e.n !== Number(n)) {
      e.conflict = true;
    }
    const had = e.parts.get(Number(i));
    if (had !== undefined && had !== chunk) {
      e.conflict = true;
    }
    e.parts.set(Number(i), chunk);
    ids.set(id, e);
  }
  const readouts = [];
  const incomplete = [];
  const invalid = [];
  for (const [id, e] of ids) {
    if (e.conflict) {
      invalid.push({ id, why: 'two different texts for one chunk' });
      continue;
    }
    if (e.parts.size !== e.n || ![...Array(e.n).keys()].every(k => e.parts.has(k + 1))) {
      incomplete.push(id);
      continue;
    }
    let r;
    try {
      r = JSON.parse([...Array(e.n).keys()].map(k => e.parts.get(k + 1)).join(''));
    } catch (err) {
      invalid.push({ id, why: `not JSON: ${err.message}` });
      continue;
    }
    const why = readoutRefusal(r, id);
    if (why) {
      invalid.push({ id, why });
      continue;
    }
    readouts.push(r);
  }
  return { readouts, incomplete, invalid };
}

const HEX64 = /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/;
const SIG = /^[1-9A-HJ-NP-Za-km-z]{64,88}$/;
const ADDR = /^[1-9A-HJ-NP-Za-km-z]{32,44}$/;
const DEC = /^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$/;

/** Why a parsed readout is not one the app writes, or null (the schema of checkpointReadout.ts). */
export function readoutRefusal(r, id) {
  if (!r || typeof r !== 'object' || r.schema !== READOUT_SCHEMA) {
    return `schema ${r?.schema}`;
  }
  if (`${r.session}-${r.seq}` !== id || !Number.isInteger(r.seq) || r.seq < 1) {
    return `id ${id} is not session-seq of the payload`;
  }
  if (Number.isNaN(Date.parse(r.at))) {
    return 'no time';
  }
  if (r.event === 'deposit-submitted' || r.event === 'deposit-outcome') {
    if (!SIG.test(r.signature ?? '') || !ADDR.test(r.depositor ?? '') || !DEC.test(r.amount ?? '') || !HEX64.test(r.commitment ?? '')) {
      return `${r.event}: a field is not of its shape`;
    }
    if (r.event === 'deposit-outcome') {
      if (!['unspent', 'pending', 'dropped'].includes(r.status)) {
        return `deposit-outcome: status ${r.status}`;
      }
      if (r.status === 'unspent' && (!Number.isInteger(r.leafIndex) || !HEX64.test(r.root ?? ''))) {
        return 'deposit-outcome: unspent without leafIndex / root';
      }
    }
    return null;
  }
  if (r.event === 'startup') {
    if (r.phase === 'error') {
      return null;
    }
    if (r.phase !== 'ready' || !r.reconcile) {
      return `startup: phase ${r.phase}`;
    }
    return null;
  }
  return `event ${r.event}`;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------------- the devnet tx

/**
 * A `getTransaction` answer (encoding json, maxSupportedTransactionVersion 0) decoded for the
 * checkpoint: success, signers, fee payer, every top-level `deposit` of the pool program (by its
 * IDL account order) and every `LeafInserted` the pool program emitted in its OWN top-level frame
 * (a `Program data:` line while the invoke stack is exactly [FeGSS…]).
 */
export function decodeDevnetTx(tx) {
  if (!tx) {
    return null;
  }
  const msg = tx.transaction.message;
  const keys = [
    ...msg.accountKeys,
    ...(tx.meta?.loadedAddresses?.writable ?? []),
    ...(tx.meta?.loadedAddresses?.readonly ?? []),
  ];
  const signers = msg.accountKeys.slice(0, msg.header.numRequiredSignatures);
  const deposits = [];
  for (const ix of msg.instructions) {
    if (keys[ix.programIdIndex] !== DEVNET.programId) {
      continue;
    }
    const data = base58.decode(ix.data);
    if (hex(data.subarray(0, 8)) !== DEPOSIT_DISC) {
      continue;
    }
    if (data.length !== DEPOSIT_DATA_BYTES || ix.accounts.length !== DEPOSIT_ACCOUNTS.length) {
      deposits.push({ malformed: true });
      continue;
    }
    const acc = Object.fromEntries(DEPOSIT_ACCOUNTS.map((n, i) => [n, keys[ix.accounts[i]]]));
    deposits.push({
      amount: u64le(data.subarray(8, 16)),
      commitment: hex(data.subarray(16, 48)),
      rho: hex(data.subarray(48, 80)),
      ...acc,
    });
  }
  const leafInserted = [];
  const stack = [];
  for (const line of tx.meta?.logMessages ?? []) {
    let m = /^Program (\S+) invoke \[(\d+)\]$/.exec(line);
    if (m) {
      stack.push(m[1]);
      continue;
    }
    m = /^Program (\S+) (success|failed: .*)$/.exec(line);
    if (m) {
      stack.pop();
      continue;
    }
    m = /^Program data: (\S+)$/.exec(line);
    if (m && stack.length === 1 && stack[0] === DEVNET.programId) {
      const b = base64.decode(m[1]);
      if (hex(b.subarray(0, 8)) === LEAF_DISC) {
        leafInserted.push(
          b.length === LEAF_BYTES
            ? { commitment: hex(b.subarray(8, 40)), leafIndex: Number(u64le(b.subarray(40, 48))), root: hex(b.subarray(48, 80)) }
            : { malformed: true },
        );
      }
    }
  }
  return {
    ok: tx.meta?.err === null,
    err: tx.meta?.err ?? null,
    slot: tx.slot,
    blockTime: tx.blockTime,
    signers,
    feePayer: msg.accountKeys[0],
    deposits,
    leafInserted,
  };
}

/** The counts of a `getSignaturesForAddress` page walk (each page newest first). */
export function treeSignatureCounts(pages, upToBlockTime = Infinity) {
  const all = pages.flat();
  const ok = all.filter(s => s.err === null);
  return {
    listed: all.length,
    successful: ok.length,
    failed: all.length - ok.length,
    successfulUpTo: ok.filter(s => s.blockTime !== null && s.blockTime <= upToBlockTime).length,
  };
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------------- the APKs

/** The BuildConfig fields the checkpoint reads — never the RPC URLs (they carry the API key). */
export const BUILD_CONFIG_FIELDS = ['APPLICATION_ID', 'BUILD_TYPE', 'DEBUG', 'NETWORK', 'FEATURES_SHIELDED', 'LOCAL_PROVING'];

/**
 * The app's own BuildConfig static fields from `dexdump -f` output of one classes*.dex
 * (react-native-config writes the env file's keys there; `build_config_package`
 * com.nocturawallet). Only BUILD_CONFIG_FIELDS; a dex without the class → null.
 */
export function buildConfigFromDexdump(text) {
  const start = text.indexOf("Class descriptor  : 'Lcom/nocturawallet/BuildConfig;'");
  if (start < 0) {
    return null;
  }
  const rest = text.slice(start);
  const end = rest.indexOf('Instance fields');
  const block = end >= 0 ? rest.slice(0, end) : rest;
  const out = {};
  // one entry per field ("#N : (in L…;)"), its own name and value only — a field without a
  // value line never borrows the next field's
  for (const field of block.split(/^\s+#\d+\s+: \(in /m).slice(1)) {
    const name = /^\s+name\s+: '([A-Za-z0-9_]+)'\s*$/m.exec(field)?.[1];
    const value = /^\s+value\s+: (.*)$/m.exec(field)?.[1]?.trim();
    if (name && value !== undefined && BUILD_CONFIG_FIELDS.includes(name)) {
      out[name] = /^".*"$/.test(value) ? value.slice(1, -1) : value;
    }
  }
  return out;
}

/** The release APKs' config as the readout's gate reads it (one line each, and a control). */
export function judgeApkConfig({ devnet, production }) {
  const lines = [];
  const add = (id, text, pass, detail) => lines.push({ id, text, pass, detail });
  const fmt = c => (c ? BUILD_CONFIG_FIELDS.filter(k => k in c).map(k => `${k}=${c[k]}`).join(' ') : 'no BuildConfig read');
  const gateOpen = c => c?.FEATURES_SHIELDED === 'true' && c?.NETWORK === 'devnet';
  add(
    'M1b.A1',
    'the devnet APK is the shielded devnet build (the readout gate open: FEATURES_SHIELDED=true, NETWORK=devnet)',
    devnet?.APPLICATION_ID === DEVNET_PACKAGE && devnet?.BUILD_TYPE === 'release' && gateOpen(devnet) && devnet?.LOCAL_PROVING === 'true',
    fmt(devnet),
  );
  add(
    'M1b.A2',
    'the production APK cannot read out (FEATURES_SHIELDED not true, NETWORK=mainnet-beta): the gate is closed there',
    production?.APPLICATION_ID === PRODUCTION_PACKAGE && production?.BUILD_TYPE === 'release' && production?.NETWORK === 'mainnet-beta' && !gateOpen(production) && production?.FEATURES_SHIELDED !== 'true',
    fmt(production),
  );
  return lines;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------------- the judge

const sum = xs => xs.reduce((s, x) => s + x, 0n);

/**
 * One PASS / FAIL per §16 M1b line.
 *   readouts: [{seenAt, readout}] (desk time, first seen)      wipe: {at, pkg, answer} | null
 *   kill: {at, signature, session} | null                       main: the main account (base58)
 *   chain: {txs: {sig: getTransaction | null}, tree: {pages, readAt}}
 *   launches: [{id, text, pass, detail}]   apkLines: judgeApkConfig()   i3: {ran, passed, failed, pending, file, commit} | null
 *   commit: {head, apks}
 */
export function judge({ readouts, wipe, kill, main, chain, launches = [], apkLines = [], i3, commit }) {
  const lines = [];
  const add = (id, text, pass, detail = '') => lines.push({ id, text, pass: Boolean(pass), detail });
  const info = [];
  const before = t => !wipe || t < wipe.at;
  const ofEvent = (e, f = () => true) => readouts.filter(x => x.readout.event === e && f(x));
  const decoded = sig => decodeDevnetTx(chain.txs[sig] ?? null);

  // M1b.1 / M1b.2 — the first deposit that settled unspent in the app, before the wipe, not the killed one.
  const dep = ofEvent('deposit-outcome', x => x.readout.status === 'unspent' && before(x.seenAt) && x.readout.signature !== kill?.signature)[0]?.readout;
  const dtx = dep ? decoded(dep.signature) : null;
  const dIx = dtx?.deposits.filter(d => !d.malformed) ?? [];
  add(
    'M1b.1',
    'a deposit from the main account landed on devnet, signed by it (the only signer, the fee payer, the deposit\'s depositor)',
    dep &&
      dtx?.ok &&
      dep.depositor === main &&
      dtx.signers.length === 1 &&
      dtx.signers[0] === main &&
      dtx.feePayer === main &&
      dIx.length === 1 &&
      dIx[0].depositor === main &&
      dIx[0].pool === DEVNET.pool &&
      dIx[0].merkle_tree === DEVNET.merkleTree &&
      dIx[0].amount === BigInt(dep.amount) &&
      dIx[0].commitment === dep.commitment,
    !dep
      ? 'no "deposit-outcome" unspent readout before the wipe (run `collect` after the deposit)'
      : !dtx
        ? `${dep.signature}: not found on devnet`
        : `${dep.signature} slot ${dtx.slot}: ok=${dtx.ok} signers=${dtx.signers.join(',')} depositor=${dIx[0]?.depositor} amount=${dIx[0]?.amount} (readout ${dep.amount})`,
  );
  const leaves = dtx ? dtx.leafInserted.filter(l => !l.malformed && l.commitment === dep.commitment) : [];
  add(
    'M1b.2',
    'the note shows unspent with the leaf index of its LeafInserted (readout = chain: commitment, leaf index, root)',
    dep && leaves.length === 1 && leaves[0].leafIndex === dep.leafIndex && leaves[0].root === dep.root && dIx[0]?.commitment === dep.commitment,
    dep ? `phone leaf ${dep.leafIndex}, chain ${leaves.map(l => l.leafIndex).join(',') || 'none'} (LeafInserted of ${dep.commitment.slice(0, 12)}… in FeGSS's frame)` : 'no deposit',
  );

  // M1b.6 — the kill.
  const killed = kill ? ofEvent('deposit-submitted', x => x.readout.signature === kill.signature)[0]?.readout : null;
  const killedOutcome = kill ? ofEvent('deposit-outcome', x => x.readout.signature === kill.signature && x.readout.session === killed?.session) : [];
  const nextStart = kill
    ? ofEvent('startup', x => x.seenAt > kill.at && x.readout.session !== killed?.session && x.readout.phase === 'ready')[0]?.readout
    : null;
  const ktx = kill ? decoded(kill.signature) : null;
  let killPass = false;
  let killDetail = 'no kill recorded (run `watch --kill-after-submit` during the second deposit)';
  if (kill) {
    if (!killed) {
      killDetail = `the kill names ${kill.signature}, but no "deposit-submitted" readout of it`;
    } else if (killedOutcome.length) {
      killDetail = 'the killed session read out an outcome: the app saw the confirmation before the kill — not exercised, repeat';
    } else if (!nextStart) {
      killDetail = 'no "startup" readout of a NEW session after the kill (reopen and unlock the devnet app, then `collect`)';
    } else if (ktx?.ok) {
      const kd = ktx.deposits.find(d => !d.malformed && d.commitment === killed.commitment);
      const kl = ktx.leafInserted.find(l => !l.malformed && l.commitment === killed.commitment);
      const c = nextStart.reconcile.confirmed.find(x => x.signature === kill.signature);
      const listed = (nextStart.notes?.unspentNotes ?? []).find(n => n.commitment === killed.commitment);
      killPass = Boolean(kd && kl && c && c.leafIndex === kl.leafIndex && listed && listed.leafIndex === kl.leafIndex && nextStart.notes.pending === 0);
      killDetail = `landed (slot ${ktx.slot}); next start: confirmed ${c ? `leaf ${c.leafIndex}` : 'NOT'}, chain leaf ${kl?.leafIndex}, unspent ${listed ? 'yes' : 'NO'}, pending ${nextStart.notes?.pending}`;
    } else if (ktx === null) {
      const dropped = nextStart.reconcile.dropped.filter(d => d.reason === 'expired').length;
      const still = nextStart.reconcile.stillPending.length;
      killPass = dropped === 1 && still === 0 && nextStart.notes?.pending === 0;
      killDetail = still
        ? `not landed and still undecided (${nextStart.reconcile.stillPending.map(p => p.reason).join(',')}): wait ~2 min, restart the devnet app, collect, verify again`
        : `not landed on devnet; next start dropped ${dropped} expired pending deposit(s) — nothing left the account`;
    } else {
      killDetail = `the killed deposit FAILED on chain (${JSON.stringify(ktx.err)}); next start must have dropped it`;
      killPass = nextStart.reconcile.dropped.length >= 1 && nextStart.notes?.pending === 0;
    }
  }

  // M1b.3 / M1b.4 / M1b.5 — the wipe and the restore.
  const restored = wipe ? ofEvent('startup', x => x.seenAt > wipe.at)[0]?.readout : null;
  add(
    'M1b.3',
    `wipe: ONLY the devnet app's data cleared (pm clear ${DEVNET_PACKAGE}), restored from the phrase: the next start found no record and restored`,
    wipe && wipe.pkg === DEVNET_PACKAGE && /^Success\s*$/m.test(wipe.answer ?? '') && restored?.phase === 'ready' && restored.restoredBecause === 'no-record' && restored.restore,
    !wipe ? 'no wipe recorded (`wipe`)' : !restored ? 'no "startup" readout after the wipe (import the phrase, then `collect`)' : `phase ${restored.phase}${restored.code ? ` ${restored.code}` : ''}, restoredBecause ${restored.restoredBecause}`,
  );
  const expected = [dep, killed]
    .filter(Boolean)
    .map(r => {
      const t = decoded(r.signature);
      const l = t?.ok ? t.leafInserted.find(x => !x.malformed && x.commitment === r.commitment) : null;
      return l ? { commitment: r.commitment, amount: BigInt(r.amount), leafIndex: l.leafIndex } : null;
    })
    .filter(Boolean);
  const back = restored?.notes?.unspentNotes ?? [];
  const found = expected.filter(e => back.some(n => n.commitment === e.commitment && n.leafIndex === e.leafIndex && BigInt(n.amount) === e.amount));
  add(
    'M1b.4',
    'the shielded balance returns from the chain: every deposit of this checkpoint that landed is unspent again at its chain leaf',
    restored?.notes &&
      expected.length >= 1 &&
      found.length === expected.length &&
      BigInt(restored.notes.unspentBalance) === sum(back.map(n => BigInt(n.amount))) &&
      BigInt(restored.notes.unspentBalance) >= sum(expected.map(e => e.amount)) &&
      (restored.restore?.ownNotes ?? -1) >= expected.length,
    restored?.notes
      ? `back ${found.length}/${expected.length} (leaves ${expected.map(e => e.leafIndex).join(',')}); balance ${restored.notes.unspentBalance} base units, ${restored.notes.unspent} unspent note(s)`
      : restored?.notesError
        ? `the store did not read: ${restored.notesError}`
        : 'no restore readout',
  );
  const r = restored?.restore;
  const tree = chain.tree ? treeSignatureCounts(chain.tree.pages, r ? Date.parse(r.finishedAt) / 1000 : Infinity) : null;
  const reached = r ? r.treeTransactions > R13_TRIGGER.treeTransactions || r.durationMs > R13_TRIGGER.durationMs : null;
  // The phone's count is of successful tree txs at its run (confirmed reads); the desk's walk
  // came later: ≤ the desk's total, ≥ the desk's count of those at least 60 s older than the run.
  const lower = chain.tree && r ? treeSignatureCounts(chain.tree.pages, Date.parse(r.finishedAt) / 1000 - 60).successfulUpTo : null;
  add(
    'M1b.5',
    `R13 recorded: the restore's tree-transaction count and duration on the phone, against the trigger (${R13_TRIGGER.treeTransactions} txs, ${R13_TRIGGER.durationMs / 1000} s)`,
    r && tree && Number.isInteger(r.treeTransactions) && Number.isInteger(r.durationMs) && r.treeTransactions <= tree.successful && r.treeTransactions >= lower && r.r13TriggerReached === reached,
    r
      ? `${r.treeTransactions} tree txs, ${r.durationMs} ms (sync ${r.syncDurationMs} ms), ${r.depositIndicesTried} counters tried; desk walk: ${tree?.successful} successful (${tree?.failed} failed) at ${chain.tree?.readAt}; trigger ${reached ? 'REACHED' : 'not reached'}`
      : 'no restore readout',
  );
  if (reached) {
    info.push(
      `R13 TRIGGER REACHED (${r.treeTransactions} txs, ${r.durationMs} ms): a coordinator tree indexer is now a PRE-MAINNET item (spec §13) — record it`,
    );
  }
  add('M1b.6', 'killed between the deposit\'s submit and its confirmation: at the next start the note is reconciled, not lost', killPass, killDetail);

  // M1b.7 — I-3.
  add(
    'M1b.7',
    'I-3: the recording-Connection test (restoreRequests.test.ts) passes at this commit',
    i3?.ran && i3.failed === 0 && i3.pending === 0 && i3.passed >= 5 && /restoreRequests\.test\.ts$/.test(i3.file ?? '') && i3.commit === commit?.head && !/dirty/.test(i3.commit),
    i3 ? `${i3.passed} passed, ${i3.failed} failed, ${i3.pending} skipped at ${i3.commit}` : 'not run',
  );
  for (const l of apkLines) {
    add(l.id, l.text, l.pass, l.detail);
  }
  add(
    'M1b.A3',
    'the APKs are of the commit checked (apks/COMMIT = HEAD, tree clean)',
    commit && commit.apks === commit.head && !/dirty/.test(commit.head ?? ''),
    `apks ${commit?.apks}, HEAD ${commit?.head}`,
  );
  for (const id of ['M1b.8', 'M1b.9', 'M1b.10']) {
    const l = launches.find(x => x.id === id);
    add(
      id,
      l?.text ??
        {
          'M1b.8': 'the devnet release APK launches on the phone',
          'M1b.9': 'the production APK of the same commit launches on the phone; no readout line in its log',
          'M1b.10': 'the production app after the owner\'s unlock (the A0 modules loaded): alive, no crash, no readout line',
        }[id],
      l?.pass,
      l?.detail ?? 'not run',
    );
  }
  return { lines, info };
}
```

```js
/**
 * The M1b checkpoint's phone operations beyond the installs — the wipe, the kill, the launches,
 * the readout collection. The installs are M1a's (`../m1a-checkpoint/install.mjs`, reused as they
 * are: the signer check before every install, the rollback pull, never uninstall, STOP on
 * anything unclear).
 *
 * THE ONE SANCTIONED CLEAR. §16 M1b says "wipe the app": that is `adb shell pm clear
 * com.nocturawallet.devnet` — the devnet app's data, which holds a DEVNET wallet only — and
 * nothing else, ever. It is sent by exactly one function, `clearDevnetAppData`, with a frozen
 * argument list built here (never from input), and only when
 *   - the package the caller names is EXACTLY `com.nocturawallet.devnet` (not the production
 *     wallet `com.nocturawallet`, not the test APK `….devnet.test`, no whitespace, no prefix),
 *   - the owner typed that same name as `--confirm-wipe com.nocturawallet.devnet`,
 *   - the installed devnet app is signed by the key of THIS checkpoint's devnet.apk (M1a's
 *     preflight: an app installed under another key — e.g. the September debug-signed build — is
 *     not the app this checkpoint installed, so it is not wiped),
 *   - and the answer is `Success`, else STOP.
 * Every other adb call goes through install.mjs's `guarded`, which refuses `clear` in any form —
 * so even this module cannot send another clear (tested). `am force-stop` (the kill, and each
 * launch's cold start) touches no data.
 *
 * Everything is injected (adb, signer reader, sha256, sleep); device.test.mjs drives it with a
 * mocked adb and no device is ever touched by a test.
 */
import * as I from '../m1a-checkpoint/install.mjs';
import { DEVNET_PACKAGE, readoutsFromLog } from './lib.mjs';

export const CONFIRM_WIPE = '--confirm-wipe';
/** The one clear the checkpoint sends — frozen, built from the constant, never from input. */
export const CLEAR_ARGS = Object.freeze(['shell', 'pm', 'clear', DEVNET_PACKAGE]);

/** Why the wipe is refused, or null. `pkg` and `confirm` must both be exactly the devnet package. */
export function wipeRefusal(pkg, confirm) {
  if (pkg !== DEVNET_PACKAGE) {
    return `refusing to wipe ${JSON.stringify(pkg)}: the checkpoint wipes ONLY ${DEVNET_PACKAGE} (never ${I.PRODUCTION_PACKAGE}, never anything else)`;
  }
  if (confirm !== DEVNET_PACKAGE) {
    return `the wipe needs ${CONFIRM_WIPE} ${DEVNET_PACKAGE} typed exactly (got ${JSON.stringify(confirm ?? null)}) — it destroys the devnet app's wallet: have its recovery phrase`;
  }
  return null;
}

/**
 * The wipe (§16 M1b "wipe the app"). Throws CheckpointStop before any adb call on a refusal, and
 * before the clear when the installed devnet app is absent or signed by another key than `apk`.
 *   adb(args) → {status, out}   (UNGUARDED: the one clear is sent here; every other call is guarded)
 */
export function clearDevnetAppData({ adb, pkg, confirm, apk, apkSigners, sha256File, outDir }) {
  const why = wipeRefusal(pkg, confirm);
  if (why) {
    throw new I.CheckpointStop(why);
  }
  const pre = I.preflightInstall({ adb: I.guarded(adb), pkg: DEVNET_PACKAGE, apk, apkSigners, sha256File, outDir });
  if (!pre.installed) {
    throw new I.CheckpointStop(`${DEVNET_PACKAGE} is not installed — nothing to wipe (run \`install\` first)`);
  }
  const r = adb([...CLEAR_ARGS]);
  if (r.status !== 0 || !/^Success\s*$/m.test(r.out)) {
    throw new I.CheckpointStop(`pm clear ${DEVNET_PACKAGE} answered ${r.out.trim() || `exit ${r.status}`} — stopped`);
  }
  return { pkg: DEVNET_PACKAGE, answer: r.out.trim(), signer: pre.apkSigners, rollback: pre.rollback };
}

/** The kill (§16 M1b): `am force-stop` of the DEVNET app — the process dies, no data is touched. */
export function killDevnetApp(adb) {
  return I.guarded(adb)(['shell', 'am', 'force-stop', DEVNET_PACKAGE]);
}

/**
 * The kill watch: fed the live log (`adb logcat`), it collects readouts and, the FIRST time a
 * complete "deposit-submitted" readout appears, kills the devnet app at once (once).
 */
export class KillWatcher {
  constructor({ kill, killAfterSubmit, now = () => new Date().toISOString() }) {
    this.kill = kill;
    this.killAfterSubmit = killAfterSubmit;
    this.now = now;
    this.buffer = '';
    this.text = '';
    this.seen = new Set();
    this.readouts = [];
    this.killed = null;
  }

  /** Feed a chunk of log output; returns the readouts completed by it. */
  push(chunk) {
    this.buffer += chunk;
    const cut = this.buffer.lastIndexOf('\n');
    if (cut < 0) {
      return [];
    }
    this.text += this.buffer.slice(0, cut + 1);
    this.buffer = this.buffer.slice(cut + 1);
    const fresh = [];
    for (const r of readoutsFromLog(this.text).readouts) {
      const id = `${r.session}-${r.seq}`;
      if (this.seen.has(id)) {
        continue;
      }
      this.seen.add(id);
      const entry = { seenAt: this.now(), readout: r };
      this.readouts.push(entry);
      fresh.push(entry);
      if (this.killAfterSubmit && !this.killed && r.event === 'deposit-submitted') {
        const answer = this.kill();
        this.killed = { at: this.now(), signature: r.signature, session: r.session, answer: answer?.out ?? '' };
      }
    }
    return fresh;
  }
}

/** Merge newly read readouts into the recorded ones (by id; first seen wins). */
export function mergeReadouts(recorded, readouts, now) {
  const have = new Set(recorded.map(x => `${x.readout.session}-${x.readout.seq}`));
  const added = [];
  for (const r of readouts) {
    const id = `${r.session}-${r.seq}`;
    if (!have.has(id)) {
      have.add(id);
      added.push({ seenAt: now, readout: r });
    }
  }
  return { all: [...recorded, ...added], added };
}

/**
 * A cold start and its check (M1a's rule): force-stop, clear the crash buffer, `am start -W`,
 * wait, the process alive, the crash buffer clean. With `expectNoReadout` (the production app),
 * the main log is cleared before the start and must hold no readout line after it.
 */
export function launchCheck({ adb, pkg, id, text, wait, expectNoReadout = false }) {
  const call = I.guarded(adb);
  call(['shell', 'am', 'force-stop', pkg]);
  call(['logcat', '-b', 'crash', '-c']);
  if (expectNoReadout) {
    call(['logcat', '-c']);
  }
  const start = call(['shell', 'am', 'start', '-W', '-n', `${pkg}/com.nocturawallet.MainActivity`]).out;
  wait();
  return afterCheck({ adb, pkg, id, text, expectNoReadout, start });
}

/** The process alive, the crash buffer clean, and (optionally) no readout line in the main log. */
export function afterCheck({ adb, pkg, id, text, expectNoReadout = false, start = null }) {
  const call = I.guarded(adb);
  const pid = call(['shell', 'pidof', pkg]).out.trim();
  const crash = call(['logcat', '-b', 'crash', '-d']).out;
  const crashed = crash.includes(pkg) || /UnsatisfiedLinkError|FATAL EXCEPTION/.test(crash);
  let readoutLines = 0;
  if (expectNoReadout) {
    readoutLines = call(['logcat', '-d']).out.split('\n').filter(l => l.includes('NOCTURA-A0-READOUT')).length;
  }
  const started = start === null || /Status: ok/.test(start);
  const pass = started && /^\d+$/.test(pid) && !crashed && readoutLines === 0;
  return {
    id,
    text,
    pass,
    crash: crashed ? crash : null,
    detail: `${start === null ? '' : `am start: ${start.match(/Status: \w+/)?.[0] ?? 'no status'}; `}pid: ${pid || 'none'}; crash buffer: ${crashed ? 'CRASH' : 'clean'}${expectNoReadout ? `; readout lines: ${readoutLines}` : ''}`,
  };
}
```

```js
#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * The M1b checkpoint, desk side (spec 2026-11-08 shielded A0 M1 §16 "Checkpoints · M1b").
 * README.md next to this file is the owner's checklist; the owner drives the app by hand, this
 * script installs, wipes, kills, reads the phone's readout lines and judges them against devnet.
 *
 *   check-apks --apks DIR                  the two release APKs' BuildConfig (dexdump) → DIR/CONFIG.json
 *   fund --main ADDR [--rpc URL]           the main account's devnet SOL and test-token balance (+ what to ask for)
 *   install --apks DIR [--allow-fresh-production]
 *                                          M1a's preflight for BOTH packages (signer, rollback, STOP), then installs
 *                                          devnet.apk only and launches it (M1b.8)
 *   collect                                one `adb logcat -d`: new readouts → OUT/readouts.jsonl
 *   watch [--kill-after-submit]            streams the log into OUT/readouts.jsonl; with the flag, force-stops the
 *                                          DEVNET app the moment a "deposit-submitted" readout appears (→ OUT/kill.json)
 *   wipe --apks DIR --confirm-wipe com.nocturawallet.devnet

 *                                          that package, only with the typed confirmation, only if it is signed by
 *                                          DIR/devnet.apk's key (→ OUT/wipe.json), then clears the log
 *   prod --apks DIR [--allow-fresh-production]
 *                                          force-stops the devnet app, installs production.apk over the wallet
 *                                          (M1a's rules), cold-launches it: alive, no crash, NO readout line (M1b.9)
 *   prod-check                             after the owner unlocked the production wallet: alive, no crash, no
 *                                          readout line since the launch (M1b.10)
 *   verify --main ADDR [--apks DIR] [--rpc URL]
 *                                          runs the I-3 Jest test, reads the named transactions and the tree's
 *                                          signature list from devnet, prints PASS / FAIL per §16 line; exit 0 only
 *                                          if every line passed
 *   common: [--out DIR] (default build/m1b-checkpoint) [--serial S]
 *
 * Never uninstalls; never clears anything but the devnet app's data in `wipe`; never contacts

 */
```
