```js
function apkSigners(apk) {
  try {
    return I.signerDigests(execFileSync(buildTool('apksigner'), ['verify', '--print-certs', apk], { encoding: 'utf8', stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'] }));
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}
const sha256File = f => createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(f)).digest('hex');
const badgingPkg = apk => execFileSync(buildTool('aapt2'), ['dump', 'badging', apk], { encoding: 'utf8' }).match(/^package: name='([^']+)'/m)?.[1];
function apks() {
  const dir = opt('apks') ?? die('needs --apks DIR (build-apks.sh writes devnet.apk, production.apk)');
  const devnet = join(dir, 'devnet.apk');
  const production = join(dir, 'production.apk');
  for (const f of [devnet, production]) {
    existsSync(f) || die(`missing ${f}`);
  }
  if (badgingPkg(devnet) !== L.DEVNET_PACKAGE || badgingPkg(production) !== L.PRODUCTION_PACKAGE) {
    die(`unexpected packages: devnet.apk=${badgingPkg(devnet)} production.apk=${badgingPkg(production)}`);
  }
  return { dir, devnet, production };
}
const sleep = s => spawnSync('sleep', [String(s)]);

// ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ the RPC

async function rpc(url, body) {
  const why = rpcRefusal(url);
  if (why) {
    die(why);
  }
  const res = await fetch(url, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(body) });
  if (!res.ok) {
    die(`RPC ${new URL(url).hostname} answered HTTP ${res.status}`);
  }
  return res.json();
}
/** One batch with getGenesisHash first: the answers by id, or die if the RPC is not devnet. */
async function devnetBatch(url, calls) {
  const out = await rpc(url, [{ jsonrpc: '2.0', id: 0, method: 'getGenesisHash' }, ...calls.map((c, i) => ({ jsonrpc: '2.0', id: i + 1, ...c }))]);
  const byId = Object.fromEntries(out.map(r => [r.id, r]));
  if (byId[0]?.result !== L.DEVNET.genesisHash) {
    die(`the RPC is not devnet (genesis ${byId[0]?.result ?? JSON.stringify(byId[0]?.error)})`);
  }
  return calls.map((_, i) => {
    const r = byId[i + 1];
    if (r?.error) {
      die(`${calls[i].method}: ${JSON.stringify(r.error)}`);
    }
    return r.result;
  });
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ readouts

const READOUTS = 'readouts.jsonl';
const recorded = () =>
  existsSync(join(OUT, READOUTS))
    ? readFileSync(join(OUT, READOUTS), 'utf8').split('\n').filter(Boolean).map(l => JSON.parse(l))
    : [];
function record(readouts) {
  const { added } = D.mergeReadouts(recorded(), readouts, new Date().toISOString());
  for (const a of added) {
    appendFileSync(join(OUT, READOUTS), JSON.stringify(a) + '\n');
    const r = a.readout;
    console.log(`readout ${r.session}-${r.seq} ${r.event}${r.status ? ` ${r.status}` : ''}${r.phase ? ` ${r.phase}` : ''}${r.leafIndex !== undefined ? ` leaf ${r.leafIndex}` : ''}${r.restoredBecause ? ` restored (${r.restoredBecause})` : ''}`);
  }
  return added;
}
function collect() {
  const { readouts, incomplete, invalid } = L.readoutsFromLog(adb(['logcat', '-d']).out);
  const added = record(readouts);
  if (incomplete.length) {
    console.log(`incomplete readouts (chunks missing — the log rotated?): ${incomplete.join(', ')}`);
  }
  for (const v of invalid) {
    console.log(`INVALID readout ${v.id}: ${v.why}`);
  }
  console.log(`collect: ${added.length} new readout(s), ${recorded().length} recorded in ${join(OUT, READOUTS)}`);
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ commands

function checkApks() {
  const a = apks();
  const config = {};
  for (const [k, f] of [['devnet', a.devnet], ['production', a.production]]) {
    const tmp = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'm1b-dex-'));
    try {
      execFileSync('unzip', ['-q', '-o', f, 'classes*.dex', '-d', tmp]);
      for (const dex of readdirSync(tmp).filter(n => /^classes\d*\.dex$/.test(n))) {
        const c = L.buildConfigFromDexdump(execFileSync(buildTool('dexdump'), ['-f', join(tmp, dex)], { encoding: 'utf8', maxBuffer: 1 << 30 }));
        if (c) {
          config[k] = c;
        }
      }
    } finally {
      rmSync(tmp, { recursive: true, force: true });
    }
  }
  writeFileSync(join(a.dir, 'CONFIG.json'), JSON.stringify(config, null, 2) + '\n');
  const lines = L.judgeApkConfig(config);
  // NEGATIVE CONTROL: the same reading, handed the devnet APK as "production", must refuse it.
  const control = L.judgeApkConfig({ devnet: config.devnet, production: config.devnet }).find(l => l.id === 'M1b.A2');
  for (const l of lines) {
    console.log(`${l.pass ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'}  ${l.id}  ${l.text}\n        ${l.detail}`);
  }
  console.log(control.pass ? 'CONTROL FAILED: the production check passes the devnet APK' : 'control OK: the production check refuses the devnet APK');
  process.exit(lines.every(l => l.pass) && !control.pass ? 0 : 1);
}

async function fund() {
  const main = opt('main') ?? die('needs --main <the devnet app\'s main account, from its Receive screen>');
  const [lamports, tokens] = await devnetBatch(opt('rpc', DEFAULT_RPC), [
    { method: 'getBalance', params: [main, { commitment: 'confirmed' }] },
    { method: 'getTokenAccountsByOwner', params: [main, { mint: L.DEVNET.mint }, { encoding: 'jsonParsed', commitment: 'confirmed' }] },
  ]);
  const units = tokens.value.map(t => BigInt(t.account.data.parsed.info.tokenAmount.amount));
  const total = units.reduce((s, x) => s + x, 0n);
  console.log(`main ${main} on devnet: ${lamports.value} lamports (${lamports.value / 1e9} SOL); test token ${L.DEVNET.mint}: ${total} base units in ${units.length} account(s)`);
  const needUnits = 1_500_000n; // deposit 1: 1,000,000 + deposit 2 (the kill): 500,000
  const needLamports = 20_000_000; // two deposits ≈ 2 × (5,000 fee + 695,960 rho-marker rent) + margin
  if (lamports.value < needLamports) {
    console.log(`NEED SOL: ask the devnet faucet (https://faucet.solana.com, devnet) for 1 SOL to ${main}`);
  }
  if (total < needUnits) {
    console.log(
      [
        `NEED TEST TOKENS: no faucet exists for this custom mint; its mint authority is ${L.DEVNET.mintAuthority} (the program side's devnet key). Send them:`,
        `  "Please mint 10,000,000 base units (0.01 TEST) of the devnet A0 test mint ${L.DEVNET.mint} to the devnet`,
        `   wallet ${main} (its associated token account, created idempotently, paid by ${L.DEVNET.mintAuthority}).`,
        '   Devnet only, for the wallet\'s M1b checkpoint. Reply with the signature."',
        '  (or see README "Test tokens" for the owner-run alternative with the devnet key on this laptop)',
      ].join('\n'),
    );
  }
  process.exit(lamports.value >= needLamports && total >= needUnits ? 0 : 1);
}

function install() {
  const a = apks();
  oneDevice();
  const pre = I.preflightAll({
    adb: rawAdb,
    apkSigners,
    sha256File,
    outDir: OUT,
    allowFreshProduction: flag(I.ALLOW_FRESH_PRODUCTION.slice(2)),
    targets: [
      { pkg: L.DEVNET_PACKAGE, apk: a.devnet },
      { pkg: L.PRODUCTION_PACKAGE, apk: a.production },
    ],
  });
  const at = new Date().toISOString();
  json('installs.json', { at, step: 'install', packages: pre });
  appendFileSync(join(OUT, 'installs.log.jsonl'), JSON.stringify({ at, step: 'install', packages: pre }) + '\n');
  for (const p of pre) {
    console.log(
      p.installed
        ? `${p.pkg}: installed, same signer; rollback ${p.rollback.dir}\n  restore with: ${p.rollback.command}`
        : `${p.pkg}: not installed (a first install${p.fresh ? `, allowed by ${I.ALLOW_FRESH_PRODUCTION}` : ''})`,
    );
  }
  console.log(`installing ${L.DEVNET_PACKAGE} (devnet release; its data is kept) …`);
  I.installApk({ adb: rawAdb, pkg: L.DEVNET_PACKAGE, apk: a.devnet });
  const l = D.launchCheck({ adb: rawAdb, pkg: L.DEVNET_PACKAGE, id: 'M1b.8', text: 'the devnet release APK launches on the phone', wait: () => sleep(10) });
  saveLaunch(l);
}
function saveLaunch(l) {
  const launches = readJson('launches.json', []).filter(x => x.id !== l.id);
  launches.push({ id: l.id, text: l.text, pass: l.pass, detail: l.detail, at: new Date().toISOString() });
  json('launches.json', launches);
  if (l.crash) {
    writeFileSync(join(OUT, `crash-${l.id}.txt`), l.crash);
  }
  console.log(`${l.pass ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'}  ${l.id}  ${l.text}\n        ${l.detail}`);
}

function watch() {
  oneDevice();
  const killAfterSubmit = flag('kill-after-submit');
  const w = new D.KillWatcher({ killAfterSubmit, kill: () => D.killDevnetApp(rawAdb) });
  const child = spawn(adbPath(), [...serialArgs(), 'logcat'], { stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'inherit'] });
  console.log(`watching the phone's log${killAfterSubmit ? ' — the DEVNET app is force-stopped at the first "deposit-submitted"' : ''} (Ctrl-C to end)`);
  child.stdout.setEncoding('utf8');
  let written = false;
  child.stdout.on('data', chunk => {
    const fresh = w.push(chunk);
    record(fresh.map(f => f.readout));
    if (w.killed && !written) {
      // this run's kill is THE kill (a repeat replaces kill.json; every kill stays in kills.log.jsonl)
      written = true;
      json('kill.json', w.killed);
      appendFileSync(join(OUT, 'kills.log.jsonl'), JSON.stringify(w.killed) + '\n');
      console.log(`KILLED ${L.DEVNET_PACKAGE} at ${w.killed.at}, after the submit of ${w.killed.signature} — reopen the devnet app and unlock it; leave this running`);
    }
  });
  process.on('SIGINT', () => {
    child.kill();
    process.exit(0);
  });
}

function wipe() {
  const a = apks();
  const confirm = opt(D.CONFIRM_WIPE.slice(2));
  const why = D.wipeRefusal(L.DEVNET_PACKAGE, confirm);
  if (why) {
    throw new I.CheckpointStop(why);
  }
  oneDevice();
  collect(); // every readout of before the wipe is recorded as before it
  const bar = '!'.repeat(100);
  console.error(`${bar}\nWIPING ${L.DEVNET_PACKAGE} (the DEVNET app's data, its devnet wallet) — never ${L.PRODUCTION_PACKAGE}. Ctrl-C within 10 s to stop.\n${bar}`);
  sleep(10);
  const r = D.clearDevnetAppData({ adb: rawAdb, pkg: L.DEVNET_PACKAGE, confirm, apk: a.devnet, apkSigners, sha256File, outDir: OUT });
  adb(['logcat', '-c']);
  const w = { at: new Date().toISOString(), ...r };
  json('wipe.json', w);
  appendFileSync(join(OUT, 'installs.log.jsonl'), JSON.stringify({ at: w.at, step: 'wipe', pkg: w.pkg, answer: w.answer }) + '\n');
  console.log(`wiped ${w.pkg} (${w.answer}) at ${w.at}: open the devnet app, IMPORT the phrase, unlock, wait for the balance; then \`collect\``);
}

function prod() {
  const a = apks();
  oneDevice();
  collect();
  adb(['shell', 'am', 'force-stop', L.DEVNET_PACKAGE]); // only the production app may run (the readout check)
  const [p] = I.preflightAll({
    adb: rawAdb,
    apkSigners,
    sha256File,
    outDir: OUT,
    allowFreshProduction: flag(I.ALLOW_FRESH_PRODUCTION.slice(2)),
    targets: [{ pkg: L.PRODUCTION_PACKAGE, apk: a.production }],
  });
  const at = new Date().toISOString();
  appendFileSync(join(OUT, 'installs.log.jsonl'), JSON.stringify({ at, step: 'prod', packages: [p] }) + '\n');
  if (p.fresh) {
    const bar = '!'.repeat(100);
    console.error(`${bar}\n${I.noWalletLine(L.PRODUCTION_PACKAGE)}\n${bar}`);
    sleep(15);
  } else {
    console.log(`${L.PRODUCTION_PACKAGE}: same signer; rollback ${p.rollback.dir}\n  restore with: ${p.rollback.command}\ninstalling production.apk over the installed wallet — its data is kept …`);
  }
  I.installApk({ adb: rawAdb, pkg: L.PRODUCTION_PACKAGE, apk: a.production });
  saveLaunch(
    D.launchCheck({
      adb: rawAdb,
      pkg: L.PRODUCTION_PACKAGE,
      id: 'M1b.9',
      text: 'the production APK of the same commit launches on the phone; no readout line in its log',
      wait: () => sleep(10),
      expectNoReadout: true,
    }),
  );
  console.log('now UNLOCK the production wallet on the phone (do not open the devnet app), then run `prod-check`');
}

function prodCheck() {
  oneDevice();
  const devnetPid = adb(['shell', 'pidof', L.DEVNET_PACKAGE]).out.trim();
  const l = D.afterCheck({
    adb: rawAdb,
    pkg: L.PRODUCTION_PACKAGE,
    id: 'M1b.10',
    text: "the production app after the owner's unlock (the A0 modules loaded): alive, no crash, no readout line",
    expectNoReadout: true,
  });
  if (devnetPid) {
    l.pass = false;
    l.detail += `; the devnet app is RUNNING (pid ${devnetPid}) — its lines would be indistinguishable: run \`prod\` again`;
  }
  saveLaunch(l);
}

async function verify() {
  const main = opt('main') ?? die('needs --main <the devnet app\'s main account>');
  const url = opt('rpc', DEFAULT_RPC);
  mkdirSync(OUT, { recursive: true });
  const readouts = recorded();
  const kill = readJson('kill.json');
  const wipeRec = readJson('wipe.json');
  const sigs = [...new Set([...readouts.filter(x => x.readout.signature).map(x => x.readout.signature), kill?.signature].filter(Boolean))];
  const answers = sigs.length
    ? await devnetBatch(url, sigs.map(s => ({ method: 'getTransaction', params: [s, { encoding: 'json', maxSupportedTransactionVersion: 0, commitment: 'confirmed' }] })))
    : [];
  const txs = Object.fromEntries(sigs.map((s, i) => [s, answers[i] ?? null]));
  const pages = [];
  let before;
  for (;;) {
    const [page] = await devnetBatch(url, [{ method: 'getSignaturesForAddress', params: [L.DEVNET.merkleTree, { limit: 1000, commitment: 'confirmed', ...(before ? { before } : {}) }] }]);
    pages.push(page);
    if (page.length < 1000) {
      break;
    }
    before = page[page.length - 1].signature;
  }
  const chain = { txs, tree: { pages, readAt: new Date().toISOString(), rpcHost: new URL(url).hostname } };
  json('chain.json', chain);

  // I-3 (§14): the recording-Connection test, run here at this commit.
  const head = execFileSync('git', ['-C', ROOT, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], { encoding: 'utf8' }).trim();
  const dirty = execFileSync('git', ['-C', ROOT, 'status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=no'], { encoding: 'utf8' }).trim();
  const jestOut = join(OUT, 'i3-jest.json');
  spawnSync('npx', ['jest', '--ci', '--json', '--outputFile', jestOut, 'src/modules/shielded/a0/__tests__/restoreRequests.test.ts'], { cwd: ROOT, stdio: 'inherit' });
  const j = existsSync(jestOut) ? JSON.parse(readFileSync(jestOut, 'utf8')) : null;
  const i3 = j
    ? { ran: true, passed: j.numPassedTests, failed: j.numFailedTests, pending: j.numPendingTests, file: j.testResults?.[0]?.name, commit: dirty ? `${head} (dirty)` : head }
    : null;

  const apkDir = opt('apks', join(ROOT, 'build/m1b-checkpoint/apks'));
  const config = existsSync(join(apkDir, 'CONFIG.json')) ? JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(apkDir, 'CONFIG.json'), 'utf8')) : {};
  const apksCommit = existsSync(join(apkDir, 'COMMIT')) ? readFileSync(join(apkDir, 'COMMIT'), 'utf8').trim() : null;
  const { lines, info } = L.judge({
    readouts,
    wipe: wipeRec,
    kill,
    main,
    chain,
    launches: readJson('launches.json', []),
    apkLines: L.judgeApkConfig(config),
    i3,
    commit: { head: dirty ? `${head} (dirty)` : head, apks: apksCommit },
  });
  console.log(`M1b checkpoint — ${OUT} (devnet via ${chain.tree.rpcHost}, ${chain.tree.readAt})`);
  for (const l of lines) {
    console.log(`${(l.pass ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL').padEnd(5)} ${l.id.padEnd(7)} ${l.text}${l.detail ? `\n${' '.repeat(14)}${l.detail}` : ''}`);
  }
  for (const i of info) {
    console.log(`\n${'!'.repeat(100)}\n${i}\n${'!'.repeat(100)}`);
  }
  const failed = lines.filter(l => !l.pass).length;
  console.log(failed ? `FAILED (${failed} line${failed > 1 ? 's' : ''})` : 'CHECKPOINT PASSED');
  return failed ? 1 : 0;
}

/** A STOP halts the checkpoint: printed, exit 3, nothing after it runs. */
function stopping(f) {
  try {
    return f();
  } catch (e) {
    if (e instanceof I.CheckpointStop) {
      console.error(`STOP: ${e.message}`);
      process.exit(3);
    }
    throw e;
  }
}

const commands = {
  'check-apks': checkApks,
  fund,
  install: () => stopping(install),
  collect: () => stopping(() => {
    oneDevice();
    collect();
  }),
  watch: () => stopping(watch),
  wipe: () => stopping(wipe),
  prod: () => stopping(prod),
  'prod-check': () => stopping(prodCheck),
  verify: async () => process.exit(await verify()),
};
if (!commands[cmd]) {
  console.error(readFileSync(new URL(import.meta.url), 'utf8').split('\n').slice(1, 33).join('\n'));
  process.exit(2);
}
await commands[cmd]();
```

Create `scripts/m1b-checkpoint/build-apks.sh` (`chmod +x`):

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Builds the two APKs of the M1b checkpoint from ONE commit (spec §16: "each checkpoint also
# builds the production APK of the same commit"), into OUT (default build/m1b-checkpoint/apks):
#   devnet.apk       the devnet release app (ENVFILE=.env.devnet, com.nocturawallet.devnet)
#   production.apk   the production release app (ENVFILE=.env.production, com.nocturawallet)
# then reads both APKs' BuildConfig off the built files (m1b-checkpoint.mjs check-apks: the
# readout gate is open in devnet.apk and closed in production.apk, with its negative control)
# and writes COMMIT, SHA256SUMS and CONFIG.json next to them. (M1b has no test APK: the phone
# part is driven by hand in the release app; the readout is the app's own, devnet-gated.)
#
#   ANDROID_NDK_HOME=~/Android/Sdk/ndk/27.1.12297006 scripts/m1b-checkpoint/build-apks.sh [OUT]
#
# Needs: android/keystore.properties (release signing), the gitignored .env.devnet (NETWORK=devnet,
# FEATURES_SHIELDED=true, LOCAL_PROVING=true, APP_ID_SUFFIX=.devnet — README "Before you start")
# and .env.production at the repository root, a real node_modules (never a symlink: Gradle writes
# into node_modules/*/android/build). CARGO_TARGET_DIR may point at an existing target.
set -euo pipefail
here=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
root=$(cd "$here/../.." && pwd)
out="${1:-$root/build/m1b-checkpoint/apks}"
: "${ANDROID_NDK_HOME:?set ANDROID_NDK_HOME (android/build.gradle ndkVersion 27.1.12297006)}"
export ANDROID_HOME="${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Android/Sdk}"
for f in .env.devnet .env.production android/keystore.properties; do
  [ -f "$root/$f" ] || { echo "missing $f" >&2; exit 2; }
done
[ ! -L "$root/node_modules" ] || { echo "node_modules is a symlink — use a real copy (Gradle writes into it)" >&2; exit 2; }
# The devnet build must be the shielded DEVNET build (Task 6: a shielded build on any other
# network refuses to start); checked here before 30 minutes of Gradle, and again on the APK.
grep -qx 'NETWORK=devnet' "$root/.env.devnet" || { echo ".env.devnet must set NETWORK=devnet (README)" >&2; exit 2; }
grep -qx 'FEATURES_SHIELDED=true' "$root/.env.devnet" || { echo ".env.devnet must set FEATURES_SHIELDED=true" >&2; exit 2; }
if grep -q '^FEATURES_SHIELDED=true' "$root/.env.production"; then
  echo ".env.production must not set FEATURES_SHIELDED=true" >&2
  exit 2
fi

commit=$(git -C "$root" rev-parse HEAD)
dirty=$(git -C "$root" status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)
[ -z "$dirty" ] || echo "WARNING: the working tree has uncommitted changes — the APKs are not exactly $commit" >&2

"$root/native/noctura-prover/build-android.sh"

gradle=(./gradlew assembleRelease --console=plain --max-workers=3 -Pkotlin.compiler.execution.strategy=in-process)
apk="$root/android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk"
mkdir -p "$out"
rm -f "$out"/*.apk "$out/CONFIG.json"
(cd "$root/android" && ENVFILE=.env.devnet "${gradle[@]}")
cp "$apk" "$out/devnet.apk"
(cd "$root/android" && ENVFILE=.env.production "${gradle[@]}")
cp "$apk" "$out/production.apk"

echo "$commit${dirty:+ (dirty)}" > "$out/COMMIT"
(cd "$out" && sha256sum devnet.apk production.apk > SHA256SUMS)
node "$here/m1b-checkpoint.mjs" check-apks --apks "$out"
echo "built from $commit into $out:"
cat "$out/SHA256SUMS"
```

Create `scripts/m1b-checkpoint/README.md`:

````markdown
# M1b checkpoint — the owner's checklist

Spec: `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-08-shielded-a0-m1-design.md` §16, "Checkpoints · M1b":

> shield an amount from the main account (deposit signed by it); the note shows `unspent` with the leaf index of its
> `LeafInserted`. Wipe the app, restore from the phrase: the shielded balance returns from the chain. (That the
> restore made no note-specific RPC request is not observable on a phone; it is the recording-`Connection` JS test of
> §14, I-3, which must pass at this checkpoint.) The restore's tree-transaction count and its duration on the phone are
> recorded against R13's trigger (5,000 transactions, 60 s). Kill the app between the deposit's submit and its
> confirmation once: at the next start the note is reconciled, not lost.

and "each checkpoint also builds the production APK of the same commit and launches it".

## What is what

| piece | where | who |
|---|---|---|
| the deposit (#16 → #18 → #19 → #20 → #21), the unlocks, the import of the phrase, looking at the screens | the phone, the **devnet app** ("Noctura devnet") | **you, by hand** |
| the readout: one log line after each deposit submit / outcome and each startup step, ONLY public values (signature, main account, amount, commitment, leaf index, counts, durations, error codes) | `src/modules/shielded/a0/checkpointReadout.ts` — **devnet build only** (gate: `FEATURES_SHIELDED=true` and `NETWORK=devnet`) | the app |
| installs (M1a's rules), the kill, the wipe, collecting the readout, the launches | `scripts/m1b-checkpoint/m1b-checkpoint.mjs` (+ `device.mjs`, `lib.mjs`, M1a's `install.mjs`) | this laptop, over adb |
| the judgement: every readout value against devnet (`getTransaction` of each signature, the tree's signature list), the I-3 Jest test, the APKs' BuildConfig | `m1b-checkpoint.mjs verify` | this laptop |
| the build | `scripts/m1b-checkpoint/build-apks.sh` | this laptop |
| the desk's own tests | `node --test scripts/m1b-checkpoint/*.test.mjs` (also in CI) | no phone, no network |

The phone reports values; the desk decides. Nothing the phone says is believed without the chain: the deposit's
signers, amount and commitment come from its devnet transaction, the leaf index from the `LeafInserted` the pool
program emitted in its own frame, the restore's tree-transaction count from the desk's own walk of `5URd…`'s
signatures.

The deposit needs the pool's mint `ERkpCFGaoWmeZPhKTUHumrqHTP1QmyHVhMJUnxbRPKCs` (the devnet test token "TEST", 9
decimals) in the devnet app's main account, and devnet SOL for the fees and the rho-marker rent (≈ 0.0007 SOL per

1,000,000 base units (0.001 TEST) and 500,000 (0.0005 TEST).

signed by this checkpoint's `devnet.apk` key (an app under another key is not the one this checkpoint installed — STOP).

## The rules (fail closed)

- Installs: exactly M1a's (`../m1a-checkpoint/README.md` "The install rules"): never an uninstall; the signer read and
  compared before every install; absence only by two agreeing readings; no wallet installed → `NO WALLET INSTALLED`
  and STOP unless `--allow-fresh-production`; a failed pull, an existing rollback with other contents or an
  `INSTALL_FAILED_*` → STOP (exit 3) with no further adb call.
- The wipe: `pm clear com.nocturawallet.devnet` only, from `wipe` only (a frozen argument list; every other adb call
  goes through the guard that refuses any `clear`), only with `--confirm-wipe com.nocturawallet.devnet`, only for an
  installed devnet app signed by this checkpoint's key. Nothing else is ever cleared.
- The kill and every cold start: `am force-stop` — a process stop, no data touched.
- The network: devnet only (the genesis hash is checked in every batch); never `*.noc-tura.io`, `solscan.io` or mainnet.

## If a line fails

| line | means | look at |
|---|---|---|
| M1b.1 | the deposit is not on devnet, failed, or was signed / paid / deposited by another account than `--main` | `chain.json` → `txs`, the `--main` you passed |
| M1b.2 | the app's leaf index or root is not the `LeafInserted`'s — **stop**: the app would build wrong paths | the readout and the tx's logs |
| M1b.3 | no wipe, another package, or the next start found a record (the wipe did not clear the encrypted store) | `wipe.json`, the first `startup` readout after it |
| M1b.4 | a landed deposit did not come back, or came back at another leaf / amount | the `startup` readout's `notes` |
| M1b.5 | the phone's count is not within the chain's list (more than listed, or fewer than listed a minute before its run) | `chain.json` → `tree` |
| M1b.6 | no kill, too late, not reconciled, or still pending (then: wait 2 min, restart the app, `collect`, `verify`) | `kill.json`, the `startup` readout after it |
| M1b.7 | the I-3 test failed or ran at another commit | `i3-jest.json` |
| M1b.A1–A3 | the APKs are not the devnet / production builds of this commit | `apks/CONFIG.json`, `apks/COMMIT` |
| M1b.8–10 | a launch failed, crashed, or the production app wrote a readout line (**the gate leaked** — stop) | `launches.json`, `crash-*.txt` |
| `STOP: …` (exit 3) | an install or the wipe was not safe to make | the message, `installs.json` |
| `INVALID readout …` | a line that is not the app's format | the raw log |

## What only the phone proves

The desk tests (`node --test scripts/m1b-checkpoint/*.test.mjs`) and the app's Jest suites run everything against
recorded devnet data. Only this run on the phone shows: that the release app's `console.info` reaches the log (the
readout's channel), the real deposit's proof accepted by the program, its leaf, the restore's real count and duration
on this phone (R13), that `pm clear` really empties the encrypted store and keychain so the next start restores, that
a force-stop between submit and confirm leaves a pending note the next start reconciles, and that both release APKs
of this commit start — the production one with its unlock — without a crash and without a readout line.
````

#### Notes for the executor (Task 7)

- **The rulings this task took (each the most secure default; the owner may overturn any):**
  - **The desk reads the phone through a devnet-only LOG LINE, not a screen and not the store.** The values (the note's leaf, R13's counters) are in the encrypted MMKV of a release app — adb cannot read it (no `run-as`), and a debug build would not be the release app the checkpoint is about. A screen would make the owner transcribe hex. The log is the one channel a release app gives adb; it needs `READ_LOGS` (adb / system only on Android ≥ 4.1). Cost if wrong: the readout channel; the judge is unchanged.
  - **Only public values, built field by field.** Every payload lists its fields; no record is spread, so a field added to a note / stats / outcome never reaches the log by accident. Public = on chain once the deposit is broadcast or landed (signature, main account, amount, commitment, leaf, root) or a count / duration / reason / error CODE. Never a rho (public once broadcast, but it is the note's handle), a depositIndex, `lastValidBlockHeight`, `spentTx`, an error message or an outcome's `detail` (an RPC message can quote anything). Tested by sentinels searched in the re-joined payloads (a raw-line search is vacuous under chunking — the first draft's bug).
  - **The gate is `FEATURES_SHIELDED=true && NETWORK=devnet`, read at run time — the code IS in the production bundle** (both APKs carry the same bundle, measured). A build-time strip would need a second bundle or a Babel define for one log line. The claim "absent from production" is therefore made three ways: the production APK's BuildConfig read off the APK (A2, with its negative controls), the Jest test of the default gate under the production config (with the devnet-config positive control), and the phone itself — no readout line after the production launch (M1b.9) and after its unlock (M1b.10). Cost if wrong: a production log line carrying public values only — and the production build never runs the A0 startup or a deposit at all.
  - **The readout sits in the modules (`submitA0Deposit`, the startup state), not in the screens**, so every caller is covered and the screens stay untouched. `submitA0Deposit`'s body is unchanged (renamed `submitOnce`); the wrapper reads out "deposit-submitted" at the `'submitted'` stage — after the send was ACCEPTED — so the desk's kill can never fall before the submit (W2 is the mutation that would allow it).
  - **The kill is the desk's `am force-stop` on the "deposit-submitted" line**, not the owner's thumb: devnet confirms in a second or two, a human swipe after seeing #21 may be too late. The window the kill hits is the poll + the settle sync (several seconds on a phone). Too late is detected, not assumed: an outcome readout of the killed signature in the killed session fails M1b.6 with "repeat". `force-stop` kills the process, touches no data (M1a used it for every cold start).
  - **The wipe is `pm clear com.nocturawallet.devnet`, the ONE clear ever sent**, from one function, a frozen argument list, the exact package name (no prefix, no whitespace, never `com.nocturawallet`, never the `.test` package), a typed `--confirm-wipe com.nocturawallet.devnet`, a 10 s banner, and M1a's signer preflight (the installed devnet app must carry THIS checkpoint's devnet.apk key — an app under another key is not the one we installed). M1a's `install.mjs` is NOT changed: its guard still refuses every `clear`, and the tests prove the guard refuses the very same arguments, so nothing but `clearDevnetAppData` can send it. Cost if wrong: none on the production wallet (unreachable by construction); the devnet wallet is lost without its phrase — the checklist's first item.
  - **Order: deposit → kill (second deposit) → wipe + restore → production.** The kill comes before the wipe so the restore must bring BOTH notes back (M1b.4 checks every deposit of the checkpoint that landed, at its chain leaf). The spec lists the kill last; the order is not normative, and this one checks more.
  - **R13 is judged as a measurement, consistent with the chain**: the phone's `treeTransactions` must lie between the desk's count of successful tree signatures at least 60 s older than the restore's `finishedAt` and the desk's total; `r13TriggerReached` must match the two numbers. Over the trigger, M1b.5 still PASSES and a banner names the pre-mainnet indexer item (§13). The judged restore is the first after the wipe; the first unlock after installing this build also restores (no A0 record yet) and is recorded, not judged.
  - **The deposit's chain checks are the desk's own decoder** (`decodeDevnetTx`: the deposit by its discriminator and IDL account order, the `LeafInserted` only from a `Program data:` line while the invoke stack is exactly `[FeGSS…]`), held to the program side's landed public inputs and to the recorded tree's 17 leaves (indices exactly 0..16) — never the app's `syncedTx.ts`.
  - **I-3 runs inside `verify`** (`npx jest --json` of `restoreRequests.test.ts`) and must be at HEAD, the tree clean, and HEAD = `apks/COMMIT` (A3) — so "must pass at this checkpoint" is a line of the record, not a separate claim.
- **Test tokens (the owner's step):** the mint `ERkp…` (read once from devnet at slot 522688040, 2026-11-15: decimals 9, mint authority `GoBAmZzHvD6F4KHLNmBFh2wZAGE1dwwufeTbifSHEYfd`, no freeze authority, supply 9,000,000 base units) has no faucet. Path 1: ask the program side — the exact message is in the README and in `fund`'s output. Path 2 (found, the owner's decision): GoBAm…'s key file is on this laptop (`~/.config/solana/devnet-a0.json`, `solana-keygen pubkey` = GoBAm…; the program side's acceptance scripts read it), so the owner can mint with `spl-token` himself — the README gives the three commands with the pubkey check first. The desk never signs and never reads a key file. SOL: the public devnet faucet. Two deposits need 1,500,000 base units and ≈ 0.0014 SOL.
- **Measured facts:** devnet build 3 min 7 s incremental on Task 6's, production 40 s; both APKs one bundle (`e4597a33…2d90`), the readout tag in it once; BuildConfig as in Step 6; the tree on devnet still 15 txs at 2026-11-15T22:11Z (R13 on the phone will read ~17–18 after the two deposits — three orders of magnitude under the trigger's count; its duration is the open number). Jest 1387 (+16), node 61 new.
- **Deviations from the brief:** none in scope. The brief's "never uninstall / clear" is kept with the ONE stated exception the brief names (`pm clear` of the devnet app for the wipe). The brief's "the desk reads results" is the readout (a new app module — the only app code this task adds).
- **What only the phone run proves (stated, not tested here):** that a release app's `console.info` reaches logcat (RN's native logging hook in release; if it does not, the desk sees no readout — every phone line fails loudly, nothing passes vacuously); the real proof accepted by the program and the real leaf; the restore's real count and duration (R13); that `pm clear` empties the encrypted store and the keychain entry so the next start restores (`restoredBecause: no-record`); that a force-stop after the submit leaves a pending note the next start reconciles; that both release APKs launch and the production one survives its unlock (the A0 modules' import at unlock) with no readout line.
- **Stated limits:**
  - The readout code ships in the production bundle (gate closed there) — see the ruling.
  - `prod-check` attributes any readout line to the production app only because the devnet app is force-stopped first and its pid is checked absent; logcat lines carry no package.
  - The R13 cross-check's 60 s slack assumes the phone's and the desk's clocks agree within that; a phone clock far off makes M1b.5 fail (loud, never a false pass of the count).
  - A kill that misses (outcome first) is detected, not prevented — repeat with a third deposit (the judge reads the last kill).
  - `npx eslint` cannot parse `scripts/**/*.mjs` (pre-existing, as M1a's).

#### Spec rev 3.3 lines (Task 7)
- §16 M1b, as built: the desk reads the phone through the devnet build's readout (`checkpointReadout.ts`: public values only — signature, main account, amount, commitment, leaf index, root, counts, R13's two numbers, reasons, error codes — gated on `FEATURES_SHIELDED=true` and `NETWORK=devnet`, chunked log lines `NOCTURA-A0-READOUT`), and judges every value against devnet (the deposit's own transaction and `LeafInserted`, the tree's signature list). The code is in both bundles; the gate is closed in the production APK (its BuildConfig, read off the APK) and the production launch and unlock are checked to write no readout line.
- §16 M1b "Wipe the app" = `pm clear com.nocturawallet.devnet`, the one clear any checkpoint sends: exact package, typed confirmation, the installed app signed by the checkpoint's devnet key; never the production wallet.
- §16 M1b "Kill the app between the deposit's submit and its confirmation" = the desk's `am force-stop` of the devnet app on the "deposit-submitted" readout (emitted once the send is accepted); a kill after the app saw the outcome is detected and repeated. The kill precedes the wipe, so the restore must return both deposits.
- §16 M1b R13: the judged restore is the first after the wipe; its count must lie within the desk's own walk of `5URd…`; the line records the numbers and the trigger (over it = the §13 indexer item), it does not fail on them.
- §16 M1b I-3: `restoreRequests.test.ts` is run by the desk's `verify` at HEAD (clean, = the APKs' commit) and is a line of the checkpoint record.
- §16 M1b production: the production APK of the same commit is launched AND unlocked (the A0 modules load at unlock in every build) — both checked for a clean crash buffer.
- §1 / §15 (fact): the devnet A0 mint `ERkp…` has mint authority `GoBAm…` (the pool authority's key), no freeze authority (slot 522688040); test tokens come from the program side.
